raw.excerpt: Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.
raw.description:
Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

As a Senior Manager of Operations within Customer Success & Operations, you will lead a multi-team organization of Operations Managers responsible for the accurate, compliant, and timely execution of multiple money movement flows on behalf of our clients and their participants. Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Operations, you will translate high-level organizational strategy into actionable operational plans, driving a culture of continuous improvement, strict risk mitigation, and client-centric execution.

In this role, you will serve as a critical strategic link between frontline operations and cross-functional leadership—including Product, Engineering, Data, Legal, and Sales/Onboarding. You will mentor and develop direct-report managers, scale high-volume transaction operations, and leverage data-driven insights to elevate customer experiences while maintaining a lean operational footprint.

About the team

The CS Operations organization sits at the heart of Human Interest's mission to make retirement savings accessible. Our teams ensure high-value financial transactions for thousands of participants every day are handled seamlessly—ensuring every dollar lands in the right place, on time, and in full compliance with regulatory requirements. We operate in a highly regulated environment where errors carry real and substantial financial risk, so precision is non-negotiable. We maintain data integrity through rigorous review, quality control, and escalation protocols, and we collaborate closely with Customer Success, Engineering, Product, and Compliance to optimize workflows, surface operational insights, and continuously improve the customer experience. We partner tightly with peer teams across Operations to share best practices, understand shared challenges, and strengthen Operations as a whole.

What you get to do every day

  • Coach & Develop Leaders: Directly manage, mentor, and build leadership bench strength across multiple Operations Managers. Establish high performance standards, hold leaders accountable to ambitious KPIs, and cultivate a robust pipeline of future operational talent.
  • Drive Vision & Strategic Alignment: Translate company strategy into departmental goals across multiple money movement flows. Maintain a broad business perspective, ensuring team priorities align directly with company objectives and broader operational effectiveness.
  • Operational Excellence & Performance Monitoring: Own high-level metrics for SLA adherence, quality, accuracy, and cycle times. Utilize data, capacity modeling, and optimization reports to continuously elevate throughput and set ambitious goals across teams.
  • Cross-Functional Strategic Partnership: Build collaborative relationships with leaders in CS&O, Product, Data, Legal, and Sales. Act as an operational translator, channeling frontline customer insights to shape product roadmaps while seamlessly operationalizing technical and regulatory changes.
  • Risk Management & Control Environment: Maintain a rigorous control environment across all transaction lifecycles. Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks to prevent financial loss and ensure full compliance in a highly regulated landscape.
  • Client Experience & Root Cause Analysis: Foster a client-first mindset that looks beyond vanity metrics to evaluate true customer experience. Lead deep-dive root cause analyses on operational trends and complex escalations to implement long-term structural fixes.
  • Process Optimization & Innovation: Drive a culture of innovation by identifying and scaling opportunities for workflow automation, process standardization, and system enhancements to maintain a lean operational footprint.
  • Change Leadership & Transparent Communication: Lead teams through change with clarity and empathy. Maintain clear, concise, and solution-oriented reporting cadences with executive leadership and internal stakeholders.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What you bring to the role

  • Experience: 4+ years of operational management experience in financial services, fintech, retirement services (401k), or banking, with 2+ years specifically managing other People Managers/Leaders.
  • Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of money movement processes, transaction lifecycles, and risk controls within a regulated environment.
  • Leadership Development: Proven track record of developing direct-report managers, setting clear expectations, managing performance, and building high-performing operational teams.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Demonstrated ability to leverage complex data reports, staffing models, and SLA metrics to drive strategy and prioritize trade-offs.
  • Cross-Functional Influence: Exceptional ability to partner with cross-functional leadership (Product, Engineering, Legal, CS) to align on shared goals and advocate for operational priorities.
  • Change & Process Management: Experience designing end-to-end operational improvements, scaling processes, and leading large teams through organizational change.
  • Communication & Integrity: High ethical standards with outstanding written and verbal communication skills tailored for executive leadership.

Nice to have

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
  • Direct experience with 401(k) recordkeeping systems, payroll integrations, or complex financial reconciliations.
  • Formal certification in process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma) or continuous improvement frameworks.
  • Experience in high-growth, fast-paced fintech environments.

Why you will love working at Human Interest

Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. You'll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium-sized businesses nationwide. We’ve made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission-driven team. We value hard work and recognize that our team's contributions are key to our continued success.

Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement.

Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest’s unique view on what’s important and what’s right. Documenting this core aspect of our culture helps employees make good decisions on their own. It also helps candidates considering career opportunities critically evaluate whether they will thrive at Human Interest.

  • Customer obsession: We're all about creating amazing experiences for our customers. We put their needs first and go the extra mile to make them smile.
  • Long-Term Orientation: We're not just playing for today; we're building a legacy. We think big, plan strategically, and invest in our future.
  • Autonomous and Accountable Teams: We trust our team members to take ownership and make smart decisions. We empower you to be your best self!
  • An Escalating Bar for Talent and Performance: We're constantly raising the bar and challenging ourselves to be better. We believe in growth and continuous improvement.
  • Fundamental Optimism: We see the glass as half full (and then we fill it up with more amazing ideas!). We believe in the power of positivity and the potential for greatness.

Compensation - At Human Interest, there are a number of factors that are used to determine the appropriate pay range for each position. We take into account the cost of labor for each position in various markets across the U.S. The base salary for this position spans $125,000 - $150,000and represents the minimum in our lowest geographic region to a maximumin our highest geographic region. The salary we offer to a new employee within this range is based on their location within the U.S., their relevant job-related skills, and experience. At Human Interest, base salary is one component of the overall total rewards package. Depending on the position, additional compensation components such as bonuses, commissions, and equity may be offered. All of our employees are offered a robust suite of physical, financial, and mental wellness benefits. In compliance with applicable laws, we do not inquire about salary history, or about criminal history prior to a conditional offer of employment.

Benefits -

  • A great 401(k) plan: Our own! Our 401(k) includes a dollar-for-dollar employer match up to 4% of compensation (immediately vested) and $0 plan fees
  • Top-of-the-line health plans, as well as dental and vision insurance
  • Competitive time off and parental leave
  • Addition Wealth: Unlimited access to digital tools, financial professionals, and a knowledge center to help you understand your equity and support your financial wellness
  • Lyra: Enhanced Mental Health Support for Employees and dependents
  • Carrot: Fertility healthcare and family forming benefits
  • Candidly: Student loan resource to help you and your family plan, borrow, and repay student debt
  • Monthly work-from-home stipend; quarterly lifestyle stipend
  • Engaging team-building experiences, ranging from virtual social events to team offsites, promoting collaboration and camaraderie.

We’re a great place to work (but don’t take our word for it)

Here’s a list of our awards and accolades:

  • Certified as a Great Place To Work® (2023-2025)
  • Fortune Best Place to Work in the Bay Area (2024)
  • Best Places to Work by Built In (2023-2024)
  • America’s Best Startup Employers by Forbes (2020-2022, 2024)
  • A Top Company by Y Combinator (2020-2023)
  • Inc. Fastest Growing Companies (2021)

All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran or military status, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected under federal, state, or local laws. Employment with Human Interest is at-will, meaning either you or the company may terminate employment at any time, with or without cause or notice, except as otherwise provided by law or written agreement.

raw.description:
NVIDIA is searching for a MSc/PhD candidate to join our growing software architecture team. The ideal candidate will be conducting innovative research at the intersection of Networking, Security, and Communications, and working alongside top authorities in these fields. With incredible resources at your disposal, you will be able to impact, contribute and advance these exiting domains. Topics include but are not limited to remote direct memory access, hardware offloading and acceleration, AI for networking and security, storage management, cryptography, and architecture. With its unique open culture, NVIDIA is one of the best industry labs to do Accelerated

Computing research.


DPU Data-Processing Units are the smallest form of a data center, and provide the foundation to implement accelerated computing, where both processing and networking experience a performance boost through the utilization of dedicated processors. DPUs started out as the engine for accelerated networking, but now they can run AI inference and training on-board, deep packet inspection and cryptography accelerations among others thanks to onboard GPUs and acceleration engines. Join us to research next-generation accelerated data-center architectures in a unique internship with NVIDIA partnership.


What you’ll be doing:

  • Be at the forefront of modern data center research
  • Partner and collaborate with forward-thinking industry leaders and external researchers
  • Participate and speak at conferences and events
  • Publish original research
  • Work with intelligent networking machines powered by AI systems that can learn, reason and interact with other network components

What we need to see:

  • Pursuing a PhD or a MSc Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or Computer Engineering
  • General computer science background, preferably in algorithm design, system programming, networking, operating system, and computer architecture.
  • Strong programming (C/C++/Python) and software development skills
  • Low-level Linux
  • Good communications skills

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. Are you creative and autonomous? Do you love the challenge of crafting the highest performance & lowest power silicon possible? If so, we want to hear from you. Come, join our Networking Research Team and help build the real-time, cost-effective computing platform driving our success in this exciting and quickly growing field.

raw.description:
WE ARE TITANIUM HEALTHCARE

Titanium is a healthcare company that puts heart and compassion above all else. Millions of Americans just aren’t getting the medical care they need. We’re on a mission to change that. For patients that means exceptional support and better care. For providers it means better support and time to focus on patients, and for partners that means higher quality and lower cost.

Join us in our mission!

POSITION SUMMARY

The RN Clinical Consultant is a key member of Titanium Healthcare’s Enhanced Care Management (ECM) program, providing clinical oversight and guidance to support high-quality, coordinated care for complex member populations. ECM is a benefit under California Advancing and Innovating Medi-Cal (CalAIM), designed to deliver comprehensive, person-centered care that addresses medical, behavioral, and social determinants of health.

In this role, the RN Clinical Consultant partners closely with Lead Care Managers (LCMs) and interdisciplinary team members to ensure care delivery is clinically appropriate, compliant, and aligned with healthcare plan requirements. The Clinical Consultant supports clinical decision-making, risk stratification, and care planning across the ECM population.

The RN Clinical Consultant is responsible for oversight of Comprehensive Assessments, Care Management Plans, Transitions of Care, and clinical escalations, ensuring timely interventions and continuity of care. This role plays a critical part in improving health outcomes, reducing avoidable utilization, and supporting members through complex care journeys.

ECM services are provided to eligible Medi-Cal members enrolled in managed care plans and focus on sustained engagement, care coordination, and connection to community-based resources. Through collaboration with internal teams and external providers, the RN Clinical Consultant helps ensure members receive the right care, at the right time, in the most appropriate setting.

WHERE YOU’LL WORK

This position is remote and is based out of California. Standard business hours are Monday through Friday from 8:00 am to 5:00 pm. 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Provide clinical oversight and support to ensure high-quality effective care management for members across the ECM program
  • Collaborate closely with Lead Care Managers (LCMs) and ancillary clinical staff (e.g., RNs, LCSWs, RDs) to support member care needs and clinical decision-making
  • Facilitate access to appropriate healthcare services including primary care, behavioral health, and specialty services, as needed
  • Complete clinical oversight of Comprehensive Assessments and Care Management Plans to ensure accuracy, appropriateness, and alignment with healthcare plan guidelines
  • Lead and/or participate in Emergent and Non-Emergent Clinical Case Conferences to address complex member needs and ensure timely interventions
  • Participate in Interdisciplinary Care Team (ICT) meetings to provide clinical input and recommendations to support coordinated and whole-person care
  • Conduct and/or oversee medication reconciliation to ensure safety and accuracy of member medication regimens
  • Support and guide smooth Transitions of Care (TOC) following emergency room visits and hospitalizations, ensuring timely follow-up and continuity of care
  • Engage members, as appropriate, using clinical expertise and motivational interviewing techniques to support health behavior change and care plan adherence
  • Provide health education within scope of practice to promote improved health outcomes
  • Coordinate care through collaboration with internal teams and external providers, ensuring seamless communication and continuity of care
  • Ensure all clinical activities are documented accurately and in accordance with organizational, regulatory, and healthcare plan requirements
  • Consult and collaborate with clinical leadership as needed for complex cases or escalations
  • Participate in case reviews and clinical discussions to support quality, consistency, and continuous improvement
  • Adhere to all departmental and organizational policies, procedures, and compliance requirements
  • Perform other duties and projects as assigned

WHO YOU ARE

Sensory Requirements

  • Fluent in English (written and verbal)
  • Ability to communicate clearly in-person, by phone, and electronically
  • Adequate hearing and vision (with corrective devices if necessary) to conduct assessments and documentation
  • Ability to identify problems and use logic and related information to develop and implement solutions
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Commitment to maintaining patient confidentiality and adhering to ethical standards in healthcare practice

Physical Activity

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position

Environmental Conditions

  • Ability to maintain professionalism
  • Ability to work independently and carry out assignments to completion within the parameters of established policies and procedures

Technology Use

  • Frequent use of computers, keyboard, and handheld/mobile devices
  • Ability to type for extended periods
  • Competent with computers, email, virtual platforms, and Microsoft Office based programs

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • Associate’s degree in nursing
  • Minimum 1+ years of experience as an RN working in a healthcare setting, such as a medical clinic or acute care hospital
  • A current and unrestricted CA state RN license
  • Experience using an EHR
  • Distraction-free home workspace with a secure internet connection

NICE TO HAVES

  • Care management experience
  • Bachelor's degree in nursing
  • Experience using eClinical Works (eCW)
  • Valid BLS certification from the American Heart Association
  • Valid CPR Certification
  • Bilingual in Spanish

WHAT YOU’LL ENJOY

  • Make an impact: an organization who cares about its employees, communities, and the future of healthcare
  • Inclusivity: be a part of a workplace where you not only belong but also can be the best version of yourself
  • Growth: opportunities to develop and grow your career with us
  • Community: you are encouraged to have a voice, share your opinions, and have an individual impact on the business
  • Paid Time Off: 12 holidays and up to 15 days of accrued PTO to rest and recharge plus additional time off for sick, jury duty, bereavement, reproductive loss, and therapy
  • Work Life Balance: enjoy flexibility to maximize your well-being and success with our hybrid work model
  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Benefits: we cover up to 100% of your premium and 50% of your dependents depending on the plan
  • Prioritize your mental health with unlimited therapy sessions funded 100% by Titanium Healthcare
  • Flexible Spending, Health Savings & Dependent Care Accounts
  • Life/AD&D insurance funded 100% by Titanium Healthcare
  • Supplemental Disability Plans
  • Employee Assistance Programs
  • Protect your pet(s) with Pet Insurance
  • Employee Referral Program: earn up to $1000 for each referral
  • 401(k) plan and Roth IRA options

EEO Statement

At Titanium Healthcare, our mission is to fearlessly reengineer the way healthcare works to reduce costs, ensure better outcomes, and provide everyone, everywhere, with the kind of compassionate and coordinated care they deserve. We believe that achieving this mission starts with a diverse and inclusive workforce.

Titanium Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to promoting and celebrating all backgrounds and encourage all applicants, regardless of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, parental status, military or veteran status, or any other legally protected status, to apply. We believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and equity in healthcare, enabling us to better serve our communities and make a lasting impact.

Salary: $80,000-$95,000

Rezolve Ai (NASDAQ: RZLV) is an industry leader in AI-powered solutions, specializing in enhancing customer engagement, operational efficiency, and revenue growth. The Brain Suite delivers advanced tools that harness artificial intelligence to optimize processes, improve decision-making, and enable seamless digital experiences.

With recent acquisitions of Bluedot, GroupBy, ViSenze and Crownpeak, Rezolve is accelerating innovation at the intersection of AI, commerce, and customer engagement.

What’s the role?

The role operates as the single point of ownership for marketing deliverables, replacing the prior distributed/co-owned model. We strive for success, are always pushing to do better, and work with pride and purpose together. You can see them in action in all aspects of our everyday work.

Join us and make an immediate impact in the digital world.

Job Summary:

Provides advanced technical leadership for knowledge management, external visibility, and strategic engagement across large, complex, multi-country global health projects in global health security, emergency and outbreak response, HIV, tuberculosis, malaria, polio, maternal, newborn, and child health, and health systems strengthening. Sets strategic direction and oversees systems and approaches that facilitate knowledge sharing, collaboration, and cross-country learning. Leads the development of strategic messaging and high-quality technical products for donor, government, partner, and public audiences to communicate project achievements, innovations, evidence, and impact. Directs the planning and execution of webinars, conference sessions, technical events, and other dissemination activities. Ensures technical accuracy, consistency, and adherence to donor branding and marking requirements and organizational standards across products and platforms. Advises project and organizational leadership on approaches to capture, synthesize, and disseminate evidence, lessons learned, and best practices that strengthen program performance and promote the use of knowledge across projects. Provides technical guidance to staff and consultants and may oversee a technical area, team, or portfolio. Strong leadership, project management, writing and editing skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities are essential; experience with social media, photography, graphic design, and visual communications is desirable.

Technical Requirements:

  • Provides advanced technical leadership in knowledge management, external visibility, and strategic engagement related to one or more of the following technical areas: global health security; outbreak and emergency response; HIV; tuberculosis; malaria; polio; maternal, newborn and child health and nutrition; and health systems strengthening.
  • Advises senior technical and project leadership on strategies, systems, and approaches for identifying, synthesizing, and communicating evidence, lessons learned, best practices, and innovations.

Project Design Implementation:

  • Leads the design and implementation of knowledge management and external visibility strategies, work plans, and technical components for large, complex, multi-country projects.
  • Oversees processes, tools, and approaches that promote knowledge sharing, collaboration, and cross-country learning across projects and technical areas.
  • Directs the identification, documentation, synthesis, and dissemination of lessons learned, best practices, innovations, evidence, and project achievements.
  • Leads the planning and execution of webinars, learning events, technical exchanges, conference sessions, and other knowledge-sharing and dissemination activities that support project and organizational objectives.

Business Development and Client/Funder Support:

  • Leads or contributes to the design of knowledge management, learning, external visibility, and dissemination components of proposals, budgets, and work plans.
  • Provides technical input and strategic messaging for proposal development, client and funder meetings, presentations, and reports.
  • Maintains collaborative relationships with donor and client organizations, relevant government agencies, bilateral organizations, and NGOs.

Capacity Strengthening:

  • Develops and implements activities to strengthen the knowledge management, technical communications, and external visibility capacity of country office staff and implementing partners.
  • Provides technical guidance, coaching, and tools to support consistent quality and effective knowledge sharing across countries and projects.

Staff Leadership and Training:

  • May supervise team members, consultants, or other technical contributors; assigns work, monitors progress and quality, and supports professional development.
  • Develops and implements training, guidance, and competency-strengthening activities and identifies strategies to address capacity gaps.

Project/Program Reporting:

  • Leads the development and quality review of digital and visual knowledge products, including social media content, photography, data visualization, graphic design, video, and multimedia materials, as needed.
  • Synthesizes complex technical information and evidence from multiple sources into concise, strategic, audience-appropriate products for donors, partners, government stakeholders, project teams, and public audiences.

Quality Assurance:

  • Proactively identifies risks or challenges affecting deliverable quality, timeliness, or compliance and develops mitigation plans.
  • Reviews and evaluates the effectiveness of knowledge management, dissemination, and external visibility approaches and recommends enhancements to systems and procedures.

Applied Knowledge & Skills:

  • Demonstrated expertise in synthesizing complex technical information, evidence, and lessons learned into clear, strategic, actionable messages and products tailored for technical, donor, program, government, partner, and public audiences.
  • Knowledge of donor branding and marking requirements, organizational style standards, and quality assurance and clearance processes for technical and public-facing products.
  • Strong leadership, project management, analytical, problem-solving, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
  • Excellent writing, editing, storytelling, content and message development, and verbal communication skills.
  • Must be able to read, write, and speak fluent English. Proficiency in French is desired; proficiency in other languages is a plus.

Education: **

  • Master's Degree or its International Equivalent in Knowledge/Information Services, Communications, Education, Public Health, International Development, Social Sciences, or a related field.
  • Project Management certification preferred.

Experience: **

  • Typically requires 12+ years of relevant experience in global health, international development, knowledge management, technical communications, organizational learning, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership for large, complex, multi-country projects or programs.
  • Demonstrated experience leading the development and quality assurance of technical products, strategic messaging, knowledge-sharing activities, and external communications for donor, government, partner, or public audiences.
  • Experience leading or contributing to business development efforts, including proposal design, writing, budgeting, or work planning.
  • Relevant publications, presentations, reports, campaigns, tools, or multimedia products.
  • Prior work experience in a non-governmental organization, government agency, or similar international development organization.

Typical Physical Demands:

  • Typical office environment.
  • Ability to spend long hours looking at computer screen and doing repetitive work on a keyboard.
  • Ability to sit and stand for extended periods of time.
  • Ability to lift/move up to 5 lbs.

Technology to be Used:

  • Personal Computer/Laptop, Microsoft applications (i.e., Office 365, SharePoint, Skype/Zoom/Teams), cell phone/mobile technology, and standard office equipment.
  • Proficiency in Skills in Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, Sprout Social, Muck Rack, or other creative software/applications a plus.

Travel Requirements:

  • 10% - 25%

Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;
  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well-Being - we will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff.

Job Title: Clinical Eligibility & Intake Nurse

Classification: Part Time/1099 Contractor

Work Structure: Fully Remote

Shift: Monday-Friday; 3-5 hours per day / 15-20 hours per week*; schedule must overlap intake hours**

Team: Clinical Operations

Reporting to: Clinical Eligibility Lead (intake coverage coordinated with Care Delivery)

Location: United States

Compensation: $27-30 per hour

*Additional hours are available on intake coverage days and as enrollment projects arise that focus on specific target populations.

**Must be available for eligibility/enrollment team meetings and able to switch to intake coverage on short notice during scheduled hours.

About Us

One in three people die of heart disease - it's time to change that. We're redesigning heart health from the ground up so that everyone can live fuller lives. Our team consists of mission-driven clinicians, engineers, and professionals attacking a problem using evidence-based research and guidelines for cardiovascular rehabilitation. We're working to deliver exercise and wellness to older adults with cardiovascular disease using telemedicine. We are dedicated to delivering exceptional services that enhance the lives of our patients.

Job Summary

The Clinical Eligibility & Intake Specialist splits time between two kinds of work. Most days, you will review the EMR records of cardiac recovery patients to determine medical eligibility for Aviary Health's virtual cardiac rehab program. When intake needs extra capacity, such as a last-minute call-out, a schedule gap, or a high-volume week, you will step in to run initial assessments with new patients over video.

This role suits a nurse who is equally comfortable working a chart review queue independently and sitting with a new patient to explain the program, review their history, and build their plan.

Responsibilities

Clinical eligibility (majority of hours)

  • Reviewing patient charts in Epic and other EMRs to determine medical eligibility/ineligibility using the inclusion/exclusion list and decision tree
  • Identifying current cardiac rehab referral orders, or creating cardiac rehab referral orders when needed
  • Communicating eligibility and ineligibility decisions to the enrollment team through concise documentation in the appropriate platforms

raw.excerpt: ABOUT OLIPOPAt OLIPOP, we’re on a mission to positively impact consumer health at scale.
raw.description:
ABOUT OLIPOP

At OLIPOP, we’re on a mission to positively impact consumer health at scale. And we’re doing it through something simple: soda. But not just any soda, a new kind of soda: one that’s delicious, refreshing, and actually good for you.

This mission is deeply personal for our CEO, Co-Founder, and Formulator, Ben Goodwin. Like many of us, Ben grew up consuming the Standard American Diet: lots of soda and processed foods that prioritized convenience over nutrition. But at 14, he took his health into his own hands. After making significant changes to his nutrition and exercise, he lost 50 pounds and saw a transformation in his energy, mood, and emotional clarity.

Those changes sparked a deep curiosity about the connection between nutrition and health. Ben became a relentless student of the gut microbiome and the ways it supports overall wellness. The more he discovered, the more passionate he became about finding credible, science-backed ways to make consumer health accessible to everyone.

The mission was clear. The vehicle? Less so. After exploring the possibilities, Ben landed on an unexpected yet familiar choice: soda. It was something he loved as a kid, and he knew millions shared that same nostalgia. But this wouldn’t be just any soda. With most Americans falling short on daily fiber, Ben set out to create a version with more fiber and less sugar, one that was perfectly balanced. The result? A deliciously refreshing soda with 6 to 9 grams of fiber and 2 to 5 grams of sugar, delivering science-backed benefits without sacrificing the classic taste people crave.

In 2018, the first OLIPOP cans hit the shelves, bringing Ben’s vision to life with a functional soda that anyone could enjoy. And by reimagining soda, we’re also reshaping culture. That means creating products that support health for all and building a business grounded in humanistic values: empathy, integrity, and a belief in better for everyone. From the ingredients we source to the culture we foster, we’re committed to proving that business (and beverage!) can be a force for good, and that soda has the power to bring people together.

So join us, and let’s write a new American soda story together. One we can all feel good about. One OLIPOP at a time.

ABOUT THE ROLE

OLIPOP is seeking a strategic, commercially minded, and highly operational Vice President of FP&A to lead enterprise financial planning, performance management, and strategic decision support through the company’s next stage of scale.

As Vice President, FP&A, you will serve as a senior finance leader and trusted partner to the CFO, executive leadership team, and cross-functional business leaders. You will own the company’s long-range planning process, enterprise financial model, forecasting operating rhythm, board and executive reporting, and strategic financial analysis that informs critical investment, growth, and profitability decisions.

This role requires a leader who can translate company strategy into financial priorities, build scalable FP&A capabilities, influence senior stakeholders through data-backed recommendations, and create the systems, routines, and team structure needed to support a high-growth CPG business.

You will be expected to balance strategic vision with operational discipline, bringing strong judgment, executive presence, and a clear point of view to ambiguous and high-impact business decisions.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Enterprise Financial Strategy & Long-Range Planning

  • Lead OLIPOP’s long-range planning process, partnering with executive and functional leaders to translate company strategy into multi-year financial plans, resource allocation priorities, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Own and evolve OLIPOP’s enterprise financial model, ensuring it serves as a dynamic decision-making tool for growth planning, profitability, capital allocation, and scenario analysis.
  • Partner with senior leadership to evaluate strategic tradeoffs across revenue growth, margin expansion, operating expense investment, working capital, and organizational scale.
  • Develop financial frameworks that help the business anticipate future risks, opportunities, and investment needs as OLIPOP continues to grow.

Financial Planning, Forecasting & Performance Management

  • Own the company-wide forecasting and planning operating rhythm across gross revenue, net revenue, trade, COGS, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA, cash flow, balance sheet, and key business drivers.
  • Lead the annual budget, reforecasting, and monthly performance management processes, ensuring cross-functional leaders have clear visibility into financial expectations, tradeoffs, and accountability.
  • Establish clear financial governance, timelines, tools, and reporting standards that improve forecast accuracy, business ownership, and decision quality.
  • Compare monthly operating results against budget and forecast, identify key variances, and partner with business owners to understand drivers, risks, and corrective actions.

Executive, Board & Investor Readiness

  • Lead preparation of board, executive, and corporate reporting materials, ensuring financial narratives are clear, accurate, actionable, and tied to enterprise priorities.
  • Translate complex financial and operational insights into executive-ready recommendations that support high-quality decisions.
  • Support equity raise, debt, or capital markets initiatives as needed, including materials preparation, diligence support, quality of earnings support, cost of capital analysis, scenario modeling, and investor-facing financial narratives.
  • Serve as a senior finance partner in high-stakes discussions, bringing strong judgment, business context, and a clear articulation of financial implications.

Strategic Finance & Decision Support

  • Lead financial modeling and analysis for strategic decisions, including growth investments, new products, channel expansion, pricing strategy, margin optimization, tradeoffs, and process improvements.
  • Evaluate profitability by product, channel, customer, SKU, region, and other relevant dimensions to guide investment decisions and commercial strategy.
  • Partner with Sales, Revenue Growth Management, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, and Accounting to evaluate business performance and identify opportunities to improve profitable growth.
  • Develop and improve pricing, margin, and investment models for existing products, new products, channels, and customer opportunities.
  • Partner with revenue and commercial teams on deal pricing, trade investment reviews, commission structures, and customer-level financial decision support.

Finance Operating Model, Systems & Scale

  • Design and implement scalable FP&A processes, tools, reporting infrastructure, and operating rhythms that improve business visibility, speed, accuracy, and decision-making.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen financial systems, planning tools, data quality, and reporting automation to support company growth.
  • Build repeatable workflows that enable disciplined business reviews, faster insight generation, and stronger accountability across functions.
  • Lead ad hoc strategic analyses and special projects that support enterprise priorities and evolving business needs.

Team Leadership & Capability Building

  • Build, structure, and develop a high-performing FP&A team aligned to OLIPOP’s strategy, business complexity, and future scale.
  • Establish clear roles, expectations, development plans, and operating cadences that strengthen team effectiveness and business partnership.
  • Coach and develop finance talent, creating a culture of accountability, curiosity, analytical rigor, continuous improvement, and strong stakeholder partnership.
  • Model OLIPOP’s leadership expectations by leading with clarity, trust, inclusion, sound judgment, and a strong ownership mindset.

Cross-Functional Influence & Executive Partnership

  • Serve as a senior connector across Finance, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, People, and Executive Leadership, ensuring financial insights are embedded into business planning and decision-making.
  • Influence senior leaders through clear financial storytelling, data-backed recommendations, and balanced assessment of risk, opportunity, and long-term impact.
  • Navigate ambiguity and competing priorities with maturity, transparency, and a company-first mindset.
  • Champion OLIPOP’s culture and values by creating clarity, raising the bar for financial discipline, and helping teams connect day-to-day decisions to company goals.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 12–15+ years of progressive finance experience, including significant leadership experience in FP&A, strategic finance, corporate finance, or related functions.
  • Experience leading FP&A in a high-growth CPG, food & beverage, consumer products, retail, marketplace, or similarly complex operating environment strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to own enterprise planning, forecasting, financial modeling, budget management, and executive-level business performance reporting.
  • Strong commercial and operational finance acumen, including experience with revenue planning, margin analysis, pricing, tradeoffs, customer/channel profitability, working capital, and investment decision support.
  • Demonstrated experience preparing executive, board, investor, or lender-facing financial materials with clear narratives and actionable recommendations.
  • Strong understanding of accounting, budgeting, cost control, and finance principles, including GAAP.
  • Track record of building scalable FP&A processes, tools, systems, reporting routines, and financial governance in a growing organization.
  • Experience building, leading, and developing high-performing teams; able to create clarity, accountability, and development pathways during periods of change and scale.
  • Strategic and effective communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, simplify complex financial concepts, and drive alignment across diverse stakeholders.
  • Strong judgment and decision quality; able to evaluate complex tradeoffs, assess risk, and recommend practical paths forward in ambiguous situations.
  • High emotional intelligence and cultural competency, with the ability to build trust, resolve tension productively, and partner effectively across functions.
  • Strategic and hands-on: comfortable shaping enterprise-level finance strategy while also diving into models, details, and operating mechanics when needed.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or related field preferred; MBA and/or CPA a plus.
  • Comfortable operating in a remote-first, fast-paced, highly collaborative environment using tools such as Microsoft Suite, Google Suite, Slack, Zoom, NetSuite, Claude AI (other exposure to AI tools) and financial planning/reporting platforms.
  • Flexibility to travel as needed for company meetings, team offsites, board preparation, and cross-functional planning sessions. Estimated Travel:10-15%

REPORTS TO:

CFO

COMPENSATION:

$220,000-$260,000 base salary + bonus

HOW WE WORK

We may be fully remote, but we’re anything but disconnected. OLIPOP has grown from a few passionate people around a table to a nationwide team, and we’ve done it without losing our collaborative spirit or sense of purpose.

Connection here is intentional. From cross-functional projects and IRL offsites to thoughtful Slack threads and spontaneous gifs, we make the effort to stay close, even across time zones. Sure, we move quickly, but we lead with trust, transparency, and a shared commitment to doing work that matters.

We value thoughtful debate. We give feedback with care and receive it with curiosity, knowing that real growth, both personal and collective, comes from listening as much as leading. Because at OLIPOP, it’s not just about getting things done. It’s about growing together, staying true to what matters, and building something with lasting impact.

WHAT WE VALUE

At OLIPOP, our values aren’t just posters on a wall. They shape how we show up: for each other, for our customers, and for the mission we’re chasing together.

  • Mission Connectivity: Everything we do ladders up to our shared goal: supporting human health. Whether launching a new flavor or conducting clinical research, the mission stays front and center.
  • Indomitable Spirit: When things get messy, we get inventive. We stay curious, adapt quickly, and find the path forward, most likely with a dedicated Slack thread and a beautifully overbuilt deck.
  • Lead at Every Level: Leadership isn’t about titles, it’s about ownership. We speak up, follow through, and lift each other up. If you’ve got ideas and initiative, you’ve got influence.
  • Courageous Humility: We’re confident in what we bring and curious about what we don’t know (yet). We give feedback with care, take it with grace, and know that real growth takes both.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Success at OLIPOP doesn’t come from checking boxes; it comes from living our values, staying curious, and finding energy in both the pace and the purpose. We’re building something big, and we’re looking for people who:

  • Think big, move fast, and take thoughtful risks
  • Thrive in a high-performance, feedback-rich environment
  • Value real human connection and honest collaboration
  • Are fired up by building something new, and making it better every day

Startup life at OLIPOP is equally fun and fast-paced. If you’re energized by a dynamic environment, eager to grow, and excited to help shape something meaningful from the inside out, OLIPOP is a one-of-a-kind ride.

raw.excerpt: We're hiring a Business & Data Analyst to support the consolidation of an acquired screening platform into Veremark.
raw.description:
We're hiring a Business & Data Analyst to support the consolidation of an acquired screening platform into Veremark. You'll work under the direction of our M&A PMO, delivering analysis and data tasks against our established integration playbook.

Veremark is a background screening and workforce trust technology company. Employers use us to run pre-employment checks, to verify criminal records, right to work, references, identity, credit and more, through our platform and integrate us with their ATS and HR systems.

You'll sit in the PMO's lean core team, taking direction from the Program Director and supporting the operations, HR and finance leads, product and engineering. It's a hybrid role: half business analysis (processes, requirements, gap analysis), half hands-on data (profiling, reconciliation, reporting). It's a great fit if you've been a BA or data analyst for a few years and want broad exposure to a real M&A integration.

You'll pick up tasks from the Program Director and workstream leads, following our existing M&A integration playbook and flagging anything that doesn't fit.

Platform consolidation

  • Help map the acquired platform: check types, workflows, candidate journeys, client configurations and edge cases.

  • Carry out gap analysis against Veremark's product using the playbook templates, and present findings for decision.

  • Keep the migration plan and tracker up to date: cohorts, cut-over dates, dependencies and actions.

  • Document current and future-state processes, and draft requirements and user stories for review.

Integrations and billing

  • Build and maintain the inventory of ATS/HRIS integrations, API consumers and webhooks, and each client's migration status.

  • Help map products, price books and contract terms onto Veremark's pricing, flagging anything that looks off.

  • Support Finance with billing reconciliation through cut-over.

Data, validation and reporting

  • Profile the acquired platform's data with SQL: volumes, usage by client, active vs. dormant accounts, data quality.

  • Help build field-level mappings between the two data models, and test migrated data against them.

  • Run the validation and reconciliation queries on each client cohort, and log and chase data issues.

  • Maintain the migration dashboard and prepare data for PMO reporting.

  • Use AI tools to speed up the work: summarising legacy docs, drafting mappings, cleansing and classifying data.

  • Pull usage and revenue data to help the PMO prioritise which clients move first.

Customers and stakeholders

  • Provide data and client lists to Customer Success and Sales for migration comms.

  • Contribute progress, issues and data to the Program Director's weekly update.

  • Follow Compliance guidance on consent, data residency and audit when handling migrated data.

Must have

  • 2+ years as a business analyst, business systems analyst or data analyst, ideally in B2B SaaS.

  • Worked on a platform migration, system implementation or integration project as part of a team.

  • Solid SQL (joins, CTEs, aggregations): comfortable writing your own queries to profile and reconcile data.

  • Core BA skills: process mapping, gap analysis, data mapping, requirements and user stories, UAT.

  • Some experience building dashboards or reports in a BI tool (e.g. Looker, Metabase, Power BI).

  • Curious about how systems fit together, and confident asking engineers about data models, APIs and integrations.

  • Comfortable working to direction and a set playbook, and knowing when to flag an issue rather than guess.

  • Meticulous and organised, with a strong eye for detail and data accuracy.

  • Clear communicator who can explain data to non-technical people.

Nice to have

  • Exposure to pricing, contracts or billing data.

  • Experience in background screening, HR tech, RegTech or another regulated industry.

  • Familiarity with ATS/HRIS platforms (e.g. Workday, SuccessFactors, Greenhouse, Bullhorn).

  • Working knowledge of GDPR, data residency and audit requirements.

  • Python for data cleansing and automation, or experience using AI tools to speed up analysis.

  • Previous exposure to an acquisition or post-merger integration.

We are an all-remote organisation with ~200+ people spread across the world. We value Trust, Integrity, Data and Experience in everything we do - from the way we collaborate to the products we create.

We’re focused on transforming the industry while partnering with many of the leading technology platforms in the People & Talent ecosystem.

And we’re growing fast. Having recently been ranked in Deloitte’s Tech Fast 50 for the second year running, we’re looking for brilliant people, fast thinkers and passionate change-drivers to join our expanding team.

Veremark is a remote-first HR tech scale-up on a mission to help the world trust faster.

We started with background and reference checking, pioneering an entirely new approach through Verepass - a blockchain solution which facilitates instant verification by enabling candidates to own, manage, and share their securely-held and verified career credentials.

We have recently launched our second product - a Whistleblowing platform with end-to-end encryption enabling employees to report issues safely and anonymously.

But this is just the beginning. Join us and become part of the journey using technology to help the world trust faster.

Job Description:

Advance your career while impacting our national security in cyber as Microsoft Purview SME (Records Management) at GDIT. Here, technologists have many paths to grow a meaningful career supporting cyber missions and operations across the federal government.

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT

As a Microsoft Purview SME, the work you’ll do at GDIT will be impactful to the mission of our customer. You will play a crucial role in designing, implementing, and optimizing electronic records management solutions using Microsoft Purview within the enterprise. This role ensures compliance with federal records management laws, supports lifecycle management of records, and drives adoption of best practices for retention, disposition, and information protection across Microsoft 365 environments.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED

  • Bachelor's Degree or experience in lieu of degree, and 10+ years of relevant experience
  • Deep expertise in Microsoft Purview, Microsoft 365, and Azure AD, with hands-on experience configuring records management, compliance, and security solutions.

  • Experience with role-based access controls, policy development, and audit processes.
  • Familiarity with e-discovery, litigation hold, and information protection modules.

Key Responsibilities

  • Records Management Solution Design: Architect and configure Microsoft Purview Records Management solutions, including retention labels, file plans, and adaptive scopes for SharePoint, Exchange, OneDrive, and Teams.
  • Compliance & Governance: Ensure records management processes comply with federal laws (e.g., NARA, 44 U.S.C.), AmeriCorps policies, and organizational directives. Support audits and reporting requirements.
  • Lifecycle Management: Oversee the creation, maintenance, preservation, and disposition of records. Implement retention schedules and monitor compliance with disposition standards.
  • Role-Based Access & Security: Assign and manage Purview roles (Records Manager, Disposition Reviewer, Compliance Administrator, Information Protection Analyst, etc.) to ensure secure access and proper segregation of duties.
  • Policy Development: Draft and maintain electronic records management policies, procedures, and standard operating guidelines. Update documentation as systems and regulations evolve.
  • Training & Awareness: Develop and deliver records management training for staff, including onboarding, annual compliance, and specialized guidance for senior leaders and records coordinators.
  • E-Discovery & Litigation Hold: Support e-discovery case management, litigation hold labeling, and audit logs for sensitive data. Collaborate with legal and compliance teams as needed.
  • Data Loss Prevention & Information Protection: Configure and monitor DLP policies, sensitivity labels, and security alerts to protect records and sensitive information across multi-cloud platforms.
  • Continuous Improvement: Lead pilot tests, evaluate new features, and recommend enhancements to records management solutions. Analyze metrics and feedback to drive operational excellence.

GDIT IS YOUR PLACE

At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do.

  • Flexibility: Full-flex work week to own your priorities at work and at home

Healthcare Administrator

Work Schedule: AU Business Hours

Salary: PHP 55,000-65,000

Location: Remote (Work from Home, Philippines)

Employment Type: Full-Time Remote Contractor

We are seeking an experienced remote Healthcare Administrator to provide essential behind-the-scenes patient and billing administrative support across both Sydney allied health clinics. Working closely with the Practice Manager and Founder, you will serve as a dedicated extension of the on-site front desk team.

In this role, you will take ownership of patient communications, inbox management, diary rebooking, and invoicing, allowing the on-site team to focus fully on in-clinic patient care. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in Cliniko practice management software and a solid understanding of the Australian healthcare system and funding framewor

Requirements

Patient Communication & Inbox Management

  • Manage clinic email inboxes and patient messaging, responding promptly and professionally in alignment with clinic policies.
  • Process rebookings, rescheduling, and cancellations to maintain full and accurate practitioner diaries across both clinic locations.
  • Proactively follow up with patients regarding missed appointments, outstanding forms, and referral paperwork.
  • Answer and return phone calls as needed (for candidates with strong spoken English).

Billing, Invoicing & Claims Management

  • Prepare and issue accurate patient invoices, keep account records updated, and follow up on outstanding balances.
  • Facilitate billing and claim workflows for private health funds (HICAPS), Medicare (EPC plans), WorkCover, CTP, and DVA, ensuring all necessary documentation is complete.
  • Audit billing details and ensure proper item numbers and fee schedules are applied before dispatching invoices.

Cliniko Administration & Reporting

  • Maintain and update Cliniko system settings, including fee schedules, billable items, pricing, and appointment types.
  • Generate and distribute regular operational reports (e.g., revenue, appointment volume, and billing summaries) for leadership.
  • Organize and maintain patient medical records, referrals, and administrative documents while adhering strictly to privacy and data security standards.

Operational Support

  • Relieve on-site front desk staff of routine back-office administrative tasks.
  • Execute additional administrative duties as assigned by the Practice Manager.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Cliniko Expertise: Direct, hands-on experience managing Cliniko, including setup and maintenance of billable items, pricing, appointment types, and reporting features.
  • Healthcare Admin Experience: Proven background in client communication and administration within an Australian clinic setting (preferably allied health, physiotherapy, or medical practices).
  • Funding Scheme Knowledge: Working understanding of Australian healthcare funding models, including HICAPS/private health funds, Medicare (EPC referrals), WorkCover, CTP, and DVA.
  • Administrative Skills: Demonstrated capability in managing patient email inboxes, complex diary rescheduling, and invoicing workflows.
  • English Proficiency: Exceptional written English skills with a warm, empathetic, and professional communication style.
  • Shift Availability: Must be fully available to work a split-shift schedule during Sydney business hours from the Philippines.

Preferred:

  • Confident spoken English capabilities for direct patient phone contact and call handling.
  • Current or recent experience working directly with an Australian healthcare clinic.
  • Familiarity with VOIP phone systems, call routing, and live call transfers.
  • General proficiency with related operational platforms such as Xero, Microsoft 365, or Google Workspace.

The Associate role is a high-impact position designed for individuals looking to accelerate their career in legal sales. As an Associate, you will be responsible for driving the initial stages of the sales cycle, from outbound prospecting to closing trial accounts. This role serves as a critical talent pipeline, with a structured 12-24 month path toward promotion to Sales Director (SD).

What You'll Do

  • Execute outbound prospecting strategies to identify and engage new legal firm leads — including cold calling and self-sourcing your own meetings.

  • Manage and close inbound leads to maintain a healthy sales pipeline.

  • Own a full-cycle, transactional sales process from first touch to close, aggressively following up on open pipeline to keep deals moving and get them across the finish line.

  • Lead trial closing efforts, ensuring a seamless transition from initial interest to platform adoption.

  • Consistently meet success KPIs, including call volume, transaction counts, and trial starts, to qualify for promotion.

Who You Are

  • An extremely self-motivated hunter who takes ownership of their pipeline and doesn't wait to be handed opportunities.

  • A proactive and highly organized professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment.

  • A collaborative people person who builds strong internal and external rapport.

  • Adaptable and capable of working effectively in a decentralized or physically remote setting.

  • Ambitious and goal-oriented, with a clear desire to grow into a Sales Director (Account Executive) role.

What We're Looking For

  • Prior experience in a fast-paced transactional sales organization, ideally as a top performing SDR/BDR, or SMB AE.

  • Comfort and confidence picking up the phone — cold calling is core to this role, not a fallback.

  • A true hunter mentality: someone who proactively books their own meetings rather than relying solely on inbound or marketing-sourced leads.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to lead client meetings confidently.

  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and follow-through.

  • Collaborative mindset with experience working cross-functionally across sales and customer-facing teams.

Comp & Perks

  • Competitive compensation package with uncapped incentive compensation.

  • Full benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with match.

  • Clear career growth opportunity.

Expert Institute is the nation's leading expert consulting and insights platform, helping plaintiff firms win more cases and increase their profitability. Established in 2010, Expert Institute has supported over 5,000 firms nationwide across all areas of practice.

We connect litigators with top industry experts, innovative litigation research, physician consultations, and comprehensive due diligence — all delivered through our SaaS platform, Expert iQ. Leveraging proprietary data and analytics, we give plaintiff firms a winning edge.

raw.description:
The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this principal development role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month, based on experience level and gross amount. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience

About the Role:

We are seeking a hands-on, high-impact Senior Security Engineer, Detection & Response, to strengthen security operations at Sezzle: detection, incident response, and vulnerability management across our cloud infrastructure and applications.

You will join the team that runs our SIEM and detection capability — from log ingestion and audit coverage to detection rules, alert tuning, and investigation workflows — so that access to sensitive systems is attributable and suspicious activity is caught and attributed by our own detections. You will operate the vulnerability-management loop end-to-end, and when incidents happen, you will lead the investigation and see the long-term fix through. You should consider yourself a DOer - someone who is comfortable diving into logs, analyzing systems, validating findings, and working end-to-end to get issues resolved.

You will report to the Director of Information Security and work alongside the engineers who own the security platform and network and zero trust — your detection and response work is what proves their controls hold. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and wants to work on real-world security problems at scale. At Sezzle, AI-assisted engineering is a standard part of how we work. In this role you will use and build agentic workflows for alert triage, investigation, and threat hunting that multiply what the team can cover.

What You’ll Do:

  • Build, operate, and mature SIEM/XDR capabilities, including log ingestion, detection rule development, alert tuning, and investigation workflows
  • Design and implement detection strategies for suspicious activity, including data exfiltration patterns using application and database telemetry
  • Extend audit and attribution coverage across the estate — Kubernetes audit logs, database audit logging, SSO and access-path telemetry — so access to sensitive data is attributable to a person or workload, with retention aligned to compliance requirements
  • Investigate and respond to security incidents across cloud infrastructure and applications, performing root cause analysis and driving long-term fixes
  • Run proactive threat hunts across cloud and identity planes, building agentic hunting workflows that make hunts repeatable
  • Operate vulnerability management across infrastructure, platforms, and applications - including internal scans, dependency analysis, and external findings, validating true positives and driving remediation with engineering teams
  • Triage and validate external security findings (including bug bounty reports), distinguishing true positives and coordinating remediation
  • Contribute to threat modeling and security design reviews for the detection, logging, and incident-response implications of new systems
  • Apply strong AWS and Kubernetes judgment to secure the systems you operate and advise owning teams on remediation
  • Support and implement security controls aligned with PCI DSS, SOC 2, and other compliance requirements — with your logging and detection work producing the audit evidence as a by-product
  • Develop and implement automation (including AI) to improve efficiency in security operations, detection, and response
  • Participate in the on-call rotation for detection and response and the services you own

What We Look For:

  • 6+ years of experience in security, software, or infrastructure engineering, with hands-on experience securing cloud-based production systems and working with real-world security challenges
  • Experience working with SIEM platforms (e.g., Wazuh, Splunk, ELK) for detection engineering, monitoring, and incident response
  • Experience designing and tuning detection rules, reducing alert noise, and improving investigation workflows
  • Strong hands-on experience in vulnerability management — scanning, triage and validation of scanner and bug-bounty findings, remediation coordination, and verification
  • Strong knowledge of AWS, Linux, and Kubernetes infrastructure, including security architecture and operational best practices
  • Ability to investigate issues directly using logs, cloud tooling, and system-level data
  • Experience assessing the detection and logging implications of new systems in design reviews
  • Knowledge of common security vulnerabilities and mitigation strategies (OWASP, SANS, etc.)
  • Working knowledge of compliance frameworks such as PCI DSS and SOC 2, particularly logging, monitoring, and evidence expectations
  • Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your work today, and have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • You have built AI-assisted workflows that others adopted — triage, enrichment, or hunting
  • Familiarity with log-based detection, telemetry pipelines, and security analytics use cases
  • Experience with internal penetration testing or adversarial exercises, and translating results into detection and remediation work
  • Strong understanding of cloud-native security controls, including IAM, network segmentation, and container security
  • Experience with container and dependency security tools (e.g., Snyk, Trivy, Grype) as an operator of their findings
  • Experience aligning technical security work with regulatory and compliance expectations
  • Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated environments

About You:

  • You think like an investigator - you turn telemetry into detections and detections into answers, and you are not done until the root cause is fixed.
  • You treat attribution as an engineering deliverable - every access to sensitive data has a name on it, and every finding has an owner and a date.
  • You are excited to use automation and emerging technologies (including AI) to take repetitive security work off the team's plate
  • You balance strong security standards with business needs and can support privacy and compliance requirements in a practical, scalable way
  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit tests
  • Open Source: Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.
