Title: Executive Assistant & Legal Operations Manager

Location: Remote

Job Type: Full-time

Compensation: $90,000 - $120,000 annually, DOE

About the Role:

The Executive Assistant & Legal Operations Manager is responsible for supporting the firm's day-to-day administrative and operational functions. This position will oversee legal technology and software systems, maintain required business registrations and insurance coverage, and provide administrative support related to recruiting and employee management.

The role requires a highly organized and detail-oriented individual who can manage multiple areas of responsibility, monitor important deadlines and renewals, and ensure that operational needs are addressed in a timely and efficient manner. This role will also directly support the firm's managing partner.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities
  • Manage and maintain the firm's software platforms and technology accounts, including Clio, Westlaw, and other legal technology systems
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for software accounts, including account administration, renewals, user access, and coordination with vendors as needed
  • Manage the firm's Registered Agent relationship and maintain related records and documentation
  • Monitor business insurance policies and ensure required coverage, including malpractice/professional liability insurance, remains current
  • Track insurance renewal dates and coordinate with insurance providers or brokers as needed
  • Maintain accurate records related to licenses, registrations, insurance, and other firm requirements
  • Provide administrative support throughout the recruiting process, including coordinating interviews, communicating with candidates, and assisting with hiring activities
  • Support employee onboarding and offboarding processes
  • Assist with day-to-day employee administration and employee-related needs
  • Support the firm in managing employee turnover, including coordinating necessary administrative and operational tasks
  • Maintain organized employee and operational records
  • Coordinate with firm leadership on administrative and operational matters
  • Identify and address operational needs proactively and ensure follow-through on outstanding items
  • Perform other administrative and operational duties as needed to support the firm and managing partner

Position-Specific Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience working in a law firm or professional services environment (preferred)
  • Familiarity with legal technology platforms, particularly Clio and Westlaw (preferred)
  • Communicate effectively and promptly to clients or employees of the organization.
  • Ability to work overtime occasionally at the last minute.

Requirements

  • Prior experience in office management, legal operations, business operations, or a similar administrative role
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, renewals, and administrative processes
  • Strong follow-through and ability to work independently
  • Professional written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to handle confidential employee and business information appropriately
  • Comfortable working across a variety of operational, administrative, and employee-related responsibilities
  • Proactive approach to identifying and resolving administrative and operational needs
  • Proficient interpersonal relations and communicative skills
  • Write routine reports and correspondence.
  • Meet daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly and other deadlines consistently.
  • Work under pressure with changing, ambiguous priorities.

Benefits

Medical, Dental, Vision, 401k, Flex PTO

Why Join Us? At Ottinger Law Firm, you’ll work on high-profile, impactful cases while collaborating with passionate attorneys who value integrity, expertise, and results. We offer a challenging yet rewarding environment where your work directly contributes to protecting employee rights and shaping the landscape of employment law.

Company Overview The Ottinger Law Firm, P.C. is a leading advocate for employees and executives, specializing in workplace disputes such as wrongful termination, discriminatory practices, wage and hour violations, and executive compensation matters. With offices in New York City and California, our firm is known for achieving significant settlements and verdicts, including cases involving top-tier organizations. If you are passionate about protecting employee rights and making a real impact, this is your chance to join a team with a proven record of success in labor and employment law.

POSITION PURPOSE

Responsible for scheduling, pre-registering patients for outpatient radiology exams. Electronically verifying insurance eligibility & accurately identifying & collecting patient financial responsibility. This is a key position that begins the overall patient experience and initiates the billing process for any services provided by the hospital.


As a mission-driven innovative health organization, we will become the national leader in improving the health of our communities and each person we serve. By demonstrating reverence, commitment to those who are poor, justice, stewardship, and integrity, our organization will continue to provide better health, better care, at lower costs.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Responsible for pre-registration, scheduling, electronically verifying insurance eligibility & accurately identifying & collecting patient financial responsibility. Handles complex scheduled events, including high dollar testing, associated studies & those with study specific instructions & communicates effectively to service delivery areas to maximize patient flow & customer service. Begins the overall patient experience & initiate the billing process for any services provided by the hospital.


Analyzes patient insurance(s), identifies the correct insurance plan, selects appropriately from HIS insurance and plan selections and documents correct insurance order. Applies recurring visit processing according to protocol.


Verifies patient information with third party payers. Collects insurance referrals and documents within HIS. Collects and documents Medicare Secondary Payer Questionnaire (MSPQ) and obtains information from the patient if third party payers need to be billed (i.e., worker's compensation, motor vehicle accidents and any other applicable payer).


Maintains operational knowledge of regulatory requirements and guidelines as outlined in the hospital and department Compliance Plans. Ensures Meaningful Use requirements are met as appropriate.


Screens all patients self-pay & out of network patients using approved technology. Provides information for follow up and referral to the RHM Medicaid Vendor and/or Financial Counselor as appropriate. Initiates payment plans and obtains payment. Incorporates point of service (POS) collection processes into daily functions.

Other duties as assigned by manager.

High School Diploma or equivalent.

Two (2) to Five (5) years experience in area of expertise such as scheduling, financial clearance, or patient access.
National certification in HFMA CRCR or NAHAM CHAA required within one (1) year of hire.
Must be proficient in the use of Patient Registration/Patient Accounting systems & related software systems.

raw.excerpt: About CIRThe Centre for Information Resilience (CIR) is an independent organisation dedicated to exposing human rights violations and threats to democracy.
raw.description:
About CIR

The Centre for Information Resilience (CIR) is an independent organisation dedicated to exposing human rights violations and threats to democracy. We achieve this through open source research, digital investigations, capacity-building with local partners, and collaboration with media to amplify our impact.

CIR was born out of a determination to expose those spreading harm – online and offline – around the world, particularly in areas of violent conflict, such as Ukraine, Sudan and Myanmar. Our projects are at the forefront of efforts to investigate and document human rights abuses, war crimes, harms targeting women and minorities, and influence operations. We work closely with multilateral and national justice accountability bodies.

Role details:

Contract Type: Contractor

Closing date: 26th October 2026 at 23:55pm

Contract length:  ASAP until 31st March 2027

Hours needed for this role:  Full time, average 19 days a month

Location: Remote

Languages: You must be able to work proficiently in Arabic (Sudanese Dialect is highly desirable).

About the Project

CIR specialises in rigorous, ethical, and impact-driven research on technology-facilitated gender-based violence (TFGBV), sexual and gender-based violence (SGBV), and conflict-related sexual violence (CRSV), translating evidence into accountability, advocacy, and practical interventions.

CIR’s Sudan Witness project is seeking to recruit an open-source investigator with experience in conducting analysis of online hate speech, primarily in Arabic in the context of Sudan. CIR specialises in rigorous, ethical, and impact-driven research on technology-facilitated gender-based violence (TFGBV), sexual and gender-based violence (SGBV), and conflict-related sexual violence (CRSV), translating evidence into accountability, advocacy, and practical interventions. Candidates with particular experience or expertise on gendered hate speech (TFGBV), who will be well placed to contribute to this work will be considered favourably.

Main Responsibilities

  • Employ open-source intelligence (OSINT) and social media analysis (SOCMINT) tools, techniques, and methodologies to conduct research into the Sudanese information environment.
  • Use SOCMINT tools to conduct audience analysis and gather audience insight.
  • Analysing and documenting evidence of Ethnic and Gendered Hate speech, Coordinated Inauthentic Behaviour and other violations of platform terms and conditions and standards.
  • Contribute to CIR’s ongoing investigations into how gender and identity are exploited on social media in relation to ongoing conflict in Sudan and other conflict contexts.
  • Contribute to the project's day-to-day monitoring, archiving and verification of open-source information.
  • Input information into the project’s databases and code that data to pre-set information fields as required. Ensure that all data is preserved and archived according to project standards.
  • Work with other investigators to analyse data from multiple sources and create comprehensive analytical reports on hate speech, trends, and dynamics.
  • Support the design and production of high-quality reports that effectively explain insights and the evidence and methodology underpinning them.

Requirements

Essential Criteria:

  • You must be able to work proficiently in Arabic (Sudanese Dialect is highly desirable).
  • Experience with open-source intelligence (OSINT) and social media analysis (SOCMINT) tools and techniques, including social media monitoring, narrative analysis, stakeholder and network mapping.
  • Experience in collecting and verification of documenting evidence of Ethnic and Gendered Hate speech, Coordinated Inauthentic Behaviour and other violations of platform terms and conditions and standards.
  • Prior experience conducting OSINT research on Sudan and/or East Africa.
  • Ability to work independently, including time management and prioritisation of tasks.

Recruitment Process

To apply, please submit your CV and complete the application form questions. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to interview, which can be conducted remotely unless specified otherwise.

CIR is an equal opportunities employer. If you require adjustments or additional support to complete this process, please let us know in your application.

A candidate’s guide to artificial intelligence (AI) in recruitment at CIR

CIR does not use artificial intelligence (AI) or automated decision-making tools at any stage of its recruitment process. All applications are reviewed, and decisions are made, by trained members of staff.

When applying for a role, please do use AI for:

  • Plan your ideas and thoughts
  • Check the spelling and grammar of your CV and cover letter
  • Research CIR
  • Generate mock interview questions for you to practice before your interview
  • Use AI as a support tool, not as a substitute for your own thinking or judgement

Don’t use AI to

  • Invent or misrepresent your skills and experience
  • Complete any tests provided by CIR
  • Assist you during an interview to help answer the questions being asked by the panel

Declaration: By submitting this application, you confirm this represents your own work and experience. Misuse of AI may result in your application being withdrawn from the process.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

The company is an OnchainGPT for autonomous trading. It is an AI-powered mentor, advisor, and companion that helps users explore the onchain world, find alpha, auto-trade, and outsmart the market.
They are looking for Staff Software Engineer (Backend and AI Infra) who will own two critical workstreams :
- the agent runtime and backend infrastructure that powers every trade in their fleet,
- and the migration of model hosting and agent deployment in-house, moving the company off third-party LLM providers and hosted agent platforms to own infrastructure.
NOTE : This role is NOT a pure Devops role but rather a building role in which you will spend 80% of your time writing Go, Python, and TypeScript that ships to production.
You’re writing the backend services, runtime engine, and deployment systems that the entire company's agent fleet runs on.
When you ship, every agent in the fleet immediately gets faster, more reliable, and more autonomous.
You are in charge of managing the very infrastructure you are building, as its designer you are be the best person to operate it.
You’re building the backend for autonomous AI agents that manage real money in real time.
The runtime you build determines whether positions are protected.
The model hosting you stand up determines whether agents can think.
The deployment pipeline you create determines whether the fleet can evolve.
This is foundational infrastructure for a new category of software.
MISSIONS
Agent Runtime & Backend (+/-50%)
The runtime is the engine that makes every agent work. You’ll own the core systems:
Plugin Runtime — the per-agent process that runs position tracking (10s polling), the RatchetStop exit engine (tiered trailing stops with sub-second evaluation), and DSL state management. Currently Go + Python; migrating to a centralized Go service with Postgres state and real-time websocket price feeds
Scanner Gateway / Rules Engine — a YAML-configurable evaluation layer that sits between scanners and execution. Scanners produce raw signal variables; the rules engine applies gates, scoring, and filters defined in YAML. Users customize trading behavior without touching Python. This is the next major runtime feature
RatchetStop Backend — centralized profit-trailing service that protects positions even when the agent is offline. Evaluates tier upgrades and places stop-loss orders on Hyperliquid via websocket, replacing per-agent polling with condition-based evaluation across all positions
Execution Layer — the MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that bridges agents to the company's 48+ platform tools: position creation, clearinghouse state, market data, Smart Money intelligence. You’ll own auth, rate limiting, and the contract between agents and the exchange
Data Layer — enriched Hyperfeed pipeline (top 1K trader positions, momentum events, market concentration) flowing through Redis, Postgres, and ClickHouse. Real-time ingestion, 4-hour rolling windows, and the APIs that every scanner calls
Model & Agent Hosting Migration (+/-30%)
The company is moving off third-party hosted agents and external LLM inference to the company's owned infrastructure. You’ll lead the technical execution:
Agent deployment platform — migrate agents from Railway/OpenClaw to own-hosted infrastructure. Each agent needs isolated workspace, cron scheduling, state persistence, MCP connectivity, and Telegram notifications. Target: deploy any skill from a GitHub repo with one command
Model hosting — evaluate and implement the path from external LLM APIs (Anthropic, Google) to self-hosted inference. Options range from proxied external models with full telemetry capture, to fine-tuned models running on own GPUs. You’ll own the decision and execution
Agent telemetry — capture every scanner evaluation, every trade decision, every signal score across all agents. This data feeds the self-reinforcing loop: agents learn from fleet-wide performance, fork winning strategies, and improve autonomously
Deployment pipeline — CI/CD for shipping scanner updates, runtime patches, and skill configs to 50+ live agents without interrupting open positions. Zero-downtime rollouts where downtime = unprotected capital
Infrastructure & Operations (+/- 20%)
Build monitoring and alerting that catches agent failures, orphaned positions, state corruption, and Auth expiration before they cost money
Manage cloud infrastructure (AWS/EKS) with infrastructure-as-code
Own incident response — in a trading system, every minute of downtime is real dollars at risk
Health monitoring for the agent fleet: which agents are scanning, which are stuck, which have the midnight rollover bug

Requirements

MANDATORY
  • Strong backend engineering — you write production code daily in at least two of: Go, Python, Node.js/TypeScript. Go being the preferred language for the runtime services
  • Experience building backend services from scratch at a startup: APIs, job scheduling, state management, distributed systems
  • Solid understanding of real-time systems where latency matters: websocket connections, condition-based evaluation, sub-second response requirements
  • Production experience with Postgres, Redis, and at least one analytics DB (ClickHouse, TimescaleDB, BigQuery)
  • Kubernetes experience — deploying, scaling, and debugging production workloads on AWS EKS
  • You’ve owned a system end-to-end: designed it, built it, deployed it, operated it, fixed it at 3am
STRONG PLUS
  • Experience with model serving / LLM infrastructure — deploying, scaling, and optimizing inference (vLLM, TGI, TensorRT-LLM, or managed endpoints)
  • Background in trading systems, exchange APIs, or fintech where uptime has direct financial consequences
  • Experience with onchain infrastructure: wallet operations, RPC nodes, transaction monitoring, DEX integration
  • Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar agent-to-tool connectivity patterns
  • Experience building multi-agent platforms — orchestrating many independent processes sharing infrastructure but operating autonomously

raw.title: VP, Engineering
raw.excerpt: What We’re BuildingHoneycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do!
raw.description:
What We’re Building

Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We’re working with well known companies like HelloFresh, Slack, LaunchDarkly, and Vanguard and more across a range of industries. This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023!
If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb.io press releases.

Who We Are

We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers.

How We Work

We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1.

Little more about the team:

AI is changing how software gets built, shipped, and run. It is increasing the need for sense-making of production software systems. We believe AI will reshape observability itself. Honeycomb created this category, and we want our next engineering leader to help us lead its reinvention.

The role

You’ll join the executive team as a full partner in setting strategy. Our exec team acts as a first team, working closely together to revise our strategy as the world changes. Right now, it is changing often! You’ll bring a wealth of experience and an imagination of what’s possible, help sharpen our bets, and decide with your peers the most elegant way forward. Then you’ll shape a strong engineering org to deliver on these decisions.

What you’ll do

  • Shape the strategy. Form your own view of where the product, technology and market are heading. Bring it to your closest partners: product and the CEO, and to the wider exec team. Some of our bets will need sharpening, and some new ones will need making.
  • Build alignment at the top. We believe our strength as a company depends on the strength of our exec team. We want you to make our exec team better, and for your first team to be the exec team. You’ll work closely with product and the CEO, challenging and being challenged in return, until the team is truly committed to a shared direction.
  • Help the whole org to make sense of fast change. When the ground moves quickly, people need help understanding what is changing and why. Burnout is high in our industry, and we want to keep our people motivated, excited to come to work, and with their full creativity and energy. You’ll explain engineering’s direction clearly and repeatedly, to engineers, managers, the exec team, and the rest of the company. We’re remote-first, so much of this happens in writing and in presentations.
  • Lead a high-performing team into what’s next. We have strong managers, directors, and ICs. You’ll aim that talent at our biggest opportunities and adjust the org’s structure, goals, and ways of working to be continually more effective. You’ll do this without losing what makes the team great.
  • Lead from technical credibility. You can’t lead an AI era shift without a deep understanding of the ergonomics of the landslide of change underway.

You might be a fit if

  • You’ve led engineering through large scale changes in direction, not just growth.
  • You’ve shipped software with AI tools yourself within the last 12 months.
  • You have a special talent for collaboration and improving executive teams.
  • You’re as interested in shaping strategy as in executing it.
  • You’ve worked at a larger company, and know what breaks as companies scale. But have a risk tolerance of someone from an early stage startup.
  • You’re comfortable with uncertainty, rapid change, and shaping new bets towards product-market fit.
  • You’ve led distributed teams and communicate well in writing and in person.
  • You care about developer tools and have good taste in them. (Having used Honeycomb is a bonus, not a requirement)
  • You share our values.

Worth reading: How we do business at Honeycomb in the AI era, our AI norms and values, and why engineering is all in on AI.

If you match some of this but not all of it, please apply anyway. We’d rather talk to a strong candidate who doubts themselves than miss them.

What you'll get when you join the Hive:

  • A stake in our success - generous equity with employee-friendly stock program
  • It’s not about how strong of a negotiator you are - our pay is based on transparent levels relative to experience
  • Time to recharge with unlimited PTO
  • A distributed-first mindset and culture (really!)
  • Home office, co-working, and internet stipend
  • Full benefits coverage for employees, with additional coverage available for dependents
  • Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave, regardless of path to parenthood
  • Annual development allowance
  • And much more...
Please note we cannot currently sponsor or support visa transfers at this time. Additionally, in compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work.

Phishing and Recruitment Scam Warning:

We take your security seriously. Please be aware that recruitment scams are increasingly common and scammers may create email addresses or websites to impersonate Honeycomb employees. To help protect you:
  • All communications will come from an @honeycomb.io email address
    • We occasionally work with external recruiting agencies. These partners will use legitimate business email addresses—never personal accounts like Gmail or Yahoo.
  • Our recruiting process will never ask you to provide financial or sensitive personal information, including but not limited to:
    • Social security or tax identification numbers
    • Credit card numbers
    • Bank account information

Diversity & Accommodations:

We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace—where people of all backgrounds, identities, experiences, and abilities are welcomed, valued, and supported. We recognize that there is no single path to success and embrace nontraditional career journeys and diverse perspectives as key to building stronger, more innovative teams.
We strive to ensure an inclusive experience throughout every stage of our hiring process and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations as needed. If you require accommodations or accessible formats at any point during our hiring process, please let your recruiter know.
As an equal opportunity employer our hiring process is designed to put you at ease and help you show your best work. If there’s anything we can do to improve your experience, we’re always open to feedback.

Privacy Notice:

If you apply for a job at Honeycomb and your application is unsuccessful (or you withdraw from the process or decline our offer), Honeycomb will retain your information after your application for a period of time in accordance with local laws. We retain this information for various reasons, including in case we face a legal challenge in respect of a recruitment decision, to consider you for other current or future jobs at Honeycomb, and to help us better understand, analyze and improve our recruitment processes.
For more information regarding our privacy practices please see the Honeycomb Privacy Notice.
If you do not want us to retain your information, or want us to update it, please contact . Please note, however, that we may retain some information if required by law or as necessary to protect ourselves from legal claims.

Job Title: Manager - Veeva Batch Release Strategy - Europe

Job Location: Zürich, Switzerland

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva Batch Release helps life sciences companies modernize the decision to release a batch by connecting the quality, manufacturing, laboratory, document, and enterprise resource planning (ERP) information needed for disposition. In this European Strategy role, you will work with customers, partners, and Veeva teams to shape how the market understands and adopts the application. This is a highly customer-facing role for someone who combines regulated-manufacturing knowledge with experience turning complex processes into practical software, services, and field strategies.

What You'll Do

    • Lead strategic discovery with European life sciences customers to understand their batch-disposition process, systems landscape, release bottlenecks, stakeholder model, and business case for change
    • Work with account teams to advance priority customers from working-level interest to senior-sponsored engagement and a clear next step
    • Act as the European domain lead, helping Sales, Strategy, Solution Consulting, Services, Product, Marketing, and partners understand how quality, manufacturing, laboratory, document, and ERP processes come together in release
    • Turn customer, partner, and market learning into clear product, services, implementation, and field recommendations
    • Build reusable European enablement, including discovery guides, stakeholder maps, account-entry plays, and positioning across ERP, manufacturing execution, laboratory, quality, and document systems
    • Develop relationships with systems integrators, consultancies, advisory partners, and industry organizations, and represent Veeva in customer meetings, executive discussions, webinars, and industry events

Requirements

    • 10+ years of combined experience in life sciences manufacturing, quality, or related enterprise software and consulting
    • Direct working knowledge of batch disposition or release and the regulated manufacturing evidence and stakeholders behind the decision
    • Experience translating manufacturing or quality processes into customer-facing software, consulting, implementation, or transformation programs
    • Senior customer-facing experience in strategy, solution consulting, implementation advisory, enterprise software, or management consulting
    • The judgment and presence to lead substantive conversations with Quality, Manufacturing, Qualified Person or release, IT, and executive stakeholders
    • Working knowledge of SAP or another ERP platform and several of manufacturing execution, laboratory, quality, document, and integration systems
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn complex processes into clear recommendations and reusable field material
    • Ability to travel within Europe and occasionally globally for customer meetings, internal workshops, and industry events

Nice to Have

    • Direct responsibility for batch disposition, Qualified Person certification, or release-process ownership
    • Experience with SAP Batch Release Hub, TrackWise, Veeva Vault Quality, or comparable manufacturing and quality platforms
    • Relationships with European systems integrators, consultancies, advisory firms, or organizations such as ISPE; or experience with external or contract manufacturing networks where release evidence crosses company and system boundaries

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A personality assessment
        3. A practical case exercise
        4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Work Anywhere
    • Flexible paid time off
    • An annual budget for health and wellness programs

The ideal candidate is relationship driven, self-motivated, and committed to delivering informed risk management advice and exceptional customer service while contributing to the long-term growth and success of the organization.

  • Drive profitable growth within an assigned territory through prospecting, referrals, networking, and community engagement.
  • Educate producers on crop insurance programs, products, and risk management strategies tailored to their operations.

  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships and earn customer trust.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

In this role, you will contribute to the strategic direction of the business and support impactful mission outcomes as the MSTR Application Lead at GDIT. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:
As the MicroStrategy (MSTR) Application Lead, your work will be pivotal to the mission of the WTCHP. You will guide the design, development, integration, optimization, and operational readiness of the MSTR environment and the analytics capabilities supporting Third Party Administrator (TPA) core services.

raw.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Android BSP Engineer to join a long-term international engineering project focused on the development of next-generation embedded Android/Linux platforms for advanced professional products used worldwide.

As part of the firmware engineering team, you’ll work on sophisticated control systems, digital media, and unified communications solutions deployed in conference rooms, classrooms, auditoriums, home offices, and enterprise environments. These are real, commercially deployed products where platform performance, multimedia quality, reliability, and hardware/software integration truly matter.

Work Deep Inside the Android Platform

This is not typical Android application development. You’ll work close to the hardware and deep within the Android platform, contributing to BSP development, platform integration, optimization, debugging, and system-level problem solving.

You’ll investigate problems that rarely have simple answers—working across multiple layers of the system to understand what is happening, why it is happening, and how to solve it properly.

Real Engineering Ownership

You’ll work directly with real hardware and real product environments, collaborating with experienced hardware, firmware, Android, Linux, and application engineers across multiple countries.

Your contribution will go beyond implementing predefined tasks. We value engineers who can analyze complex technical problems, propose solutions, make sound engineering decisions, and take ownership from investigation through implementation and validation.

You’ll also have the opportunity to exchange knowledge with highly experienced engineers and deepen your expertise across Android internals, BSP development, embedded Linux, multimedia, and hardware/software integration.

Why This Project?

If you enjoy bringing up hardware, debugging across the Android stack, optimizing complex embedded systems, and solving the difficult problems that sit between hardware and software, this is an opportunity to work on technically challenging products while continuing to grow as a senior Android platform engineer.

Required Expertise

Must have

  • 8+ years of proven experience developing, customizing, and debugging embedded software / firmware for Linux and/or Android-based products.
  • Strong programming skills in C/C++ within embedded or system-level development environments.
  • Hands-on experience with Embedded Linux development on ARM-based platforms, including configuration, build, deployment, hardware interfaces, and platform bring-up.
  • Experience with Linux Kernel, U-Boot, Device Tree, and low-level platform customization.
  • Practical experience with device driver development, optimization, troubleshooting, bug fixing, and adding new functionality for areas such as display, power management, Wi-Fi, GPIO, or other hardware interfaces.
  • Hands-on experience with Android HAL and the ability to debug issues across the Android Framework and Linux Kernel layers.
  • Good understanding of AOSP architecture and Android platform development workflows.
  • Strong understanding of recent Android versions, features, APIs, and changes, preferably Android 14 or later.
  • Experience working with source control and Android development tools such as Git, Gerrit, GitHub, ADB, and Fastboot.
  • Ability to debug embedded systems where traditional step debugging may be limited or unavailable.
  • Ability to independently read and understand electrical schematics and collaborate effectively with hardware engineering teams.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, ownership mindset, and ability to work independently in a complex technical environment.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in an international engineering setting.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Android framework services, Android Native applications using JNI/NDK, or Android system applications written in Java or Kotlin.
  • Experience with hardware-accelerated graphics processing, especially OpenGL ES.
  • Experience with Camera, Display, Media, power management, or connectivity-related subsystems in embedded Android/Linux products.
  • Experience with scripting or automation using Bash or Python.
  • A degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field would be an advantage.

 Expected Deliverables and Areas of Contribution

  • Participate in the full software development lifecycle for new and existing embedded Android/Linux-based products — from design and development to testing, debugging, release support, and maintenance.
  • Design, develop, and maintain embedded software and platform-level components using C/C++ in close cooperation with software and hardware engineering teams.
  • Work with Embedded Linux and Android BSP areas, including platform configuration, hardware interfaces, device drivers, and support for new device features.
  • Contribute to the development of next-generation control system, digital media, and unified communications products used in real enterprise environments.
  • Investigate and resolve system-level issues across Android/Linux software layers, working on troubleshooting, debugging, performance improvements, and bug fixing.
  • Support integration between software applications, hardware components, connected devices, and control systems to ensure stable product behavior.
  • Support field escalations for new and legacy products by analyzing issues and contributing to long-term product reliability.
  • Prepare and maintain clear technical documentation, including test procedures, design notes, troubleshooting information, and implementation details.

Jabil Inc. partners with experienced independent professionals who contribute their expertise to international engineering projects. Let’s together create, innovate, and solve meaningful technical challenges for world-leading brands.

Engagement highlights:

  • Opportunity to support engineering projects delivered for market-leading global brands.
  • Long-term project engagement with clearly defined technical objectives.
  • Engage based on a B2B basis as an independent contractor who retains discretion over the manner, time, and place of service delivery (remote cooperation model), subject to project requirements and agreed deliverables, giving you flexibility in how and where you work.
  • Collaboration with international engineering stakeholders and highly experienced specialists across different countries.
  • Exposure to modern technologies and complex engineering challenges across embedded systems and Android platforms.
  • The chance to influence technical decisions and contribute your knowledge to products used globally.

Dir/Sr Dir, Strategy & Delivery (Gen Med - Rare Disease - US and/or Canada)

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

Therapeutic Area Expertise: Rheumatology, Dermatology, Rare General Medicine Diseases, Nephrology, Gastroenterology (GI).


JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and execute study and customer engagement strategies that align with customer objectives, partnering with Business Development and Medical Strategy to secure new business and support account growth.
  • Lead pre-award activities for assigned opportunities, including account planning, proposal strategy, proposal development, and Bid Defense Meetings.
    • Build strong cross-functional partnerships with Business Development, Medical Strategy, and operational teams to develop competitive, customer-focused solutions.
    • Lead proposal development, ensuring strategic alignment, operational feasibility, and financial accuracy.
    • Lead Bid Defense Meetings, preparing and coaching cross-functional teams to deliver compelling customer presentations.
  • Ensure seamless transition from pre-award through study execution by aligning proposal commitments with operational delivery plans.
  • Lead and develop high-performing cross-functional teams, fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Develop trusted customer and internal stakeholder relationships, proactively managing risks and resolving issues to support successful outcomes.
  • Ensure successful delivery across assigned studies, meeting scope, timelines, quality, regulatory, and financial expectations while maintaining strong customer satisfaction.
  • Manage financial performance across assigned opportunities, ensuring accurate forecasting, disciplined budget management, and effective change order execution.
  • Promote quality, compliance, and continuous improvement through consistent application of governance, risk management, and best practices.
    • Adheres to all enterprise policies, work instructions, standard operating procedures, and project plans. Adheres to customer policies and standard operating procedures, as required in project plans.
    • Maintains in-depth knowledge of FDA and worldwide drug development regulations and national and ICH Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines.
    • Demonstrates strong strategic judgment and accountability, independently leading complex customer opportunities with minimal oversight.
    • Develops high-quality study strategies and delivery plans that align scientific, operational, financial, and customer objectives.
    • Builds trusted relationships with customers and cross-functional stakeholders through consistent execution, proactive communication, and sound decision-making
    • Successfully balances competing priorities, manages risk, and delivers projects to scope, quality, timeline, and financial expectations.
    • Creates an environment of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement while contributing to the development of peers and project teams.

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

  • Requires a degree in the life sciences, nursing degree, or equivalent education or equivalent related experience, plus extensive clinical research experience in a contract research organization, pharmaceutical, or biotechnology company
  • Deep knowledge of global drug development and regulatory requirements, with ability to translate into effective delivery strategies
  • Strong understanding of therapeutic landscapes and industry trends to support customer engagement and business growth coupled with demonstrated therapeutic area depth.
  • Proven leadership in complex, matrixed environments, driving high-performing, cross-functional teams
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead customer interactions
  • Demonstrated operational and financial acumen across multiple programs, including prioritization, forecasting, and delivery execution
  • Customer-focused with strong problem-solving capability in dynamic, fast-paced environments
  • High level of organizational discipline and attention to detail, ensuring quality and compliant delivery
  • Proficient in core business tools; fluent in English; willingness to travel (~25%)

At  Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality-of-life balance. The benefits for this position may include a company car or car allowance, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, eligibility to participate in Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and individual performance, and flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

Salary Range:

$134,400.00 - $306,500.00

The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Additional Information

raw.description:
Job Description

At Blue Cross NC, we recognize the dedication, discipline, and leadership that transitioning service members bring to the workforce. Through our DoW SkillBridge Program, we provide a unique opportunity for military personnel in their final months of service to gain hands-on experience in a civilian work environment while exploring meaningful career paths in the healthcare industry.

By joining Blue Cross NC’s SkillBridge Program, service members can deploy their leadership, problem-solving skills, and mission-driven mindset in a civilian setting. This internship provides a bridge between military service and a meaningful career in healthcare, allowing participants to continue their tradition of service—this time, by helping make healthcare better for all.

We are honored to support transitioning military professionals as they navigate this next chapter and invite you to explore how your skills can make a difference at Blue Cross NC.

**This program is open to only active military service members.**


  • Develop and execute strategic military and veteran-focused initiatives that advance Blue Cross NC's brand, business objectives, member outreach, retention efforts, and community impact. Strategies will include improving access to healthcare, behavioral health resources, benefits education, and social determinants of health for active-duty service members, veterans, and military families.
  • Collaborate with County Engagement teams and cross-functional business units to implement community-informed strategies that primarily support Healthy Blue, Blue Cross NC’s Medicaid plan.
  • Build and maintain relationships with military installations, Veteran Service Organizations (VSOs), Military Service Organizations (MSOs), Veteran Service Officers, healthcare providers, community-based organizations, and government agencies to expand Blue Cross NC's reach and impact.
  • Identify and implement opportunities for education and outreach initiatives focused on healthcare access, behavioral health, chronic disease prevention, food insecurity, housing stability, and other priority issues affecting military and veteran populations.
  • Lead and support military community events, Veteran Stand Downs, benefits education seminars, health screenings, wellness initiatives, and evidence-based training programs that connect individuals to healthcare resources and Blue Cross NC products and services.
  • Collaborate with Public Health, Faith-Based, Tribal and Regional Liaisons, and other business-facing divisions to ensure coordinated engagement strategies that maximize community impact and support organizational goals.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on military and veteran community needs, emerging healthcare trends, and barriers to care, providing recommendations to improve outreach, engagement, and member experience.
  • Lead, train and support County Engagement teammates and community partners, fostering a high-performing team committed to serving military-connected populations across North Carolina.
  • Communicate program activities, partnership outcomes, community insights, and measurable impacts through regular reporting, presentations, and internal communication channels.
  • Manage military engagement projects, programs, policies, and procedures, ensuring deliverables, strategic objectives, compliance requirements, and performance measures are successfully achieved.
  • Evaluate community needs and partnership opportunities to develop sustainable, long-term initiatives that strengthen trust within the military community while supporting Blue Cross NC's mission and business objectives.

Eligibility Requirements:

  • Applicants must be active-duty service members within their last 180 days of service at the time of internship start.
  • Participants must receive approval from their commanding officer and service branch to engage in SkillBridge. Blue Cross NC does not determine eligibility for participation.
  • A minimum of 12 weeks of commitment is required for internship placement at Blue Cross NC.
  • Candidates must have a clear end-of-service date that aligns with the internship timeline.
  • For more information visit DoW Skillbridge.

Internship Placement & Selection:

  • Internship placement is not guaranteed and is based on available learning/training opportunities and the alignment of the service member’s skills and interests with organizational needs.
  • Selected candidates will undergo a formal interview process to determine fit for available roles.
  • Internships are unpaid and intended for training purposes only, with no guarantee of post-program employment.
  • Participation is contingent upon approval from the service member's commanding officer and is not determined by Blue Cross NC.
  • Note: To be eligible for full-time employment at Blue Cross NC, individuals must reside and work in one of the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Wisconsin, or Wyoming.

Application Process:

  • Interested applicants must submit a current resume outlining military and civilian experience.
  • Command and service branch approval documentation (if available).
  • A statement of interest or cover letter describing career goals and SkillBridge program objectives.
  • Final selection is contingent upon Blue Cross NC’s internal review and business need alignment.

Program Compliance:

  • The Blue Cross NC SkillBridge Program is conducted in accordance with Department of War (DoW) policies, guidance, and regulations. Participation is subject to DoW approval, and all service members must adhere to applicable program requirements throughout their internship.

Additional Considerations

  • Service members are responsible for their own housing, transportation, and living expenses during the internship.
  • Participation in the internship does not imply a future employment offer but provides valuable industry experience.
  • Interns must adhere to all company policies and professional conduct standards throughout the program.

For additional questions or support regarding the Blue Cross NC SkillBridge Program, please email .

Salary Range

At Blue Cross NC, we take great pride in a fair and equitable compensation package that reflects market-price and our starting salaries are typically planned near the middle of the range listed. Compensation decisions are driven by factors including experience and training, specialized skill sets, licensure and certifications and other business and organizational needs. Our base salary is part of a robust Total Rewards package that includes an Annual Incentive Bonus*, 401(k) with employer match, Paid Time Off (PTO), and competitive health benefits and wellness programs.

*Based on annual corporate goal achievement and individual performance.

Skills

Our hiring process does not include text-based conversations or interviews and never requires payment or fees from job applicants. All our career opportunities are published on . raw.description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

About the Role

Product Security is responsible for ensuring the continuous security of Harness customer-facing products and internal tools. The team is focused on proactively discovering security weaknesses, driving and advising risk remediation, building a paved road for developers to adopt secure development practices, and developing partnerships with engineering and product teams to accelerate the release of software with security by design.

The Senior Product Security Engineer is a highly skilled practitioner who drives hands-on security work across the Harness platform. You will own technical security initiatives end-to-end, partner closely with engineering and product teams to identify and remediate vulnerabilities, and build tooling and processes that elevate the security bar across our development lifecycle. This role is for engineers who love to build, break, and secure complex systems.

What You Will Do

  • Design and develop product security APIs, tools, and utilities for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Conduct threat modeling and secure design reviews for application backend services and business integrations.
  • Perform advanced penetration tests and adversarial attack simulations against Harness modules, APIs, and codebase using industry-standard frameworks.
  • Lead manual and automated code review efforts to discover vulnerabilities, weaknesses, and anti-patterns in the Harness platform.
  • Implement and operate security tooling including SAST, DAST, and SCA, and integrate these into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Consult and advise developers and Product Managers on security standards, vulnerability remediation, and security architecture.
  • Assess risks and trade-offs, and propose solutions for product security features such as authentication and authorization.
  • Participate in the creation, review, and implementation of technical security standards across global engineering teams.
  • Use the Harness platform to integrate security processes like vulnerability management into the SDLC.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering and Product to accelerate the release of software with security by design.

About You

  • BS in Computer Science or a related degree.
  • 5+ years of relevant industry experience with a strong security focus.
  • Solid experience with DevSecOps practices and secure SDLC methodologies.
  • Good working knowledge of cyber security frameworks including OWASP, SANS, NIST, and CIS.
  • Ability to describe software supply chain risks and Secure SDLC best practices.
  • Experience with public or private cloud environments such as K8s, AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Professional knowledge of enterprise applications, API development, and modern software delivery processes.
  • Previous experience in a cloud-native environment.
  • Proficiency in Java or a comparable language and object-oriented programming methodology.
  • Hands-on experience with security testing tools and vulnerability management workflows.
Pay transparency
$150,000—$200,000 USD

  • How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal

We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.

raw.excerpt: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility About UsWe are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies.
raw.description:
Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of iOS development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior iOS App Developer with an excellent background in native iOS development using Swift and SwiftUI, together with practical experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into iOS applications.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our iOS application, integrate shared application logic, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development.

Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build mobile applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our native iOS application using Swift and SwiftUI.
  • Integrate Kotlin Multiplatform modules into the iOS application and collaborate on shared business logic.
  • Implement platform-specific functionality while maintaining consistent behavior across iOS and Android.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical iOS challenges such as permissions, application lifecycle, background execution, battery consumption, and device compatibility.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and investigate issues that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and clear explanations.
  • Support application signing, release preparation, and distribution through TestFlight and the App Store.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production iOS applications.
  • Excellent practical knowledge of Swift, SwiftUI, and the iOS development ecosystem.
  • Practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and its integration into native iOS applications.
  • Solid understanding of application architecture, asynchronous programming, lifecycle management, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills across application code, shared modules, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain technical decisions.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, geofencing, and sensor data.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and proximity detection.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Interoperability between Swift and Kotlin Multiplatform, including asynchronous operations and error handling.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful iOS development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing and releasing iOS applications.
  • Your experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into native iOS projects.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, App Store references, or GitHub links are welcome where available.

raw.title: Head of Revenue Operations
raw.excerpt: About TiugoTiugo is the company behind CKEditor, TinyMCE, Uploadcare and ButterCMS, developer tools that power rich content creation inside thousands of applications and across the Fortune 1000.
raw.description:
About Tiugo

Tiugo is the company behind CKEditor, TinyMCE, Uploadcare and ButterCMS, developer tools that power rich content creation inside thousands of applications and across the Fortune 1000. Formed in 2021 and backed by PSG, we have grown through acquisition into a ~$60M ARR business with strong gross and net retention and Rule of 60 performance.

We run two motions at once: a developer-led, product-led motion at high volume, and sales-led motion with a growing enterprise model built around our AI content platform. Our next chapter depends on running both well, across multiple brands, with one set of numbers everybody trusts.

Why this role exists now

Over the next eighteen months we are layering an enterprise, AI-led motion on top of an inbound Sales Assist motion and a product-led engine, across four brands with four histories and four stacks. That demands a revenue operations function that designs the engine rather than maintains it. One that owns how a customer moves from first touch through renewal, how we measure it, how we equip the field to run it, and how we automate the parts that should not need a human. The clearest example is renewals: moving the long tail to a tech-touch motion where people manage by exception, designed hand in hand with our Customer Success leaders. We are deliberately not backfilling the role as it existed. This is a bigger job, and we are hiring for the version of it we need in FY27.

In place today: a RevOps team; standardized stage and data definitions across instances; a weekly forecast cadence; a self-service channel; a central data warehouse.

What you'll build: field enablement, a deal desk, GTM engineering, a scaled tech-touch renewal motion, and real business analysis.

What you will own

  • The revenue engine's architecture. In close collaboration with the CRO and Sales & CS leaders, design the end-to-end customer journey across self-service and sales-assisted motions: segmentation, coverage, routing, lifecycle stages, and the handoffs between marketing, sales, customer success and partners.

  • Sales, customer success and partner operations. A single operations function serving the whole revenue motion. One funnel, one definition set, one system of record. This covers every Tiugo brand, and you decide where standardization pays off and where a lighter touch is right. Marketing operations sits today within Growth Marketing and works closely with this role on the shared funnel. As the function matures, bringing the two closer together is a path we'll consider.

  • Planning and performance cadence. Territory and coverage design, quota setting, capacity and productivity modeling, and the forecast process and its discipline. You design the incentive plans; Finance administers and pays them.

  • Deal desk. A function that works inside the deal cycle alongside our sellers, helping shape deal structure and pricing approach on enterprise and AI deals, and moving those deals through legal, finance and security review without losing momentum. It also brings together the sales support work that keeps deals moving, such as quoting. Finance and Legal keep their approval authority; this role owns the path to it. You will define how the function operates as part of building it.

  • Field enablement. Onboarding and ramp, sales methodology, and product and AI fluency across the field. This is a build rather than a maintain, and you will hire the leader for it.

  • GTM engineering and applied AI. In collaboration with a central AI team, own Revenue Organization automation across the revenue lifecycle and internal AI applications pointed at go-to-market work.

  • Business analysis for the revenue engine. Not report production, but interpretation. Monitoring what the business is actually doing, diagnosing what changed and why, and turning that into recommendations the revenue leadership team acts on. You will partner closely with our central data and analytics group, who own metric definitions, pipelines, governed dashboards and data quality. They own what is true. You own what it means and what we do about it.

Your first twelve months

By the end of year one, we should be able to say:

  • The revenue leadership team is making decisions from analysis you surfaced before anyone asked for it

  • Coverage, segmentation and routing are designed, documented and actually followed across brands

  • Forecast accuracy is materially better, and the process is trusted enough that it is not relitigated every month

  • Deal desk is a competitive advantage on enterprise deals rather than a bottleneck

  • An enablement function exists, is staffed, and the field can carry a credible AI conversation without escalating

  • Meaningful, measurable revenue work is automated, returning hours to sellers rather than producing slideware

Who you are

  • 10+ years in revenue or go-to-market operations, with 5+ leading the function at a B2B SaaS company between roughly $30M and $150M ARR

  • You have run operations for a business with both a product-led and a sales-assisted motion, and you understand why the two rarely share definitions cleanly

  • Deep Salesforce fluency, plus real command of the surrounding stack: forecasting, quote-to-cash, marketing automation, BI and billing

  • Genuinely technical with data. Opinionated about data models, and able to hold your own with a data engineering team

  • You have deployed AI operationally inside a go-to-market org and can tell the difference between what worked and what demoed well

  • You have built functions rather than inherited them, and hired people better than you into them

  • Comfortable in a globally distributed, multi-brand business where standardization is a negotiation rather than a mandate

How we will know it is working

Forecast accuracy. Pipeline coverage and conversion by stage and motion. Sales cycle and time to first value. Rep productivity and ramp time. Quote turnaround and deal desk cycle time. Time from question to trustworthy answer. Hours of manual revenue work eliminated.

How this role works with others

We are explicit about lanes, because ambiguity here is expensive. Some of your key partners will be:

  • Sales & CS leaders: they own their number, their teams and customer relationships, and what the customer journey should be: which signals matter and what coverage they need. This role is a key collaborator on customer journey design, and owns turning that into the operating model: coverage and capacity modeling, process design, data structures, automation, and the forecast cadence.

  • Operations (Data & Analytics): they ownthe corporate data warehouse and pipelines, company-wide metric definitions, governed corporate reporting, and enterprise systems such as billing. This role owns the GTM stack and everything in it, including Salesforce and Gong, revenue analysis, diagnosis and action. Requirements for how billing and other enterprise systems support the revenue process

  • Central AI team (forming): they own AI platform, governance and data access policy. This role owns which revenue workflows get automated, and building them within that governance.

  • Marketing: they own demand creation, campaign strategy, positioning and brand. Marketing operations, including marketing automation and campaign execution, sits in Growth Marketing today. This role owns shared funnel definitions, lead routing into sales, and attribution mechanics, in close partnership with marketing operations.

  • Finance: they own the model, plan administration and payout calculation. Rep-facing on questions about calculations of payout amounts and timing. This role owns quota and incentive design, and sales results reports for Finance to use in commission calcs. You are rep-facing on plan questions and crediting.

  • Product and Engineering: they own the roadmap decision. This role owns bringing structured go-to-market signal into prioritization.

Why Join Tiugo

Our people are a huge part of what makes Tiugo a great place to work! Aside from an impactful role working in great team, some of our benefits include:

  • Extra paid leave and dedicated funds to pursue personal development (up to 5 days and $1500 a year based on tenure)

  • Competitive medical, retirement and PTO benefits

  • Fully remote work environment

  • Access to a mental health and wellbeing platform with 24/7 dedicated psychological support, and targeted programs to promote wellness

We are seeking a dynamic, mission-driven Developer Relations Manager to engage leading university-affiliated researchers and labs. In this role, you will work directly with researchers to accelerate the adoption of NVIDIA’s sophisticated AI and computing platforms.


The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong experience in research engagement and proven track record to translate advanced technologies into valuable, insight-focused outcomes.

What you'll be doing:

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor for research labs, engaging and partnering with ecosystem leaders, identifying and accelerating high-impact workloads by integrating NVIDIA's frameworks, libraries, and core software stack into research projects.
  • Map and continuously assess the research ecosystem to identify institutional growth opportunities and inform long-term technology strategies.
  • Stay current on research papers across affiliated domains to anticipate emerging trends and provide technical direction on future collaboration areas.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Research Account Managers, Solution Architects, and Business Development teams to drive researcher enablement
  • Forge closer ties with lab personnel, understanding opportunities, challenges, interpersonal dynamics and the full scope of research being conducted.
  • Attend domain scientific conferences and facilitate NVIDIA participation alongside other subject matter experts. Drive success stories into adoption
  • Represent the needs of researchers internally by translating academic feedback into actionable insights that build product development, education programs, and platform roadmaps.

What we need to see:

  • PhD in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, Computational Science or a related technical field; or equivalent experience demonstrating comparable research depth.
  • Over 4+ years of experience in research or industry, with a proven record of advancing innovation at the crossroads of AI and Science.
  • Deep expertise in applying AI, including Generative AI and Physical AI, to a specific scientific domain is required. A broad intellectual foundation is also necessary to translate AI breakthroughs across fields such as Biology, Physics, material science and complex scientific workflows.
  • Strong understanding of frontier research challenges in AI and computational science.
  • Hands-on experience building or evaluating AI systems using modern frameworks, model APIs, orchestration tools, retrieval systems, sandboxed execution for research-grade deployment.
  • Established research credibility evidenced by high-impact publications, contributions to open-source scientific software, or successful collaborations with academic laboratories.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Track record translating frontier research into demos, reference architectures, workshops, technical content, or developer enablement programs.
  • Experience presenting at academic conferences, research workshops, technical summits, or university facing events.
  • Ability to identify emerging research trends and convert them into strategic opportunities for collaboration, platform adoption, and ecosystem growth.
