raw.excerpt: About the teamThe Public Cloud Foundations (PCF) team is part of Platform Engineering.
raw.description:
About the team

The Public Cloud Foundations (PCF) team is part of Platform Engineering. We build the internal cloud platform that every Zillow engineer builds on: the self-service APIs, paved paths, and automation that turn the raw complexity of AWS into a small set of safe, reliable, well-documented product surfaces.

We treat the platform as a product. Rather than handling cloud infrastructure as a queue of tickets and one-off requests, we design software that lets teams provision accounts, networking, and shared infrastructure themselves, safe by default. Our current work shows the direction: self-service VPC connectivity, a Terraform delivery platform, container base images delivered as a managed product, and provisioning and policy capabilities exposed as APIs instead of runbooks. We partner closely with Runtime Platform, Database Engineering, Middleware Engineering, Delivery Engineering, and Security to replace manual cloud work with software.

PCF is where you help decide how Zillow uses the public cloud, and how a platform team turns operational surface area into engineered products.

About the role

As a Senior Software Development Engineer on Public Cloud Foundations, you will build the services and APIs that abstract away the complexity of the public cloud, and own them as products from design through operation.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and APIs that make cloud capabilities self-service: account provisioning, networking, IAM, and policy exposed as clean software interfaces rather than tickets or manual processes.

  • Turn recurring cloud work into products. Take patterns that today depend on human judgment or hand-run runbooks and encode them into APIs, controls, and automation that are safe by default.

  • Treat teams across Zillow as the customers of your platform: understand their use cases, shape the interfaces and paved paths they build on, and let their feedback and usage data drive your roadmap.

  • Own the reliability of what you build. Design for observability, SLOs, and self-healing so the platform runs itself. Like any team that owns services in production, you'll be on call for what you ship, and you'll lead the follow-up work that removes whole classes of problems rather than patching individual incidents.

  • Use modern AI-assisted and agentic tooling to accelerate design, implementation, and operations while keeping quality and safety high.

  • Influence how Platform Engineering approaches public cloud enablement, bringing a product mindset to design discussions and roadmap decisions.

You'll help take a set of foundational capabilities and turn them into a cohesive, self-service platform that Zillow engineers experience as a product, not a queue.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $160,900.00 - $257,100.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $152,900.00 - $244,300.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

You're a senior engineer who wants to build platforms, not just run them. You like taking messy, manual infrastructure work and turning it into clean software that other engineers build on, and you care about the developer experience of what you ship.

You'll bring:

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating backend or platform services in production.

  • Solid system design skills for distributed systems and API-based platforms, with a practical approach to simplicity, resiliency, and observability.

  • Production experience in Golang or Python (preferred), or another modern language, with solid testing, code review, and debugging habits.

  • Strong experience with at least one public cloud provider (preferably AWS) and its core primitives such as VPCs, subnets, routing, load balancers, security groups, IAM, compute, and storage, deep enough to abstract them behind clean interfaces.

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code such as Terraform, structured as reusable, tested software rather than copy-paste configuration, including reviewing changes for safety and managing drift.

  • Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals, e.g., IAM, network segmentation, encryption, and policy enforcement in multi-account environments.

  • Hands-on experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Argo) for infrastructure and/or backend services.

  • A bias toward eliminating toil in software: when you see repeated manual work, your instinct is to build the system that makes it unnecessary.

Nice to have:

  • Experience building or contributing to internal platforms or developer tooling (account vending, golden paths, self-service provisioning, or similar).

  • Experience treating an internal platform as a product: defining interfaces, measuring adoption, and iterating on developer experience.

  • Familiarity with service-to-service networking, service mesh, workload identity, or rate limiting in cloud environments.

  • Strong Linux systems and networking fundamentals.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help customers navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company that's reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the country. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.

raw.excerpt: About the Role The Azul Sales Engineer is a hands-on, deeply technical pre-sales leader responsible for delivering the technical win across opportunities within their territory.
raw.description:
About the Role

The Azul Sales Engineer is a hands-on, deeply technical pre-sales leader responsible for delivering the technical win across opportunities within their territory. Azul sells to the most demanding Java estates in the world — enterprises running mission-critical, high-throughput, latency-sensitive applications on the JVM — so this role demands genuine engineering depth, not just presentation polish.

A Sales Engineer earns credibility with engineers, architects, and executives alike by getting hands on: running technical evaluations in the customer’s own environment, tuning the JVM, interpreting GC and performance data, and translating measurable technical outcomes into clear business value. Beyond individual deals, the Sales Engineer uses their experience to mentor and uplevel the broader SE team.

What You'll Do (aka Responsibilities)

  • Own the technical win. Drive pre-sales engagements end to end — discovery of the prospect’s business and technical challenges, mapping Azul portfolio capabilities to those challenges, and validating the solution through demonstration and hands-on proof.
  • Lead hands-on pilots. Design, scope, and personally execute product pilots and proofs-of-concept inside the customer’s existing environment: installing and configuring the JVM, running representative workloads, and capturing empirical results the customer trusts.
  • Prove performance. Plan and run performance-focused engagements: establish benchmarks and success criteria, measure latency, throughput, GC pause behavior and resource efficiency, analyze GC and JIT logs, tune JVM settings, and quantify the improvement Azul delivers against the incumbent.
  • Win at enterprise scale. Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise engagements (large production estates, strict SLAs, security and compliance review, and long procurement cycles) coordinating technical validation across many teams and environments.
  • Present at every altitude. Deliver presentations and demos across all technical levels, from CxOs to hands-on developers, to “make the complex simple” and communicate Azul’s value to each audience.
  • Respond to technical requirements. Understand and respond to solicited and unsolicited proposals (RFI/RFP) by aligning Azul capabilities against detailed technical and business requirements.
  • Orchestrate the extended team. Engage Product Management, Engineering, and the CTO office as needed to remove technical blockers and secure the win.
  • Partner on territory strategy. Work alongside your Account Executive(s) on territory planning: pipeline generation, growing existing accounts, and enabling partners.
  • Grow and retain customers. Nurture existing clients to promote customer success and to create new upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
  • Evangelize. Present at conferences, workshops, and roadshows to raise awareness of the Azul portfolio and build funnel.
  • Mentor the team. Provide expert assistance to other SEs on pilot planning and execution, run training sessions, and serve as a primary mentor to onboarding SEs.
  • Be a trusted advisor. Advise your manager on product, territory, and team matters.

Technical Competencies

    These are the core technical strengths that define a successful Sales Engineer at Azul:

  • Java & the JVM. Deep, hands-on knowledge of Java internals and the JVM: class loading, JIT compilation, memory model, and garbage collection. Able to read and reason about GC logs and runtime behavior, not just describe them.
  • Performance engineering. Practical experience benchmarking, profiling, and tuning JVM-based applications for latency, throughput, and scale; comfortable diagnosing GC pauses, warm-up, jitter, and resource-efficiency issues in production-like conditions.
  • Hands-on aptitude. Confident on the command line and in customer environments: installing, configuring, and troubleshooting runtimes; able to build and run a POC independently.
  • Enterprise application stacks. Solid understanding of Java-based applications and frameworks that run on or alongside Azul products (e.g., Cassandra, Kafka, Solr, Spring).
  • Cloud & containers. Working knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and container/orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Portfolio SME. Demonstrate SME-level depth and breadth across the entire Azul product suite, and continuously grow technical acumen through enablement, hands-on experimentation, and self-study.

What You'll Bring

    Qualifications

  • 5+ years in a Sales Engineering / pre-sales role supporting enterprise software, ideally in the Java, middleware, performance, or infrastructure space.
  • 3+ years of hands-on Java development or testing experience with a demonstrable command of Java architecture.
  • Proven track record of hands-on pilots and POCs and of performance-related engagements where you measured and demonstrated technical results in a customer environment.
  • Experience selling into large enterprises — complex, multi-stakeholder, mission-critical production environments.
  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related IT discipline; a master’s or higher in an IT or business discipline is a plus.
  • Working knowledge of cloud and container technologies (e.g., AWS, Docker/Kubernetes).
  • Solid knowledge of sales process and CRM (MEDDICC and Salesforce preferred).
  • Willing and able to travel up to 30%.
  • Fluent in your territory’s primary language, with strong professional English.

    • Skills & Attributes

  • Strong oral and written communication, effective one-on-one and in front of large groups.
  • Proven critical-thinking and problem-solving skills; able to solve complex technical challenges with minimal supervision.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, with excellent time management.
  • Highly professional and ethical.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment and can multitask across client challenges, meetings, and team needs, occasionally outside normal business hours.
  • Collaborates across disciplines, with the EQ to understand multiple perspectives toward a common goal.
  • A proven winning record.

What we Offer

·Comprehensive compensation and healthcare packages
·Referral Program
·Work-life balance, remote-first, paid time off, company shutdown, holidays
·Work with top experts worldwide whom contribute to the Java ecosystem

Our Culture & Values

·Maniacal Customer Focus
·Innovation & Excellence
·Initiative & Courage
·Impact & Influence
·Integrity & Transparency
·Diversity, Inclusion & Teamwork

raw.description:
Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of mobile development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile App Developer with strong Kotlin Multiplatform expertise and an excellent background in native Android development with Kotlin.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our application, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development. Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build Android applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our Android application using Kotlin and Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Design shared application logic and integrate it with platform-specific functionality.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical mobile challenges such as permissions, background execution, battery consumption, connectivity, and differences between devices.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and resolve problems that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and understandable explanations.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production Android applications with Kotlin.
  • Strong practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform, including shared code, platform-specific integrations, and the boundaries between them.
  • Solid understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack Compose, coroutines, Flow, application lifecycle, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills and the ability to investigate problems across application code, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain why an implementation is appropriate.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, sensor data, and proximity detection.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and signal-strength limitations.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful mobile development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing Android applications and Kotlin Multiplatform solutions.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio or GitHub links are welcome where available.

Olo is a leading SaaS platform accelerating digital transformation in the restaurant industry, by helping customers deliver more personalised and profitable guest experiences. As a result, our digital ordering, payment, loyalty and guest engagement solutions enable brands to do more with less and make every guest feel like a regular.

While our roots are in NYC, we’re intentionally investing in Belfast and Northern Ireland as a key hub, with an established leadership presence, a local team, and community for the long term. This role is fully remote, offering you flexibility to work from anywhere within NI.

Your new role

In this role, you’ll join as a Software Engineer on the ‘Core’ team, which is part of the wider ‘Order Engineering’ group.

The Core team owns key parts of Olo’s platform, including baskets, orders, checkout, promotions, capacity management, and the services that power ordering experiences at scale. We build and maintain the APIs, services, and tools that brands and partners rely on to create reliable, flexible, and high-performing digital ordering experiences.

As a Software Engineer on this growing team, you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of these systems. You’ll help guide technical decisions, improve platform reliability and scalability, contribute hands-on code, and mentor other engineers. This is an opportunity to have meaningful influence across a broad and business-critical area of the platform while helping evolve the architecture for the next stage of growth.

On a management level, the team is led by a dedicated Engineering Manager who is based in Northern Ireland.

How you’ll make an impact

    • Develop an understanding of the ‘Core’ team's domain and technology stack and actively seek guidance to grow technical expertise.

    • Handle small-to-medium features with support from more senior engineers, ensuring tasks are completed according to set timelines.

    • Write code adhering to established coding standards and participate in code reviews to learn best practices.

    • Collaborate with team members to understand feature requirements and implement solutions with guidance.

    • Focus on building reliable and maintainable software components, contributing to team deliverables with a focus on quality.

    • Utilise version control systems to manage code changes and maintain a consistent development workflow.

    • Participate in team meetings and sprint ceremonies, such as daily stand-ups and sprint retrospectives, contributing updates and feedback.

    • Engage in learning activities, including game days and training sessions, to build familiarity with the company's tools and processes.

    • Troubleshoot and debug issues with guidance, learning to identify and resolve common software bugs.

    • Demonstrate a willingness to collaborate with other engineers and stakeholders, developing teamwork skills necessary for larger projects.

    • Demonstrate ownership of the team's delivery pipeline, ensuring that code quality, testing standards, and deployment practices are continuously optimised.

    • Use Claude Code and GitHub Copilot extensively as part of your daily workflow, and grow your skills through hands-on AI training designed to help you become highly effective with modern AI coding agents and IDEs.

    • Active participation in on-call duties is required, with specific responsibilities determined by your assigned team and area of expertise.

What will set you up for success

    • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

    • At least 1.5 years of experience in a software engineering role.

    • Programming Skills: Proficient in C#/.Net and familiar with basic programming constructs and design patterns.

    • Version Control Systems: Basic understanding of version control tools (e.g., GitHub) and how to use them for source code management.

    • Unit Testing: Familiarity with writing unit tests to validate small software components and test-driven development frameworks (e.g., NUnit, Jest).

    • Distributed Systems Fundamentals: Basic understanding of how distributed systems work, focusing on building reliable components.

    • Collaboration Tools: Experience using collaboration platforms for development, such as Jira, Confluence, and GitHub.

About Olo

Olo is a leading restaurant technology provider with ordering, payment, and guest engagement solutions that help brands increase orders, streamline operations, and improve the guest experience. Each day, Olo processes millions of orders on its open SaaS platform, gathering the right data from each touchpoint into a single source—so restaurants can better understand and better serve every guest on every channel, every time. Over 800 restaurant brands trust Olo and its network of more than 400 integration partners to innovate on behalf of the restaurant community, accelerating technology’s positive impact and creating a world where every restaurant guest feels like a regular. raw.description:
About MoonPay

Hi, we’re MoonPay. We’re here to onboard the world to the decentralized economy by making digital money move as universally and effortlessly as the internet.

Why?

Because crypto, stablecoins and blockchain aren’t just technologies. They’re tools for global financial empowerment. They give people and businesses more control over their money, their digital assets, and their future, opening access to legacy financial systems that have been out of reach for many.

What we do

MoonPay is a unified payments platform for digital currency. We make it easy for anyone, anywhere, to buy, sell, swap and pay in digital currencies as easy as sending an email. That simplicity is intentional, our focus is reducing complexity so people can participate confidently, without needing to be crypto experts. We power the entire flow between fiat and crypto end to end, with compliance, identity checks, fraud prevention, and settlement all built in. This end-to-end approach reflects how we work internally: with accountability, rigor, and trust built into everything we ship.

Proven at scale

Trusted by over 30 million customers and over 500 ecosystem partners, our secure, enterprise-grade platform is driving mainstream crypto adoption worldwide. Behind those numbers are millions of real people and organizations relying on MoonPay every day.
We collaborate with innovative brands and projects to build secure, scalable solutions for a blockchain-powered future. This is an opportunity to help shape systems, not just scale them. And we’re committed to doing it right. Fully licensed in the U.S. and regulated across the UK, EU, Canada, and Australia, because trust and compliance are non-negotiable.
But we’re just getting started. We’ve launched a consumer app that makes crypto accessible, intuitive, and usable for everyone, and it’s growing fast. We’re iterating every day to make it the best it can be.
If you believe financial freedom should be for everyone. If you believe in building a fairer, more open financial system - we want you with us. To build systems that benefit all, we need contributions from all, regardless of background.
Come build the future of payments and the decentralized economy with MoonPay. Let’s make financial freedom and autonomy the new normal.

Locations Supported 🌍

  • India (Bangalore) - EU hour coverage

Relocation available: No

Work pattern:

  • This role is remote until we have an office set up in Bengaluru. This role requires weekend and shift work, depending on business needs.

About the Opportunity

We’re looking for a Team Lead, Trust & Safety Operations to lead MoonPay’s Bangalore-based Trust & Safety Ops analyst team across Fraud Operations and Disputes / Chargebacks workflows.

In this role, you will be responsible for leading a team of Trust & Safety Analysts, ensuring operational excellence across fraud alerts, transaction monitoring, manual reviews, disputes handling, chargebacks, and escalations. You will own team performance, coaching, process maturity, operational execution, and continuous improvement - while partnering closely with the Quality Analyst to improve decision quality, consistency, and standards across the team.

Your work will directly impact fraud prevention, chargeback rates, customer experience, operational quality, SLA performance, and the scalability of MoonPay’s Trust & Safety function.

This is a great opportunity for someone who is not only strong at running high-performing BAU operations, but who also brings structure, urgency, curiosity, and strategic thinking. We’re looking for someone who proactively identifies problems, brings solutions, uses data to drive improvements, and is comfortable leveraging AI and automation tools to make operations smarter, faster, and more effective.

What You Will Do

  • Lead and coach a team of Trust & Safety Analysts across Fraud Operations and Disputes workflows.

  • Own daily operational performance across fraud alerts, transaction monitoring, manual reviews, disputes, escalations, productivity, quality, and SLA adherence.

  • Act as the senior operational escalation point for complex cases, ensuring decisions are timely, consistent, and risk-based.

  • Drive high standards of communication, structure, and follow-through across the team, ensuring priorities, risks, escalations, and decisions are clearly documented and communicated.

  • Partner closely with the L2 Analysts to improve decision quality, run calibration sessions, identify knowledge gaps, and ensure analysts are aligned with internal policies, risk frameworks, and card network rules.

  • Use QA insights, operational data, case trends, and analyst performance data to coach the team, improve playbooks, and strengthen decision-making across fraud and disputes workflows.

  • Identify fraud and chargeback trends, operational bottlenecks, control gaps, and emerging risks, then turn these insights into clear action plans and measurable improvements.

  • Lead strategic initiatives across Trust & Safety Ops, including process redesign, workflow optimisation, playbook development, tooling improvements, automation opportunities, and AI-enabled operational enhancements.

  • Collaborate with other teams to improve fraud controls, dispute outcomes, customer experience, and operational scalability.

  • Create a high-accountability team culture where ownership, responsiveness, operational discipline, and proactive problem-solving are the standard.

About You

Must-have experience and skills

  • 4-5+ years of people management experience leading analyst teams in Trust & Safety, Fraud Operations, Risk Operations, Payments Operations, Disputes, Chargebacks, or a similar high-risk operational environment.

  • Strong hands-on experience across both transaction monitoring / fraud alerts and disputes / chargebacks workflows.

  • Deep understanding of fraud typologies such as account takeover, scams, payment fraud, synthetic identity, friendly fraud, mule activity, and suspicious transaction patterns.

  • Strong knowledge of the chargeback lifecycle, representment process, dispute evidence preparation, reason codes, and card network rules, especially Visa and Mastercard.

  • Proven ability to lead operational teams in a fast-paced, high-volume environment while maintaining strong standards across quality, productivity, SLAs, and risk decisioning.

  • Experience managing escalations, incidents, urgent risk events, and time-sensitive workflows with calm, structured, and clear communication.

  • Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret operational data, identify root causes, spot trends, and translate insights into practical improvements.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with analysts, senior stakeholders, cross-functional teams, and external partners.

  • Highly organised, structured, and proactive, with strong follow-through and the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing operational detail.

  • Experience driving process improvements, building playbooks, improving decision frameworks, and leading initiatives that go beyond day-to-day BAU management.

  • Comfortable using AI, automation, workflow, and productivity tools to improve team efficiency, decision quality, documentation, reporting, and operational outcomes.

  • Strong interest in crypto, fintech, payments, and the future of digital finance.

Nice-to-have experience

  • Exposure to fraud tooling, rule tuning, or decision engines.

  • Experience working with Unit21 case management solution.

  • Exposure to workforce planning, capacity management, queue management, and performance forecasting.

BLOCK Values

We’re looking for people who live our core values, those who strive for excellence and want to leave a lasting legacy on the global financial system. Our values:
B - Be Hungry
L - Level Up
O - Own It
C - Crypto Curious
K - Kaizen
Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learnt, diversity cannot.

Benefits & Perks 💡

💰Competitive salary package
🤝 Equity package: We believe financial freedom starts with our employees, so all employees have ownership at MoonPay
📈 Pay for performance equity bonus: Those who drive outsized outcomes receive outsized rewards
🚀 Moonshot award. We honor exceptional impact - 10 employees twice a year, each earning a $250,000 equity grant.
🏝 Unlimited holidays: We give you the autonomy to choose when to work (and when to switch off)
🌍 Hybrid working schedule: Work fully remotely or your nearest Moonbase, the choice is yours
🩺 Private Healthcare benefits: To protect you and your loved ones
🍼 Enhanced parental leave: So you can spend more time with your loved ones without a second thought
📚 Annual training budget: We support your training journey every step of the way
🪑 Home office setup allowance: Create the home office of your dreams
👛 Remote working allowance: Those working fully remotely get a little extra for utilities
💰 Monthly budget to spend on our products and zero fee crypto transactions: Cultivate your inner DEGEN
💰 Employee referral programme: Great people know great people, refer them to receive 10K in USDC
✈️ Regular remote company offsites: Meet your colleagues regularly for high impact in person sessions and hackathons
🚀 Working in a disruptive and fast-growing company where excellence is rewarded

Commitment To Diversity

At MoonPay we believe that every voice matters. We strive to create a mindful and respectful environment where everyone can bring their authentic self to work, and experience a culture that is free of harassment, racism, and discrimination. That’s why we are committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and are a proud equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including, but not limited to, hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, and leave of absence.

Our team exists to make these moments the most reliable and transparent in world-class consumer finance.

Our work is agile and fast-paced, shipping new code to production almost every two-week sprint, and rigorously measuring the impact it has on the behavior of our users. This role rewards curiosity, ownership, and a builder's mindset. You'll know exactly what your objectives are, you'll have what you need to hit them, and you'll choose your own path to get there. Job Summary:

The Provider Success Manager plays a vital role in supporting LegalShield’s network of law firms by monitoring service-level agreements, coaching attorneys, and driving performance improvements. Operating with a moderate to high level of independence, this role serves as the key liaison between LegalShield and assigned firms, ensuring they meet quality and productivity standards while enhancing the member experience. Responsibilities include training on best practices and technology, monitoring firm performance, resolving member issues, and supporting business development initiatives.

Responsibilities:

LegalShield provides affordable legal advice and representation for individuals, families, and businesses through a network of provider law firms. The Lawyer Services division is tasked with building and maintaining our network of top performing law firms and lawyers who service our members. To achieve that goal, we strive to build relationships based on mutual trust, shared capabilities, transparency and a commitment to maximizing the member experience.

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, self-starter to join our team of Provider Success Managers (PSM). PSMs will be responsible for ensuring that their assigned provider law firms’ interaction with members is optimized, and relationships are nurtured to align with the company's business goals. This role requires a bold and collaborative individual who is able to exert influence through excellent communication, compelling information and a rigorous, disciplined framework.

Operating with a moderate to high degree of independence, the PSM works with their assigned firms to monitor individual firm SLA’s, deliver on their assigned firm/attorney performance improvement plans, and acts as the liaison between LegalShield and their assigned law firms. The Provider Success Manager, working with the Vice President of Lawyer Services, will identify individual firm and attorney performance targets and develop new and innovative ways to enable the success of their assigned provider law firms.

The Provider Success Manager must have the ability to communicate effectively, collaborate with internal and external teams, meet deadlines, display organization, and time management, and maintain autonomy while working on multiple simultaneous projects and duties.

​Performance Outcomes:

  • Relationship Management:
    • Establish and maintain positive working relationships with provider law firms.
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned provider law firms, ensuring communication is clear and effective.
    • Serve as the internal LegalShield advocate for assigned law firms, representing their interests and navigating internal teams on behalf of their firms
  • Contract Management:
    • Monitor performance and ensure adherence to contractual agreements, deadlines, and quality standards.
    • Address and resolve any issues or disputes that arise during the provider law firms relationships.
  • Performance Monitoring & Reporting:
    • Track and evaluate performance based on key metrics such as quality, timely delivery, and customer satisfaction.
    • Work with provider law firms to improve service delivery, product quality, and compliance with contracts.
    • Regularly report on provider performance to senior management and make recommendations for improvements.
  • Risk Management & Compliance:
    • Ensure provider law firms meet all regulatory, legal, and company compliance requirements.
    • Mitigate risk by identifying potential issues in relationships and implementing corrective actions.
  • Cost Management & Optimization:
    • Identify opportunities for cost savings and efficiency improvements.
  • Process Improvement:
    • Continuously evaluate and improve management processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness.
    • Implement best practices and industry trends to optimize relationships and business outcomes.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, or a related field (or equivalent work experience) preferred.
  • 1 year of experience managing third party teams, such as contact center vendors, third party partners, etc
  • Strong negotiation and management skills.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams (e.g., Legal, Operations).
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and efficiency.
  • Knowledge of industry best practices and regulatory compliance related to vendor management.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and vendor management software (e.g., SAP, Oracle, etc.). (Should vendor management tools be preferred and not a requirement?)

Exempt

  • Extended periods of working on a computer and speaking with others

  • Extended periods of sitting at a desk

  • Periodic travel for site visits and conferences. May require airline travel and overnight stay

The Digital Shelf Team’s mission is to drive organic growth for our Kraft Heinz brands by optimizing our shoppers’ experience across eCommerce retailers. We aspire to create the best digital shelf experience in the industry through a deep understanding of our brands, shoppers, and retailers.

The Digital Shelf Senior Analyst plays a crucial role on the Digital Shelf Team through ownership of end-to-end Digital Shelf strategy and execution for a group of key customers as well as acting as a subject matter expert for our written content strategy across all retailer dot coms.

This role requires close collaboration with cross-functionals and external partners to identify real-time and long-term opportunities for their customers in the areas of SEO, content effectiveness, syndication, ratings and reviews, and taxonomy. The Senior Manager will utilize digital shelf analytics, uncover insights, drive measurement, and scale to maximize visibility and conversion rates on the digital shelf.

Essential Functions & Responsibilities

  • Holds end-to-end PDP content responsibility for customers within Alternate Channels sales area. Leverages content intelligence, customer partnerships, and digital shelf tools to establish the strategy and lead the execution of processes to drive Organic Product Placement, Sales, Market Share, and Content Accuracy for customers under responsibility.

raw.description:
Senior Infrastructure & Network Engineer (L3) (Part-time)

Architecture, Security & Compliance

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Infrastructure & Network Engineer (Level 3) to provide senior-level technical oversight, architecture review, configuration validation, project assurance, and infrastructure compliance support across our enterprise technology environment.

This is not a traditional network administration or deployment-focused position.

The primary purpose of this role is to serve as a senior technical reviewer and trusted second set of eyes for infrastructure and network projects. The engineer will review proposed architectures and implementations, identify technical or security weaknesses, recommend improvements, assist with complex configuration adjustments when necessary, and independently verify that systems have been implemented correctly.

The engineer will work closely with IT leadership, infrastructure teams, vendors, MSPs, and the cybersecurity team to ensure that technology implementations are reliable, scalable, secure, properly documented, and aligned with established cybersecurity and compliance requirements.

The role will also participate in the development of automation and AI-assisted compliance validation, including an AI CISO platform designed to continuously review technical controls, configurations, asset coverage, and compliance evidence.

Core Responsibilities

  • Review network and infrastructure architectures before implementation.
  • Review configurations implemented by internal teams, vendors, MSPs, and other technical resources.
  • Validate that infrastructure projects follow technical, security, and vendor best practices.
  • Identify design weaknesses, configuration problems, unnecessary exposure, and operational risks.
  • Provide recommendations for improving architecture, reliability, performance, security, and maintainability.
  • Perform post-implementation reviews to verify systems were configured as designed.
  • Assist engineers with complex configuration changes and troubleshooting when senior-level expertise is required.
  • Independently validate remediation after identified issues have been corrected.
  • Participate in technical design and architecture discussions for new projects.
  • Review implementation plans, change plans, testing procedures, and rollback strategies.
  • Maintain and improve technical standards, configuration baselines, and review checklists.

Advanced Network Engineering Skills

The successful candidate should possess advanced Level 3 knowledge of:

  • TCP/IP and advanced network troubleshooting.
  • IPv4 addressing and subnetting.
  • Layer 2 and Layer 3 switching.
  • VLANs and network segmentation.
  • STP/RSTP.
  • LACP and link aggregation.
  • ACLs.
  • NAT.
  • DHCP and DNS.
  • OSPF and BGP.
  • VPN technologies.
  • Firewall concepts and policy design.
  • Multi-site networking.
  • Network redundancy and high availability.
  • Enterprise Wi-Fi.
  • Network performance analysis.
  • Packet-level troubleshooting using Wireshark or equivalent tools.

The engineer should be capable of reviewing an unfamiliar network environment and identifying architectural, configuration, performance, reliability, and security concerns.

Infrastructure Architecture & Technical Assurance

Strong experience reviewing:

  • Network diagrams and architecture.
  • Switch and router configurations.
  • Firewall rules and ACLs.
  • VLAN and segmentation strategies.
  • Management networks.
  • Wireless architecture.
  • VPN and remote-access configurations.
  • High-availability designs.
  • Internet and WAN connectivity.
  • Authentication and administrative access.
  • Logging and monitoring configurations.
  • Infrastructure firmware and software standards.
  • Backup and recovery architecture.
  • Vendor-proposed technical solutions.

Security & Compliance Engineering

This position is not part of the cybersecurity/SOC function, but the engineer must have a strong understanding of cybersecurity architecture and compliance requirements.

Required knowledge includes:

  • Network segmentation.
  • Zero Trust principles.
  • Least privilege.
  • Secure administrative access.
  • MFA and SSO.
  • Privileged-access concepts.
  • Endpoint protection architecture.
  • EDR/XDR architecture.
  • Secure Internet access.
  • Encryption requirements.
  • Logging and telemetry.
  • Vulnerability-remediation requirements.
  • Infrastructure hardening.
  • Secure configuration baselines.
  • Defense-in-depth principles.

The engineer should have working knowledge of frameworks such as:

  • NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
  • CIS Critical Security Controls.
  • Cyber-insurance technical requirements.
  • Common enterprise security-control requirements.

Configuration & Compliance Validation

A major responsibility of this position is independently validating technical controls.

Examples include reviewing whether:

  • Management interfaces are properly isolated.
  • Administrative access is appropriately restricted.
  • Network segmentation is implemented correctly.
  • Firewall and ACL rules match the intended design.
  • Required MFA controls are properly configured.
  • Endpoint-management platforms cover the intended systems.
  • Security agents are correctly deployed and communicating.
  • Required logs are being generated and forwarded.
  • Network equipment is running approved configurations and firmware.
  • Encryption requirements are implemented.
  • Infrastructure configurations follow approved security baselines.

Identity & Endpoint Architecture

Strong understanding of:

  • Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Duo MFA and SSO.
  • SAML.
  • OAuth/OIDC concepts.
  • Conditional Access concepts.
  • RBAC.
  • Privileged-access concepts.
  • Service accounts.
  • Windows enterprise management.
  • macOS enterprise management concepts.
  • RMM and endpoint-management architecture.
  • Patch-management architecture.
  • Endpoint security architecture.

Preferred Technology Experience

Experience with the following technologies is highly desirable:

  • Cisco networking and security technologies.
  • Cisco Secure Endpoint.
  • Cisco Secure Access.
  • Cisco Umbrella.
  • Cisco XDR.
  • Duo.
  • Extreme Networks.
  • ExtremeCloud IQ.
  • Microsoft Entra ID.
  • NinjaOne.
  • Microsoft 365.
  • Enterprise MDM platforms.

Automation & API Engineering

This role will help develop automated technical validation and compliance-assurance capabilities.

Desired skills include:

  • Advanced PowerShell.
  • Python.
  • REST APIs.
  • JSON.
  • OAuth and API authentication.
  • Webhooks.
  • SQL/data-query concepts.
  • Git/version control.
  • Data normalization.
  • Cross-system data reconciliation.
  • Secure API credential and secrets management.
  • Automated configuration validation.
  • Automated compliance checks.
  • Automated evidence collection.

Professional Skills

The ideal candidate should:

  • Be highly analytical.
  • Be naturally skeptical of unverified technical assumptions.
  • Have exceptional troubleshooting skills.
  • Be comfortable reviewing another engineer's work constructively.
  • Be capable of identifying subtle configuration and architectural problems.
  • Communicate technical findings clearly.
  • Explain risks without unnecessarily exaggerating them.
  • Provide practical remediation recommendations.
  • Work effectively with internal teams, vendors, MSPs, and cybersecurity personnel.
  • Produce high-quality technical documentation.
  • Understand the difference between theoretical best practice and practical business requirements.
  • Know when additional specialist expertise is required.

Experience

Preferred qualifications:

  • 7+ years of progressive network/infrastructure engineering experience.
  • Significant Level 3 or senior engineering experience.
  • Experience reviewing enterprise network and infrastructure architectures.
  • Experience with multi-site environments.
  • Experience working alongside cybersecurity teams.
  • Experience implementing or validating security requirements.
  • Experience reviewing vendor/MSP implementations.
  • Experience with automation, APIs, or infrastructure scripting.

Preferred Certifications

Relevant certifications may include:

  • CCNP Enterprise.
  • CCNP Security.
  • Extreme Networks certifications.
  • Microsoft infrastructure/security certifications.
  • CISSP.
  • Security+.
  • CySA+.
  • GIAC certifications.

Engagement: Part-Time

Contract Duration: 3–6 months, with potential extension

Work Setup: Remote

Hours: 10–20 hours per week

PH Applicants only

raw.description:
Job Overview:

The Sr. Demand Planner will be responsible for creating, maintaining, and continuously improving a rolling 12-month forecast for all items. In this role, they will combine historical demand, customer forecasts, sales input, product activity, and other available information to develop an actionable demand plan. They will coordinate the Sales and Operations Planning meeting and work closely with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, and other groups to develop the forecast. The role requires the ability to work effectively with varied and incomplete data sets from both internal systems and customers.

RectorSeal is part of the Industrial Products division of CSWI, a publicly traded U.S. company. RectorSeal has an 80+ year track record of growth and success providing unique products to HVAC, Plumbing, and Electrical contractors as well as the commercial construction industry across North America. RectorSeal currently operates from five manufacturing locations in the United States and maintains strong third-party manufacturing and distribution relationships across the world.

The ideal candidate will possess strong quantitative and analytical skills, experience developing item-level forecasts, and the judgment to make sound recommendations when data is incomplete or inconsistent. They will be comfortable coordinating cross-functional discussions, challenging assumptions constructively, and engaging tactically in data preparation, forecast maintenance, and process improvement activities.

Key Responsibilities:

Operations

  • Create and maintain a rolling 12-month item-level forecast for the full product portfolio, including new, mature, seasonal, promotional, and discontinued items.
  • Analyze historical sales, orders, customer forecasts, market inputs, promotions, pricing activity, product lifecycle changes, and other demand drivers.
  • Combine, clean, validate, and reconcile incomplete, inconsistent, or differently structured data sets from internal systems and customers; document assumptions and identify material gaps.
  • Monitor forecast accuracy and bias, investigate variances, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions with commercial and operational partners.
  • Prepare for and coordinate the Sales and Operations Planning meeting, including, data preparation, presentation materials, decision tracking, and follow-up.
  • Maintain forecasting parameters, product hierarchies, customer mappings, and forecast inputs while improving data quality, and planning processes.
  • Support inventory and supply planning decisions by providing timely, accurate, and clearly documented demand assumptions.
  • Have a general understand of the products, markets, and customers to be able to make more informed decisions regarding the forecast.

Communication

  • Present forecast changes, assumptions, performance metrics, risks, and recommended actions.
  • Maintain effective communication with key internal stakeholders.
  • Identify process problems and data-quality concerns and implement improvements and solutions.

Required Experience:

  • Minimum of five years of experience in demand planning, forecasting, supply chain analytics, business analytics, or a similar role.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Operations Research, Supply Chain, or a related field.
  • High-level Excel skills and proficiency with relevant business systems and Microsoft applications.

Skills/Competencies:

  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to form defensible conclusions from incomplete or imperfect data.
  • Ability to combine, clean, validate, and interpret data from multiple internal and customer sources.
  • Ability to work independently and as a member of a team.
  • Excellent interpersonal, presentation, and communication skills.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Experience with demand planning, ERP, business intelligence, or statistical forecasting systems.
  • Working knowledge of time-series forecasting, seasonality, trend analysis, forecast value added, segmentation, and exception-based planning.
  • Experience using customer-provided forecasts, point-of-sale data, order history, or other external demand signals.
  • Familiarity with inventory management, supply planning, service-level tradeoffs, and Sales and Operations Planning or integrated business planning processes.
  • Experience in a manufacturing or distribution environment.

Benefits:At RectorSeal, our employees enjoy the following benefits to support their physical, financial, and emotional wellness. These benefits include comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans, 401(k), pension, life insurance, paid time off program with paid holidays, and various wellness programs.

About RectorSeal

Based in Houston, Texas, RectorSeal, LLC, is a wholly owned subsidiary of CSW Industrials, Inc. [NYSE: CSW] and is a leading provider of quality solutions for the professional trades serving heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC/R), plumbing, electrical, and construction markets. For more information about RectorSeal’s innovative products and brands that increase efficiency and improve reliability, please visit www.RectorSeal.com.

About CSW Industrials
CSW Industrials is a diversified industrial growth company with industry-leading operations in three segments: Contractor Solutions, Specialized Reliability Solutions, and Engineered Building Solutions. CSW provides niche, value-added products with two essential commonalities: performance and reliability. The primary end markets we serve with our well-known brands include HVAC/R, plumbing, electrical, general industrial, architecturally-specified building products, energy, mining, and rail transportation.

We are seeking an experienced and proactive Escalations Manager to join our Global Support Organization. You will act as the bridge between customers, internal teams, and executive management, driving resolution and maintaining trust with our customers while contributing to continuous improvement efforts.

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives to address and resolve complex issues within high-risk accounts, ensuring timely and effective escalation resolution.
  • Triage, prioritize and assign escalations to appropriate teams while maintaining accountability
  • Develop and execute detailed action plans for resolving escalated issues, coordinating with cross-functional teams
  • Build strong relationships with key customer stakeholders to restore confidence and trust during escalations
  • Proactively communicate status updates and resolution plans to customers and internal teams • Ensure customer feedback from escalations is documented and shared with relevant stakeholders

  • Conduct post-mortem reviews for major incidents, documenting lessons learned and implementing preventive measures
  • Track and report on key metrics such as escalation response times, resolution and customer satisfaction scores

  • Proven track record of resolving high-impact customer issues and managing critical incidents
  • Exceptional communication skills with experience in communicating regularly with executive level management
  • Understanding of SaaS organizational and operational constructs including Product, Engineering, Support, Customer Success, Sales, and Professional Services
  • Ability to quickly establish trust and to influence others, both internally and externally
  • Ability to handle conflict and drive agreement on decisions for which conflicting opinions and input exist
  • Strong data-driven decision making skills, and process oriented mindset
  • Ability to identify risks and dependencies and put in place plans to mitigate them
  • Adaptability, flexibility and the conviction to “do the right thing” by keeping a customer centric mentality at all times
  • Familiarity with support related tools such as Salesforce Service Cloud, Jira and Slack.

Hiring Range:

$130,000 to $145,000

In accordance with Colorado’s Equal Pay for Equal Work Act (SB 19-085) the approximate compensation range for this role in Colorado is listed above. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors, such as knowledge, skills, and abilities.

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day.

Our Benefits:

Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone’s individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. About the Company

Gemini is a global crypto and Web3 platform founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss in 2014, offering a wide range of simple, reliable, and secure crypto products and services to individuals and institutions in over 70 countries. Our mission is to unlock the next era of financial, creative, and personal freedom by providing trusted access to the decentralized future. We envision a world where crypto reshapes the global financial system, internet, and money to create greater choice, independence, and opportunity for all — bridging traditional finance with the emerging cryptoeconomy in a way that is more open, fair, and secure. As a publicly traded company, Gemini is poised to accelerate this vision with greater scale, reach, and impact.

The Department: Predictions

The Role: Senior Software Engineer (Mobile)

As a Senior Mobile Engineer on the Predictions team, you'll own the mobile experience for Gemini's CFTC-regulated prediction markets exchange. You'll build and ship trading interfaces for event contracts — from order entry and position management to real-time market data — within Gemini's React Native app. You'll work closely with product, design, backend, and compliance to bring new contract types (binary, range, combo) to market on mobile and drive activation and retention for a fast-growing product line.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain the Predictions mobile trading experience end-to-end: market browsing, order placement, portfolio views, and settlement flows.
  • Architect performant, real-time UI for streaming market data (orderbook, price charts, position P&L) using modern React Native patterns (TurboModules, JSI, native navigator integration).
  • Collaborate with backend engineers on gRPC and WebSocket integrations that power live trading surfaces.
  • Create reusable, well-tested UI components shared across Predictions and the broader Gemini mobile app.
  • Partner with product and design to shape mobile-specific UX for new contract categories (weather, economics, crypto, sports) and features like combo contracts and range contracts.
  • Scope and implement solutions independently, making informed architecture decisions and tradeoffs around native vs. JS boundaries.
  • Establish and improve mobile development processes — testing strategy, release quality gates, OTA vs. native release decisions.
  • Conduct thorough code reviews and mentor other engineers on React Native best practices.
  • Use analytics and experimentation data to inform product and engineering decisions around activation funnels, onboarding, and trading engagement.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years building production mobile applications with React Native.
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript.
  • Deep understanding of React Native internals — bridging, native modules, performance profiling, and debugging.
  • Experience building real-time, data-intensive UIs (trading, dashboards, live feeds).
  • Strong UX/UI sensibility with a track record of contributing to design and product decisions, not just implementing specs.
  • Expertise in unit and integration testing for mobile.
  • Comfort working in a regulated environment where changes require rigor and auditability.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with financial or trading applications (orderbooks, charting, position management).
  • Familiarity with Expo, EAS, and OTA update strategies.
  • Experience with native module authoring (Swift/Kotlin) or SwiftUI/Jetpack Compose embedding via Expo Modules API.
  • Exposure to gRPC, WebSockets, or similar real-time transport protocols.
  • Experience with performance analysis tooling (Flipper, React DevTools profiler, native instruments).
  • Prior work at a fintech, exchange, or other regulated product environment.

It Pays to Work Here

The compensation & benefits package for this role includes:
  • Competitive starting pay
  • A discretionary annual bonus
  • Long-term incentive in the form of a new hire equity grant
  • Comprehensive health plans
  • 401K with company matching
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Flexible time off

Salary Range: The base salary range for this role is between $140,000 - $200,000 in the State of New York, the State of California and the State of Washington. This range is not inclusive of our discretionary bonus or equity package. When determining a candidate’s compensation, we consider a number of factors including skillset, experience, job scope, and current market data.

In the United States, we offer a hybrid work approach at our hub offices, balancing the benefits of in-person collaboration with the flexibility of remote work. Expectations may vary by location and role, so candidates are encouraged to connect with their recruiter to learn more about the specific policy for the role. Employees who do not live near one of our hubs are part of our remote workforce. All employees, however, are required to onboard in-person at one of our office locations.

The CIO will have overall responsibility for ERAC’s IT function, including technology strategy, infrastructure, applications, cybersecurity, data governance, business continuity, and emerging technology strategic implementation.. In addition, this role will provide oversight to the Corporate Holdings Trailing Operations business segments. The CIO will partner closely with the CEO and senior leadership team to align technology and operational priorities with business objectives, drive continuous improvement, and support long-term value creation.

Job Description

Enterprise Technology Leadership

  • Develop and execute ERAC’s overall information technology strategy in alignment with business goals and enterprise priorities.
  • Lead all core IT functions, including infrastructure, enterprise applications, service delivery, cybersecurity, data management, architecture, and vendor management.
  • Ensure the stability, security, scalability, and effectiveness of the company’s technology environment.
  • Oversee the planning, prioritization, and execution of technology investments and initiatives.
  • Establish and maintain IT governance, policies, standards, and controls appropriate for a regulated business environment.
  • Drive modernization and continuous improvement efforts that enhance efficiency, reduce risk, and improve service delivery.

Business Partnership and Executive Leadership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to the CEO and a strategic partner to the senior leadership team.
  • Translate business needs into practical technology solutions that support operational excellence and business outcomes.
  • Provide leadership on enterprise-wide initiatives requiring cross-functional coordination and executive sponsorship.
  • Foster strong collaboration across finance, operations, legal, compliance, risk, and other key functions.

Corporate Holdings Trailing Operations Oversight

  • Provide executive oversight for the Corporate Holdings Trailing Operations business segments, representing approximately 10% of the role.
  • Partner with business leaders to ensure effective operational management, alignment of priorities, and execution of key initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve controls, and enhance organizational effectiveness within these segments.
  • Support integration of operational and technology strategies to drive sustainable performance.

Risk, Security, and Compliance

  • Ensure strong cybersecurity, data protection, disaster recovery, and business continuity capabilities.
  • Maintain compliance with applicable regulatory, legal, and internal control requirements.
  • Oversee risk management related to systems, vendors, data, and operational technology dependencies.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to ensure technology and operations are audit-ready and well controlled.

Team and Vendor Leadership

  • Lead, develop, and inspire a high-performing IT organization utilizing FLIGHT DECK methologies.
  • Build organizational capability through talent development, succession planning, and effective resource management.
  • Oversee key technology vendors and service providers to ensure performance, value, and accountability.
  • Manage the IT budget with a focus on cost discipline, investment prioritization, and business value.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or related field required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Significant senior leadership experience in information technology, including experience leading enterprise IT functions.
  • Experience working in insurance, reinsurance, financial services, or another highly regulated industry strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to align technology strategy with business objectives and deliver measurable operational results.
  • Experience working directly with executive leadership and boards or governance committees.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity, enterprise applications, infrastructure, data governance, and IT risk management.
  • Proven ability to lead through complexity, manage transformation, and influence across functions.

Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;

Job Summary:

The Manager, Member Intake is a hands-on virtual leader responsible for the day-to-day performance, quality, and development of a team of Intake CSRs supporting LegalShield members across all states. This role owns real-time queue management, call quality oversight, coaching, and the professional growth of team members, while driving the team toward defined efficiency, proficiency, and productivity targets.

The Manager is a working leader actively engaged with the live queue, visible and accessible to the team throughout the shift, and directly accountable for delivering a consistent, seamless, and cohesive member experience aligned to the intake framework, disposition standards, and call-flow methodology (Connect → Understand → Assess → Resolve → Close).

Responsibilities:

Performance Outcomes

Real-Time Queue & Contact Center Operations

  • Monitor live queue activity throughout the shift service level, average speed of answer, calls in queue, agent availability, adherence, and abandoned rate and take immediate action to balance staffing and workload.
  • Manage agent status and scheduling exceptions in Workday (WD), including log-in/log-out compliance, breaks, and after-call work.
  • Identify and resolve real-time bottlenecks (e.g., callback backlog, referral handling delays, unusually high abandoned rates) before they impact the member experience.
  • Escalate systemic issues (telephony, tooling, staffing gaps) with clear data and recommended actions.

Call Listening, QA & Coaching

  • Conduct scheduled and ad-hoc live-call monitoring and recorded-call reviews for every direct report on a defined cadence.
  • Evaluate calls against the intake call-flow standard (Connect / Understand / Assess / Resolve / Close), verification protocol, OPP procedures, disposition accuracy, and member-experience benchmarks.
  • Deliver timely, specific coaching after each observation reinforcing what worked and providing concrete, actionable guidance where the agent can grow.
  • Partner with the QA/Trainer to calibrate scoring, close skill gaps identified in QA trends, and ensure coaching is consistent across the team.
  • Coach agents on correct use of the Primary + Secondary disposition framework so call data remains reporting-ready for QA, trend analysis, and firm-level insights.

Professional & Personal Development

  • Maintain an individual development plan (IDP) for every direct report, updated quarterly, covering role proficiency, career aspirations, and personal growth goals.
  • Hold consistent 1:1s that go beyond metrics focusing on the whole person, their engagement, career trajectory, and any barriers to success at work or otherwise.
  • Identify high-potential team members and create stretch opportunities (e.g., peer mentorship for new hires, SME ownership of a disposition category, project participation).
  • Onboard new hires coming off the training cohort, pairing them with veteran agents and providing intensified coaching support during their first 30/60/90 days.
  • Recognize and celebrate wins publicly call saves, member-experience moments, KPI milestones to reinforce a culture of pride and ownership.

KPI Tracking & Performance Management

  • Track, analyze, and act on team and individual KPIs, including but not limited to:
  • Efficiency: average handle time (AHT), after-call work (ACW), adherence, occupancy, log-in/log-out compliance
  • Proficiency: QA score, first-contact resolution, disposition accuracy, verification compliance, adherence to script and call-flow standards
  • Productivity: calls handled per shift, intakes opened, callbacks completed, transfer accuracy, referral-handling accuracy
  • Member Experience: CSAT / member feedback, escalation rate, complaint rate, save rate on at-risk members
  • Build and deliver weekly individual and team performance summaries; identify trends and translate them into targeted coaching actions.
  • Own performance management for direct reports from positive recognition through structured improvement plans and, when necessary, formal corrective action in partnership with HR.
  • Coach agents to efficiency, proficiency, and productivity targets simultaneously, ensuring speed never comes at the cost of quality or the member experience.

Team Communication & Culture

At Relevate Health, we believe every HCP communication should be relevant, and we've built a company of exceptional people committed to making that vision a reality. Our culture is collaborative, growth-minded, and energized by purpose.

This is a working leadership role: you'll shape positioning and messaging, turn complex clinical science into compelling brand ideas, and bring them to life across traditional and omnichannel ecosystems.

You'll own the copy team and serve as a trusted creative partner to clients and internal collaborators alike, working alongside strategy, art, account, medical, and UX to push the work forward.   • Familiarity with omnichannel content strategy and digital/UX considerations
  • Experience in high-science therapeutic areas (oncology preferred)

Education:

  • BA degree in Advertising, Communications, Journalism, English, Fine Arts, or a related field required

Apply today and let's talk.
