About AIRS Medical

AIRS Medical is a fast-growing healthcare technology company founded in 2018 and headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, with rapidly expanding U.S. EMEA and Japan operations. Built on the belief that technology should help prevent illness, not just treat it, AIRS Medical empowers people to live healthier, longer lives.

Our flagship solution, SwiftMR, is an FDA-cleared, cloud-based AI software that accelerates MRI scans by up to 50% without compromising diagnostic quality. Trusted by more than 350 hospitals and imaging centers across the U.S., including Lumexa Imaging, Northwestern Medicine, and MedStar Health / Georgetown University, SwiftMR enhances imaging efficiency, patient comfort, and clinical workflow.

AIRS Medical has been recognized with Frost & Sullivan’s Technology Innovation Leadership Awards (2023 and 2024) and as the winner of the Facebook AI Research and NYU Langone Health fastMRI Challenge (2019 and 2020), underscoring our leadership in deep learning and medical imaging AI.

As we continue expanding globally, AIRS Medical remains committed to advancing AI and robotics innovations that enhance patient care, support healthcare professionals, and redefine diagnostic efficiency.

Requirements

What you will do

Market mapping and white-space analysis

  • Build and maintain market maps for priority EMEA countries, covering hospitals, imaging centers and healthcare groups
  • Map current AIRS customers, opportunities and partner coverage to identify white spaces and priority targets
  • Validate and refine the maps with country business development (BD) teams

Strategic account and stakeholder intelligence

  • Research high-value, multi-site healthcare organizations: their footprint, structure, imaging capacity and growth plans
  • Map key decision makers and stakeholders across executive, clinical, technical, procurement and digital functions
  • Prepare account insights that support commercial account planning

Public-sector market access

  • Research how public healthcare procurement works in priority countries, including tender platforms and supplier registration
  • Map key requirements and documentation for market access, and help assess AIRS's readiness
  • Final legal, regulatory and compliance interpretation stays with the relevant AIRS owner or external specialist

Market intelligence database

  • Build and maintain a structured, reusable EMEA market intelligence database with clear sources and update dates
  • Prepare concise country, account and market access briefs for EMEA leadership and commercial teams
  • Use AI and research tools to work efficiently, while validating key facts through reliable sources

Required

  • Strong research and analytical skills, with the ability to turn fragmented information into clear commercial insights
  • Comfort researching companies, healthcare systems, public procurement and market structures
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and confidence working with structured datasets
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • High attention to detail and the ability to distinguish facts from assumptions
  • Ability to work independently on open-ended research questions
  • Familiarity with AI research and productivity tools
  • Valid authorization to work or complete an internship in Germany
  • Ability to turn research data into meaningful reports to help the EMEA team understand markets and make strategies based on the data

Nice to have

  • Additional European languages and/or Korean
  • Interest in healthcare, medical technology, AI and international business

Student status is not required. Recent graduates and early-career candidates are welcome to apply.

Benefits

  • A paid, 6-month internship at €2,800 gross per month
  • Direct exposure to EMEA commercial leadership and strategic account work
  • Hands-on experience at the intersection of healthcare, medical technology and AI
  • Work in an international team across Europe and Korea
  • 15 days of PTO
  • Remote work setting

About Us

The North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS) is one of the largest, most complex agencies in the state, and has approximately 17,000 employees. It is responsible for ensuring the health, safety, and well-being of all North Carolinians, providing human service needs for special populations including individuals who are deaf, blind, developmentally disabled, and mentally ill, and helping poor North Carolinians achieve economic independence.


Description of Work

The Child Care Consultant supports the regulatory functions of the Division by assisting potential and current child care providers in understanding and meeting child care licensing requirements. The role operates remotely within assigned service counties and requires independent planning and management of daily work.

Responsibilities include monitoring licensed and unlicensed child care settings for compliance, conducting investigations related to alleged violations, and documenting findings in accordance with program expectations. The position relies on effective communication and professional conduct in highly stressful situations. This role also utilizes computer software applications, including Microsoft Word and Excel, to complete regulatory and administrative tasks.

Key Duties Include:

- Monitor child care centers and homes for compliance with applicable licensing requirements through scheduled and unscheduled visits.

- Investigate reports alleging violations of licensing requirements, including allegations of unlicensed operation, and document findings accurately.

- Assist potential and current child care providers in understanding, achieving, and maintaining compliance with state child care regulations.

- Review facility operations, records, and practices to verify adherence to health, safety, and program standards.

- Prepare clear, accurate documentation and reports using Microsoft Word, Excel, and other required software applications.

- Communicate findings, expectations, and regulatory guidance to providers in a professional and supportive manner.

- Plan and manage daily workload independently to meet program expectations across assigned service counties.

- Respond to high‑stress situations with calm, professional judgment to support effective regulatory oversight.

- Coordinate follow-up activities to ensure timely resolution of compliance issues and corrective actions.

- Maintain accurate records to support regulatory decisions and ongoing monitoring activities.

About us:

Working at Tech Holding isn't just a job, it's an opportunity to be a part of something bigger. We are a full-service consulting firm that was founded on the premise of delivering predictable outcomes and high-quality solutions to our clients. Our founders and team members have industry experience and have held senior positions in a wide variety of companies – from emerging startups to large Fortune 50 firms – and we have taken our combined experiences and developed a unique approach that is supported by the principles of deep expertise, integrity, transparency, and dependability.

The Role:

We’re looking for a hands-on Machine Learning Engineer in Mexico to join our team building an AI-powered risk intelligence platform. The platform helps enterprises detect, assess, and respond to emerging online threats, including disinformation, reputational attacks, and security risks. You’ll design, build, and deploy NLP and LLM-based models that process large volumes of data from mainstream and niche online sources. You’ll collaborate daily with US-based engineers and product stakeholders as an individual contributor.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, train, and deploy ML models for text classification, entity extraction, clustering, and narrative and topic detection
  • Build and improve LLM-powered features, including prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic workflows
  • Develop embedding and semantic-search pipelines to group related content and surface emerging threats
  • Productionize models as scalable, monitored services with clear latency, cost, and accuracy targets
  • Build evaluation frameworks and datasets to measure model quality, bias, and drift over time
  • Work with data engineering to improve ingestion, labeling, and feature pipelines for high-volume, noisy, multilingual text data
  • Monitor and retrain models in production, and debug quality issues end to end
  • Join daily standups and technical discussions with the US-based client team

Requirements:

  • 4+ years of professional experience building and deploying machine learning models in production
  • Strong Python skills and hands-on experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Hugging Face Transformers
  • Practical NLP experience, such as classification, named entity recognition (NER), topic modeling, or semantic similarity on real-world text data
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models), including prompt engineering and RAG
  • Experience with embeddings and vector search (e.g., pgvector, Pinecone, OpenSearch, or FAISS)
  • Experience deploying and operating ML services on AWS, GCP, or Azure, using Docker and CI/CD

The role of Patient Coordinator will be central to the success of the Signatera product line. This position will be focused on growing the relationship between Natera and its patients to ensure timely management of testing. Core responsibilities include collaborating with Nurse Coordinators to increase revenue and drive market development through direct sales by being the key contact for patient needs. The Patient Coordinator will accomplish this by being the patient advocate within Natera.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

raw.description:
Conceive, Create and Contribute to Cityscope

Creative expression is all about putting across your thoughts without limitations. We, at Cityscope would love for you to do just that. Whether you have a flair for writing an article or producing a video, we have got you covered. Being a local information, news and commerce platform, we are always looking to feature good stories and magnify your voices.

So, if you have an original topic or story idea in mind and have worked on a piece, dos end in your work to - .

Who can contribute?

You don’t have to be a professional writer, video producer or photographer. If you have something enriching and value-adding to share - be it about a person, place, product or point at issue, put pen to paper or capture it on camera. And, share it with us.What kind of content are we looking for? Go through the Cityscope website and look at the kind of topics/issues covered as well as how it’s presented. However, this does not mean you need to restrain yourself. Here are a few examples:

  1. Articles including feature or news stories, individual profiles, in-depth pieces, opinions, listicles, etc.

  2. Photo collections

  3. Videos in conjunction with interviews, tutorials, stories, news

  4. Memes, illustrations, comic strips, technology tips, mythbusters, data driven visualisations. Let your imagination run free! If it’s interesting to you, others will also find it so.

How long should the articles and videos be?

Articles can run anywhere from 500 to 800 words and should be accompanied with appropriate images. Some may run longer (to a maximum of 1,000 words) if they’re really compelling. Videos can run up to 3 to 4 minutes.

How does the process work?

  1. Do not forget to include some details about yourself and your background and/ or interests. In case your work has been published previously, send us the relevant links.2. We will go through it and get back to you (usually in a week or two) to let you know if we can publish it along with feedback.

  2. All images and other multimedia elements in the work submitted, should be original or from a public domain or used with the permission of the owner.

  3. Articles need to be sent in a Google document. google drive for Images and videos

  4. If your work is published, you will retain all rights to your article or video or pictures and be given due credit. However, they cannot be republished on any other platform.

  5. Your article or piece of work will contain your name on a byline.We can also include a link to your website (if you have one) and contact information (if applicable and requested by you)

Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

About the Team

Launched in 2021, Fanatics Betting and Gaming is the online and retail sports betting subsidiary of Fanatics, a global digital sports platform. The Fanatics Sportsbook is available to 95% of the addressable online sports bettor market in the U.S. Fanatics Casino is currently available online in Michigan, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and West Virginia. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin.

Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG) is building the industry’s most trusted, scalable, and fan-centric sportsbook experience. Our Internal Platforms team powers the systems that enable customer operations, marketing, support, and data-driven decision making—centered around Salesforce and deeply integrated backend services.

We are seeking a Senior Salesforce Engineer to develop, and maintain scalable Salesforce solutions that support critical internal workflows and customer-facing operations. This is a hands-on engineering role requiring strong Salesforce development expertise, comfort working across integrations and distributed systems, and a passion for building high-quality internal platforms.

You will work closely with Marketing, Operations, Product, Data Engineering, and Backend Engineering teams to deliver robust Salesforce capabilities that integrate with third-party systems and internal APIs.

Responsibilities

Salesforce Engineering & Platform Development

  • Build, and maintain custom Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, and declarative features.
  • Participate in the end-to-end implementation of Salesforce enhancements, from requirements gathering through deployment and support.
  • Apply scalable and maintainable patterns for triggers, flows, automation, and custom components.
  • Write high-quality, testable code with appropriate unit test coverage and participate in code reviews.

Integrations & Distributed Systems

  • Develop and maintain integrations between Salesforce and external/internal systems using REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, and event-driven patterns.
  • Partner with backend engineers to design clean integration contracts between Salesforce and Java-based services.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex integration and data flow issues across systems.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Partnership

  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Business Analysts, and cross-functional partners to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Partner with Marketing, VIP, Operations Support, Risk, and Data teams to ensure Salesforce solutions meet business and regulatory needs.
  • Clearly communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, and implementation details to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Data Management & Platform Quality

  • Support data migrations, imports/exports, and ongoing data quality initiatives.
  • Ensure strong data integrity, security, access control, and performance across the Salesforce ecosystem.
  • Contribute to platform reliability, availability, and operational excellence.

Documentation & Best Practices

  • Create and maintain technical documentation for Salesforce customizations, configurations, and integrations.
  • Follow and help evolve engineering best practices related to Salesforce DX, Git workflows, CI/CD pipelines, testing, and deployment strategies.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to reduce technical debt and improve platform scalability.

Experience and Skills

Required

  • 3-5 years of hands-on Salesforce engineering experience, with strong proficiency in Apex, Lightning Web Components, and Salesforce automation.
  • Strong experience with Salesforce configuration, including custom objects, flows, validation rules, and security model design.
  • Experience building and maintaining API-based integrations between Salesforce and third-party or internal systems.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce DX, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Ability to work independently on complex projects while collaborating effectively within a team.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Preferred

  • Salesforce Platform Developer I or II certification.
  • Additional Salesforce certifications (Administrator, App Builder, Architect).
  • Experience with:
    • Data migrations and large-scale data operations
    • Event-driven architectures and distributed systems
    • Highly available, production-critical platforms

Job Summary

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who loves being at the center of the action and driving business impact without carrying a direct sales quota. As the Manager, Field Planning & Execution, you'll serve as the operational quarterback for Insulet's commercial organization, partnering with Sales, Marketing, Training, Analytics, and leadership teams to turn strategic priorities into real-world execution. You'll lead cross-functional planning, manage high-visibility commercial pilots, gather and translate field insights into actionable recommendations, and help shape how future initiatives are scaled across the business. This role is ideal for a strong project manager and strategic thinker who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment, enjoys influencing senior stakeholders, and wants the opportunity to directly improve the effectiveness of a national sales organization while helping bring innovative diabetes solutions to more patients. It's a unique chance to combine strategy, operations, analytics, and innovation while gaining broad exposure across Insulet's commercial leadership team.

The Manager, Field Planning & Execution is a senior individual contributor responsible for running the day-to-day operating cadence for integrated field planning and assigned commercial pilots across U.S. Field and Inside Sales. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Field Innovation & Pilot Execution, this role translates approved priorities into executable plans, coordinates cross functional workstreams, maintains roadmap and governance discipline, and turns field and performance insights into practical recommendations.

The role owns planning, coordination, issue resolution, reporting, and follow through for assigned work while influencing partners without formal authority. The Senior Manager retains accountability for portfolio direction, prioritization, executive alignment, and final recommendations.


Core Responsibilities:

Integrated Field Planning and Roadmap Management

  • Manage intake for field-facing commercial initiatives: clarify incoming requests, assess field effort and customer impact, and size and sequence work for cross-functional decision.
  • Facilitate recurring planning forums and publish concise decisions, actions, owners, and next steps.
  • Maintain the roadmap of record, including timing, reach, dependencies, sustainment needs, and change impact, and coordinate with initiative owners to keep status current.
  • Prepare analysis for planning discussions, including capacity risks and sequencing considerations.
  • Contribute to prioritization criteria, effort scoring, and intake tools that keep planning decisions consistent and transparent for requesting teams.

Field Pilot Coordination and Execution

  • Coordinate the field side of innovation pilots from launch planning through closeout, including participant and territory selection, onboarding, field communication, and cadence management.
  • Confirm roles, responsibilities, dependencies, and success measures with cross-functional owners before a pilot goes live.
  • Surface execution barriers early and recommend solutions that protect customer experience, field capacity, and measurement quality.
  • Keep pilot teams aligned on timelines, decisions, and open questions as scope evolves.

Field Insight and Advisory Input

  • Coordinate with sales leadership and field sales teams to gather structured input on initiatives, pilots, and field-facing programs.
  • Support field advisory forums, surveys, and other feedback channels, ensuring requests have clear objectives and are routed through the appropriate channel.
  • Synthesize qualitative field feedback into concise themes, implications, and recommendations.
  • Connect field learning to planning decisions, pilot design, operational improvements, and future commercial initiatives.

Measurement, Reporting and Recommendations

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to operationalize measures, data requirements, reporting cadences, and qualitative feedback plans.
  • Monitor progress against approved measures and surface data-quality, workflow, or role-overlap issues that could affect interpretation.
  • Synthesize results, field feedback, customer experience, and commercial outcomes into clear recommendations to scale, adapt, combine, or stop an approach.
  • Build readouts and decision materials for cross-functional partners and leadership.

Cross-Functional Ways of Working

  • Lead day-to-day coordination across Field Marketing, HCP Marketing, Consumer Marketing, Sales Leadership, Training & Clinical Business, Global Sales & Clinical Training, Medical, Data Science and Insights, Sales Effectiveness, and Sales Operations teams.
  • Establish repeatable ways of working built on common definitions, timelines, measures, and governance standards.
  • Clarify ownership, decision points, handoffs, and escalation paths for shared work, and escalate unresolved risks or ownership gaps.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify work, reduce duplication, and protect customer-facing field time.

Education and Experience:

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business, Communications, Analytics, Healthcare, or a related discipline
  • 4+ years of progressive experience in sales, marketing, commercial strategy, sales operations, program management, innovation, analytics, or a related commercial discipline
  • Demonstrated ownership of a recurring cross-functional planning process, governance forum, or program, including agenda, decisions, and follow-through
  • Proven experience managing complex, cross-functional projects or commercial pilots with responsibility for planning, execution, measurement, and stakeholder alignment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, exercise judgment, and recommend best practices in a matrixed organization
  • Experience developing senior leadership-ready updates, recommendations, presentations, and decision materials

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience in medical device, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, diabetes technology, health tech, or another regulated healthcare environment
  • Experience working with a large field sales organization or customer-facing commercial team
  • Experience with advisory boards, voice-of-customer programs, qualitative research, or survey design
  • Experience with integrated planning, portfolio or roadmap management, intake workflows, or program governance
  • Experience with pilot design, test-and-control approaches, or commercialization initiatives

Skills and Competencies:

  • Advanced, specialized depth and breadth of expertise used to develop or improve complex commercial models, processes, and procedures
  • Experience with advisory boards, voice-of-customer programs, qualitative research, or survey design
  • Experience with integrated planning, portfolio or roadmap management, intake workflows, or program governance
  • Experience with pilot design, test-and-control approaches, or commercialization initiatives
  • Strong facilitation skills and comfort leading discussion with sales leaders and senior cross-functional stakeholders, including managing disagreement in the moment
  • Ability to analyze quantitative and qualitative information and convert findings into practical business recommendations
  • Strong prioritization judgment, with the ability to surface trade-offs, recommend sequencing, and explain decisions clearly to senior stakeholders
  • Strong project-management capability, including work planning, dependency management, risk tracking, issue resolution, and executive reporting
  • Ability to influence and align stakeholders across functions without formal authority
  • Ability to create structure in ambiguous or evolving environments and establish repeatable processes
  • Familiarity with the tools used to run this work, including Smartsheet, Microsoft Forms and Teams, Salesforce, and Power BI or comparable reporting platforms
  • Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and presentation skills
  • Ability to manage several concurrent workstreams independently with different partners, cadences, and stakeholders while maintaining attention to detail and follow-through

Physical Requirements (if applicable):

  • Will be required to travel approximately 25% for field advisory meetings, pilot observation, field engagement, customer or field visits, leadership meetings, commercial events, and sales meetings.

NOTE: This position is eligible for 100% remote working arrangements (may work from home/virtually 100%; may also work hybrid on-site/virtual as desired)

Additional Information:

Compensation & Benefits:For U.S.-based positions only, the annual base salary range for this role is $98,400.00 - $147,600.00This position may also be eligible for incentive compensation.We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including:• Medical, dental, and vision insurance• 401(k) with company match• Paid time off (PTO)• And additional employee wellness programsApplication Details:This job posting will remain open until the position is filled.To apply, please visit the Insulet Careers site and submit your application online.Actual pay depends on skills, experience, and education.

Insulet Corporation (NASDAQ: PODD), headquartered in Massachusetts, is an innovative medical device company dedicated to simplifying life for people with diabetes and other conditions through its Omnipod product platform. The Omnipod Insulin Management System provides a unique alternative to traditional insulin delivery methods. With its simple, wearable design, the tubeless disposable Pod provides up to three days of non-stop insulin delivery, without the need to see or handle a needle. Insulet’s flagship innovation, the Omnipod 5 Automated Insulin Delivery System, integrates with a continuous glucose monitor to manage blood sugar with no multiple daily injections, zero fingersticks, and can be controlled by a compatible personal smartphone in the U.S. or by the Omnipod 5 Controller. Insulet also leverages the unique design of its Pod by tailoring its Omnipod technology platform for the delivery of non-insulin subcutaneous drugs across other therapeutic areas. For more information, please visit insulet.com and omnipod.com.

We are looking for highly motivated, performance-driven individuals to be a part of our expanding team. We do this by hiring amazing people guided by shared values who exceed customer expectations. Our continued success depends on it!

Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve engineering workflows, and share practical knowledge.

We are looking for a senior engineer who can connect mobile development, backend services, databases, and infrastructure into a reliable development and delivery process.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile & Platform Engineer who can work across Android and iOS, contribute to our Kotlin Multiplatform architecture, and support our dedicated developers on both platforms.

Your main focus will be enabling the team to deliver effectively: resolving technical challenges, maintaining shared components, improving development workflows, and managing the backend and infrastructure that support the application.

You will also contribute directly to implementation where needed. Depending on your experience and suitability, the role may include technical team leadership for our Android and iOS developers.

Strong GitHub, GitHub Actions, and runner-management experience is essential. Practical experience with AI-assisted and agentic development is equally important.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support our Android and iOS developers with technical decisions, debugging, code reviews, and integration challenges.
  • Develop and maintain shared application logic using Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Contribute to native Android and iOS development where platform-specific work is required.
  • Maintain a clear architecture across mobile applications, backend services, APIs, and databases.
  • Develop and maintain backend functionality and server-side integrations.
  • Manage database changes, investigate data-related issues, and maintain reliable migration, backup, and recovery processes.
  • Build and improve CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot GitHub runners, including self-hosted runners.
  • Improve build reliability, automated testing, deployment processes, and development environments.
  • Manage server-side application deployments, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Establish effective AI-assisted and agentic coding workflows across the team.
  • Review AI-generated code and ensure that changes are tested, understandable, secure, and maintainable.
  • Help developers and junior team members use AI tools effectively through practical demonstrations and knowledge sharing.
  • Where appropriate, act as technical team lead: coordinate dependencies, guide implementation, review technical decisions, and help the team resolve blockers.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience in mobile software development.
  • Strong Kotlin and Android development experience, together with practical Swift and iOS development experience.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and integrating shared code into both mobile platforms.
  • The ability to investigate problems across mobile clients, APIs, backend services, databases, and infrastructure.
  • Practical backend development experience and a sound understanding of API design, authentication, and application security.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including schema changes, migrations, and performance troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on DevOps experience with Linux servers, application deployment, configuration, and operational troubleshooting.
  • Excellent Git and GitHub knowledge, including pull requests, code reviews, branch workflows, and repository configuration.
  • Strong experience with GitHub Actions and configuring and maintaining GitHub runners.
  • Substantial experience using AI coding assistants and coding agents to deliver working software.
  • The ability to establish development workflows that combine coding agents, automated checks, and human review.
  • Clear communication, practical documentation skills, and a willingness to share knowledge.
  • The ability to work independently while supporting other developers constructively.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Previous experience as a technical lead or senior engineer supporting a mobile development team.
  • GPS, BLE, UWB, NFC, or other location and proximity technologies.
  • Testing mobile applications on real devices and investigating platform-specific behavior.
  • Container-based application deployment and reproducible development environments.
  • Monitoring, incident diagnosis, and maintaining reliable backend services.
  • Coordinating changes that affect mobile applications, backend APIs, and database structures together.

Potential Technical Team Lead Responsibilities

For a suitable candidate, the role can include technical leadership of our Android and iOS developers.

This would involve helping the team make consistent technical decisions, breaking down implementation work, coordinating shared dependencies, and maintaining the quality of delivered changes. You should be comfortable mentoring developers and taking responsibility for the technical direction while remaining actively involved in engineering.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • A central role supporting our mobile development team.
  • The opportunity to shape our architecture, infrastructure, and agentic development workflows.
  • Potential technical teamlead responsibility, depending on suitability.
  • Close collaboration with a team that values practical knowledge sharing.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your experience developing for both Android and iOS, including Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Your backend, database, and server infrastructure responsibilities.
  • Examples of GitHub Actions workflows and runner environments you have configured or maintained.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with examples of delivered results.
  • Your experience supporting developers, mentoring colleagues, or leading a technical team.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, GitHub repositories, and released application references are welcome where available.

Job Description

We are seeking a Growth and Improvement minded Regional Medical Scientific Director (AKA Medical Science Liaison, MSL) | in Inflammatory Bowel Disease Immunology that can help drive our Strategic Operating Priorities.

Summary, Focus and Purpose

The Regional Medical Scientific Director (Medical Science Liaison) is a credentialed (i.e., PhD, PharmD, DNP, MD) Director Level Medical Affairs position and therapeutic and disease expert who engages in bidirectional exchange of scientific or medical information with Scientific Leaders (SLs). The role provides balanced, factual, scientific information about non-product areas of interest to the Company and replies to scientific questions from SLs, including questions about Company products. The work is aligned to Scientific Exchange, Research, Scientific Congress Support, and Scientific Insights.

You will liaise between the scientific community and the Company to enhance the comprehension of scientific foundations and goals for approved, in-development, and active Company-sponsored trials and/or investigator-sponsored research studies and serve as a role model for other field medical team members in ways that include on-boarding and/or sharing of therapeutic expertise.

Consistent adherence to field and corporate policies and Global Medical Scientific Affairs (GMSA) strategy, including field standard operating procedures (SOPs), Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines, and administrative/operational responsibilities.

Responsibilities and Primary Activities

Scientific Exchange

  • Develops professional relationships and engages with national and regional SLs to ensure access to company-approved medical and scientific information on areas of therapeutic interest and Company products

  • Conducts peer-to-peer scientific discussions and maintains a reliable presence with those SLs to ensure they have a medical contact within the company

  • Addresses scientific questions and directs SL inquiries on issues outside of scope (e.g., grants) to appropriate company resources consistent with applicable policies

  • Maintains current knowledge and comprehension of dynamic scientific and clinical environment in the Company's Areas of Interest (AOI) for your specific therapeutic area

Research

  • Upon Request from Global Center for Scientific Affairs (GCSA)

    • Initiates discussions with SLs and/or potential investigators that include scientific/data exchange within our AOI to determine the alignment with our research strategies, studies concepts, scientific merit, and qualifications for a specific compound or trial

    • Enhances the comprehension of the scientific foundations and goals of investigator-sponsored research

    • Identifies barriers to patient enrollment and retention efforts to achieve study milestones

  • Upon Request from Global Clinical Trial Operations (GCTO)

    • Recommends study sites and identifies potential investigators to participate in phase II-IV clinical development programs, conducts Site Initiation Visits (SIVs), and detects barriers to patient enrollment and retention efforts to achieve study milestones

    • Protocol lead responsibilities in collaboration with GCTO

    • Addresses questions from investigators and provides information regarding participation in Company-sponsored clinical studies

Scientific Congress Support

  • Engages in scientific congresses and medical meetings, facilitates scientific and data exchange for both Company and competitor data

Scientific Insights

  • Gathers feedback, data, or information during routine activities that can help the company better comprehend medical or scientific needs, priorities, or concerns of SLs and/or patients

Inclusive Mindset and Behavior

  • Work Independently and as a Team member with Integrity | Precision | Accomplishment | Motivational Ambition | Respect | Inclusion

  • Demonstrates eagerness to contribute to an environment of belonging, and empowerment

  • Leads by example and serves as a role model for creating, leading, and retaining a workforce

  • Motivation to contribute to an environment of belonging, engagement, and empowerment

    • Working to transform the environment, culture, and business landscape

    • Leveraging to ensure business value, per global and inclusion strategy

    • Ensuring accountability to drive an inclusive culture

    • Strengthening the foundational elements

Required Location:

  • This role covers northern Texas (Dallas).

  • Candidates must reside within the territory.

  • Ability for travel up to 50% within the territory

Required Education

  • PhD, PharmD, DNP, DO, or MD

Required Experience | Skills | Knowledge

  • Proven competence and three years of relevant Immunology (Inflammatory Bowel Disease) experience beyond that obtained in the terminal degree program

  • Principled verbal and written communications

  • Ability to conduct doctoral-level discussions with key external stakeholders

  • Dedication to scientific excellence with a strong focus on scientific education and dialogue

  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and networking skills

  • Thorough comprehension of FDA, OIG, HIPAA, and other ethical guidelines, laws, and regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry and its customers

  • Ability to organize, prioritize, and work effectively in a constantly changing environment

  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Teams, OneNote)

  • Familiarity with virtual meeting platforms

Preferred Experience | Skills | Knowledge

  • Additional experience in Immunology Rheumatology and/or Dermatology

  • Field-based medical experience

  • Research Experienced

  • Demonstrated record of scientific/medical publication

Job Description:

Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact as a Senior Technical Training Specialist, supporting the Defense Health Agency (DHA), who is committed to medical excellence, health care improvement and ensuring military personnel are ready to perform combat operations and humanitarian missions at home and abroad. GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to challenging projects and grow a rewarding career.

At GDIT, people are our differentiator. As a Senior Technical Training Specialist, our work depends on providing information technology technical and program management expertise to Defense Health Networks and their Medical Treatment Facilities (MTF). The Market Technology Integration Office (MTIO) Division delivers the Geographic Service Leads (GSL) model to the Military Health System (MHS) CIOs. Through the GSL model, the division provides Program Management Support, Enterprise Resource Planning and Management, Enterprise Schedule Management, Performance Management, Change Management, Technical Support Services, Financial Management, and Internal Communications support to the MTFs within their health network/geographic market.

HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT:


  • Prepares and modifies training modules, artifacts, videos, and other materials to meet the latest mission requirements, as established by the customer
  • Prepares and modifies training modules, artifacts, videos, and other materials to meet the latest mission requirements as established by the customer
  • Trains personnel through formal classroom (in person and virtual) courses, workshops, and seminars
  • Develops, updates, and maintains innovative computer-based training materials, courses, and systems in support of the DHA and J-6 mission
  • Develops tests and visual aids, conducts training classes, and develops criteria for evaluating effectiveness of training activities
  • Keeps abreast of training and development research: learning theory, motivation theory, and new materials, methods, and techniques
  • Conducts research to develop and revise training courses, and uses knowledge to recommend training strategies, establish training approaches, and prepare appropriate training materials
  • Conducts peer reviews of all training content to ensure accuracy and quality in accordance with DHA’s professional certification and development requirements
  • Manages a feedback system to capture data and metrics from participants and uses that information to constantly improve the training program
  • Manages professional certification training, validation, and verification systems supporting local Information Technology staff at MTFs and OLB sites and PEO MS / CIO J-6 personnel
  • Collaborates with other training offices and functions on training initiatives and standards as required by DHA
  • Researches and recommends training venue locations for live, in-person classroom training
  • Plans training venue logistics, organizes training events, and produces travel, lodging, and venue cost projections and documentation using DHA-required templates
  • Plans and executes equipment requirements for training venues including performing setup, configurations, testing, equipment maintenance, break down and travel logistics
  • Other duties as assigned

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED:


  • Education: Bachelor's degree in a related discipline, or the equivalent combination of education, professional training, or work experience
  • Required Experience: 5+ years of related experience
  • Required Technical Skills: Ability to design and deliver programs to train all levels of personnel; Experience training personnel through formal classroom (in person and virtual) courses, workshops, and seminars; Knowledge of the use of Microsoft Office products, Adobe training and related applications; Ability to work with stakeholders to assess potential risks; Ability to translate business requirements into non-technical and technical documents; Skilled in identifying and addressing client needs, actively participating in client discussions and meetings; preparing concise, accurate documents
  • Attributes for Success: Must be organized, self-motivated and able to multitask in a fast paced and dynamic work environment; Demonstrated ability to excel both independently and as a team member in a lively, collaborative environment
  • Preferred Skills: 6+ years of related experience preferred; Adobe Certified Professional - Adobe Captivate; ITIL 4 Foundation certification; Prior DoD experience; Defense Health Agency or Military Health System experience a plus
  • Location: Remote working 100%; Must be available to travel for training events and customer meetings; Work Hours: Monday-Friday 9am-5pm (40 hours – flexible work schedule)
  • Security Clearance Level: Ability to obtain a Public Trust (NACI-T1)
  • US Citizenship Required

This is a remote position.

Drishti Clarity LabJob Opening — Growth Marketing Manager

QUICK FACTS

  • Position: Growth Marketing Manager
  • Company: MaxFate Pvt Ltd — Drishti Clarity Lab
  • Location: Mathura, UP / Remote
  • Experience: 2–4 years (D2C / E-commerce / Agency, Meta Ads)
  • Salary: ₹40,000 – ₹50,000/month + performance bonus
  • Reporting: Founder (CEO) — weekly 30-minute data review

WHERE WE ARE GOING (Our 3-Year Vivid Vision) We are already at 1 lakh customers today — and by 2029, Drishti Clarity Lab will serve 10 lakh paying customers: people who do NOT believe in magic. They understand accountability, and they come to us for clarity and a real action plan that helps them move forward — not vague predictions. We are the most trusted name where Vedic wisdom meets behavioral science, profitable and growing without burning money on ads. And just as our customers believe in action over magic, we need team members who are action-oriented and believe in action, not magic.

If that future excites you, read on. If it does not, this role is not for you — and that is okay.

ABOUT US Our goal is to guide people who are under mental stress because they cannot make the right decisions. These life confusions directly hurt their health, wealth and relationships. We pull them out of that confusion and give them complete clarity — along with a clear, action-oriented blueprint — so their stalled growth and happiness can return.

Drishti Clarity Lab (DCL) blends 20 years of Vedic astrology expertise with modern behavioral science. We deliver personalized clarity blueprints to an Indian audience, primarily through Meta Ads. We are a small, self-funded team that has reached profitability — now we need one sharp owner to take us from steady to scaled.

HOW WE WORK (Our Values) We live by Satya (truth). We only sell what we genuinely believe in. If you are someone who will sell anything to anyone, we are not the right fit. We want an honest operator who builds long-term trust.

THE ROLE (Read This Carefully) This is NOT a "just run ads" job. You will OWN revenue, not just channel metrics. Like a second-in-command, you take our growth engine end-to-end: bring new customers in efficiently, fix where they drop off, and — most importantly — get more value from the 1 lakh+ customers who already trust us.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS We believe in clear targets, decided by data and gut together. By day 90, you will have:

  • Re-activated our existing customer base — generated measurable repeat revenue from the 1 lakh+ past buyers (your #1 mission).
  • Moved CPA closer to our ₹200 target, with stable, profitable campaigns.
  • Reduced our Add-to-Cart to Checkout drop-off (currently ~23%) through tested funnel fixes.
  • Set up a clean weekly reporting rhythm so the whole team sees the numbers honestly.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN (Ongoing)

  • Meta Ads: daily optimization, preventing learning-phase resets, killing underperformers fast.
  • Funnel: landing-page and retargeting experiments to plug leaks.
  • Repeat Revenue: email, WhatsApp and retargeting to existing customers; revive high-value offers that worked before.
  • Copywriting: write high-converting ad scripts (Hindi/Hinglish) and landing-page copy that speaks to our audience and drives action.
  • Data analysis: read the numbers across Meta Ads, CRM and analytics — spot what's working and what's not, and make decisions from data, not guesses.
  • Data discipline: track everything in our Zoho ecosystem; report honestly, no guesswork.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • 2–4 years running Meta Ads for a D2C / e-commerce brand or agency.
  • Proven ability to tie your work to revenue, not just clicks/impressions.
  • Comfortable with numbers — basic Excel/analytics, funnel thinking.
  • Bonus: Hindi-speaking / Tier 2-3 audience experience, and retention/upsell experience.
  • Strong copywriting — can write ad scripts and landing-page copy in Hindi/Hinglish that actually converts (please share samples).
  • Solid data analysis — comfortable reading dashboards, finding patterns, and drawing conclusions from numbers.
  • Owner mindset — you want to grow into a second-in-command, not just clock hours.

PROOF OF DELIVERY — This Is Non-Negotiable We do not hire on talk. We hire on evidence. In your interview you must be ready to SHOW, not just tell:

  • Screen-share a real account, dashboard, or report you personally built or ran (Meta Ads Manager, a tracking sheet, an analytics dashboard, a campaign result).
  • Bring at least one written record / screenshot / short screen-recording (even a 5-minute video) that proves a result you delivered — with before and after numbers.
  • Every achievement you claim must come with specific numbers and dates. "I increased sales" is rejected. "Jan to Jun 2024, I grew revenue 47%, from ₹2cr to ₹2.94cr" is what we want.

If you cannot show proof of what you have done, please do not apply.

TWO QUESTIONS THAT WILL DECIDE YOUR APPLICATION Answer both in 4–5 lines each, with numbers:

  • Q1: Describe one time you generated revenue from an EXISTING customer base (not new acquisition). What did you do, and what was the measurable result?
  • Q2: Tell us about one project or campaign that completely FAILED. What happened, what was your part in it, and what did you learn?

(There is no right answer to Q2. Saying nothing ever failed is itself a red flag.)

OUR HIRING PROCESS (Please Read) We follow hire slow, fire fast. Our process has clear stages:

  1. You read our Vivid Vision (sent with this), and reply with "Please interview me" if the future excites you.
  2. Interview rounds where you show proof of your work (see above).
  3. Reference checks: before the final round, we WILL call your past managers. Please keep their names and contacts ready. (A-players are happy about this; it is a chance to shine.)
  4. After joining, the first 90 days decide long-term fit, measured against the clear targets above.

HOW TO APPLY Send the following to :

  1. Your CV / portfolio.
  2. Your written answers to Q1 and Q2 above.
  3. At least one proof (screenshot / dashboard link / short video) of a result you personally delivered.
  4. One line: best CPA you personally achieved, for what product, at what monthly ad spend.
  5. One writing sample: an ad script or landing-page copy you wrote (Hindi/Hinglish preferred).

  • Acts with integrity in accordance with AbbVie code of business conduct and leadership values. Self-motivated individual focused on delivering timely and quality outcomes in a fast-paced environment.

Job Summary

Wabtec is seeking a PSIRT Analyst – Product Cybersecurity tojoin its Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT). The role will beresponsible for supporting the identification, assessment, triage, andcoordination of cybersecurity vulnerabilities and security incidents affectingWabtec's global product portfolio.

The candidate will work closely with Product Security, EnterpriseInformation Security, Engineering, Product Development, and other globalstakeholders to evaluate vulnerabilities, determine productapplicability and risk, coordinate response activities, and support timelycommunication and remediation.

This position requires a strong understanding of vulnerability management,cybersecurity incident response, threat intelligence, and vulnerabilityassessment frameworks such as CVE, CWE, and CVSS.

KeyResponsibilities

  • Monitor and manage PSIRT intake channels, including vulnerability reporting mailboxes, reporting portals, security tools, and dashboards.
  • Review, classify, acknowledge, and track reported vulnerabilities and security events in accordance with defined SLAs.
  • Perform initial vulnerability validation, applicability assessment, and impact analysis for Wabtec products.
  • Analyze vulnerabilities using CVE, CWE, and CVSS methodologies.
  • Assess vulnerability severity, exploitability, potential impact, and business/product risk.
  • Register and maintain accurate vulnerability records, evidence, status, and required metadata in vulnerability management tools.
  • Escalate vulnerabilities and security incidents in accordance with established escalation procedures.
  • Coordinate with Product Security, Engineering, Enterprise Information Security, and other stakeholders during vulnerability investigations and response activities.
  • Participate in security war rooms and emergency response activities when required.
  • Support the development, review, and distribution of security advisories and vulnerability notifications.
  • Monitor relevant threat intelligence sources, including CISA KEV, CISA advisories, vendor security notifications, and other trusted sources.
  • Conduct threat analysis based on vulnerability characteristics, exploitability, affected products, and available threat intelligence.
  • Support the vulnerability disclosure process, including coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Participate in a documented on-call rotation to support continuous coverage for product security incidents and vulnerability response.

About Us

Ovation Law Firm is a fast-growing, consumer-focused law firm committed to delivering exceptional legal services while fostering a high-performance, accountable, and supportive workplace. As we continue to scale, we are building strong quality controls to ensure consistency, compliance, and excellence across every stage of the client lifecycle.

About the Role

We are seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Quality Assurance Specialist to support the firm’s QA function within the Intake Department. This role reports to the QA Manager and works closely with Intake Leadership and Training to ensure that every client interaction meets firm standards from the very first point of contact.

You will be responsible for monitoring and evaluating live and recorded intake calls, scoring interactions against predefined quality criteria and providing clear, actionable feedback to help intake agents continuously improve. Your work will directly impact compliance, client experience and the overall effectiveness of the intake process.

Strong English communication skills are essential for success in this role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor and evaluate live and recorded intake calls to assess agent performance, script adherence and compliance.
  • Score calls using predefined quality criteria, ensuring consistency and objectivity in all evaluations.
  • Ensure intake agents follow approved scripts, ask all required qualifying questions and provide accurate, compliant information to callers.
  • Identify misleading statements, missed disclosures, compliance risks or deviations from firm standards.
  • Provide clear, actionable feedback and coaching recommendations to the QA Manager, Intake Leadership and Training teams.
  • Flag recurring errors, trends, and systemic quality issues observed across intake calls.
  • Maintain detailed QA documentation, scorecards and audit trails for all evaluations completed.
  • Track and report quality metrics and performance trends to the QA Manager on a regular cadence.
  • Support the development and refinement of QA guidelines, evaluation forms and scoring benchmarks.
  • Participate in calibration sessions to ensure alignment and consistency across the QA team.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives within the Intake Department.

Qualifications

  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) with strong verbal and written communication skills in both languages (C1 level).
  • At least 1 year of experience in quality assurance, call monitoring or customer service auditing, preferably in a law firm, call center or regulated environment.
  • Strong analytical, listening, and critical-thinking skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to identify compliance risks and handle sensitive issues with professionalism and confidentiality.
  • Experience providing structured, constructive feedback based on objective evaluation criteria.
  • Tech-savvy, with hands-on experience using call monitoring tools, CRM systems and spreadsheets for tracking and reporting. Proficient in Microsoft Office, Slack and Google Workspace.
  • Strong time management skills with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience supporting legal teams or working in a law firm environment.
  • Lemon law, consumer protection, or high-volume intake experience.
  • Experience with QA scorecards, evaluation frameworks, or reporting dashboards.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Five9 or similar CRM platforms.

Requirements

  • Ability to work independently from a home office with stable, high-speed internet and a quiet, professional workspace.
  • Must have a laptop or desktop computer with a minimum of 16GB RAM and an Intel Core i5 processor or higher.
  • Must have a stable internet connection with a minimum speed of 50 Mbps.
  • Availability to work during U.S. business hours (PST).
  • Willingness to use time-tracking software.

What We Offer

  • Earn $5-$6/hour.
  • Competitive hourly pay based on skills and experience (full-time, 40 hours/week).
  • 100% remote work environment.
  • 6 paid time-off (PTO) days per year.
  • Opportunity to work closely with leadership and legal professionals in a growing, modern law firm.
  • Long-term growth and stability in a high-impact operational role.

raw.description:
Superside is reinventing how its people learn, and we're looking for someone to help bring that vision to life in practical, AI-powered ways.

As an AI Enablement and Learning Specialist, you'll join the Learning Enablement and Transformation team. You'll work closely with the person leading our learning strategy, turning goals and ideas into working solutions: Claude-supported resources, automated workflows, and well-organized knowledge that people can actually find and use. You'll also keep the systems and knowledge behind our learning programs in good order, so everything runs smoothly with little manual effort.

This isn't a traditional L&D role. If you love working with information, enjoy building with AI and automation tools, and care about how people learn, you'll feel at home here. You'll work independently, from ideas and open problems rather than step-by-step briefs, in a fully remote, ambitious, async-first team.

What you'll do

  • Research practical, AI-powered ways to deliver on our learning goals, and recommend what's worth implementing.

  • Prototype Claude-supported learning resources and automations, and turn the best ones into working solutions.

  • Build and launch new learning initiatives, from first idea to something people use.

  • Run and improve async onboarding, so new joiners get a smooth, mostly automated experience.

  • Organize and maintain our learning knowledge, so it's easy to find, trust and keep up to date.

  • Automate enrolments, reminders, tracking and reporting across our learning systems.

  • Look after our learning systems and tools such as Sana LMS, Notion, Claude so they stay reliable and easy to use.

  • Create learning content when needed, such as short modules, guides and resources.

  • Work with stakeholders across the company to understand their learning needs and turn them into practical solutions.

What you'll need to succeed

  • Strong experience organizing and managing knowledge: structuring information, keeping it current, and making it easy to use.

  • Hands-on experience building with AI, and a real curiosity about what's possible next.

  • Experience with workflow automation tools and a comfort with the technical side of things.

  • A systems mindset: you see how the pieces connect, and you follow through until it works.

  • Comfort solving problems from ambiguity, turning an idea or a rough goal into a clear plan.

  • A people-first approach: you think about the learner and their experience, not just the tool.

  • Experience in learning and development, HR, enablement, or a related field is a plus, though it's not the centre of the role.

  • Experience with learning platforms (such as an LMS) is a plus.

  • Ability to create clear, simple learning content and communications.

  • Proactive and independent: you don't wait for step-by-step instructions.

  • Great written communication in English, and comfort working async in a remote team.

Why Join us?

Superside's vision is to create equal opportunities globally by accelerating the world’s transition to online work. With that in mind, we're building a fully remote company that attracts people where they are.

Remote-first. Customer-led.

Remote isn’t just a perk; it’s how we deliver better for customers. We are fully committing to our customers by hiring top talent and collaborating seamlessly across time zones.

Global team, local impact.

Join a community of 60+ nationalities working across time zones, cultures, and disciplines, all aligned on doing great work for great brands.

High performance, low ego.

Work in a fast-paced, high-trust environment where feedback is direct, growth is constant, and kindness leads collaboration.

Impact meets opportunity.

We’re in the sweet spot — big enough to be stable, small enough for you to shape what’s next. Your ideas will matter here.

Grow fast. Lead well.

You’ll gain mentorship, take on real responsibility, and grow your career while helping us disrupt a global industry.

About Superside

Superside is the leading AI-powered creative company that quickly and cost-effectively enhances in-house functions. We help over 500 ambitious brands get great creative concepts done at scale. Built to be an extension
of in-house teams, we unbottleneck marketing and creative teams so they can move faster and drive more reliable creative performance.
Superside is a fully remote company with over 700 team members working across 60+ countries and 13 timezones.

We are looking for our next Project Manager with experience in clinical drug development and leading cross-functional projects in the late phase. This position is fully remote and open to candidates based on the US Eastern Time Zone.

As a Project Manager at Antaros Medical, you will manage the execution of the assigned clinical trials where the imaging part has been outsourced to Antaros Medical as well as internal methodology studies, other research studies and collaborations. The Project Manager ensures that all deliveries are completed with high quality and on time and in accordance with all applicable legislation and regulations.

As a Project Manager, you will oversee the imaging part of the project in clinical trials.

Here are the key responsibilities:

  • Leading the Antaros project activities and ensuring that trial tasks and deliverables are planned, executed, and delivered on time and to a high-quality standard.

  • Responsible for acting as the primary contact with the Sponsor/CRO.

  • Responsible for managing the trial budget, by reviewing it throughout the trial lifecycle, escalating any issues when the budget is out of range and reconciling the budget at the trial's end.

  • Accountable for motivating, leading, and inspiring others both within and outside Clinical Operations.

  • Risk management responsibility and document lessons learned for assigned projects.

What are we looking for?

  • Decision making:You should have strong decision-making skills, including the ability to solve problems, identify project-related issues, provide effective solutions, and determine whether issues need escalation to upper management.

  • Technical, Clinical and Quality Knowledge:You should have good collaboration and coordination skills to exchange technical, clinical, and quality options and ensure alignment with organisational goals.

  • Analytical Skills:You should have good analytical skills, including the ability to oversee the clinical strategies, create financial forecasts, and measure performance.

  • Organisational Leadership:When needed, you should also have the ability to analyse project risks and propose mitigation plans in collaboration with upper management.

  • Communication and Collaboration Skills:You should have the ability to make effective planning and decision-making, and lead and motivate cross-functional teams to achieve the goal. You should also have good communication and presentation skills to effectively structure material to allow easy decision-making. Fluency in written and spoken English is also required.

Are you interested?

We are happy to hear! Please submit your application via this link, no later than October 16th, 2026. We will contact and interview candidates continuously throughout the recruitment process, so don’t wait with your application!

We only accept applications via our recruitment system, Teamtailor. The recruitment is handled by Antaros Medical.

At Antaros Medical, we combine ground-breaking imaging with profound experience in drug development and deep knowledge of disease mechanisms. We are specialized in cardiorenal & metabolic disease. We have a global network of collaboration partners and customers, including both Big Pharma and Biotechs, and several European collaboration initiatives such as Innovative Medicines Initiative (IMI).

Antaros Medical delivers both small, complex, mechanistic studies as well as large, streamlined multi-center clinical trials utilizing our innovative imaging methods. Our global headquarters and analysis Corelab are based in Sweden. If you want to find out more about our company, please go to our website: .

raw.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

We are seeking a strategic Senior Contracts Procurement Manager to lead our contract management function and forge supplier partnerships. The Senior Contracts Procurement Manager at Instacart will serve as a key point of contact, enforcing our enterprise-wide strategy, governance, and execution of procurement contracting.

Reporting to the Head of Procurement, this role drives business-term negotiations, ensures seamless partnership with organizations such as Legal and Third Party Review (TPRM), and delivers measurable value through risk-adjusted, cost-optimized agreements. The Contracts Senior Manager balances commercial agility with rigorous compliance to enable Instacart’s scalable growth.

What you'll cook up in your first year

Governance

  • Procurement contract policies, playbooks, and templates are developed and enforced in lockstep with Legal, TPRM, and Finance, with clean documentation maintained to support SOX and internal audit processes.
  • KPIs including contract cycle time and compliance rates are tracked and reported, with routine performance updates presented to stakeholders.

Business-Term Negotiations

  • Strategic, high-value, and high-complexity contracts are personally led through the full procurement contract lifecycle, securing optimal outcomes across SLAs, scope, exit clauses, payment terms, and auto-renewals.

The Tax Senior Associate serves as a key member of engagement teams supporting a client portfolio with a primary focus on high-net-worth individuals, families, and their related entities, including family investment partnerships, trusts, estates, closely held businesses, and investment entities. The role also provides support to other clients based on experience and business needs.

This individual primarily prepares complex tax returns and workpapers, supports tax compliance and planning matters, and coordinates assigned engagement activities. As experience and engagement needs warrant, the Tax Senior Associate may also review work prepared by Associates. The individual communicates with clients and engagement leaders, mentors Associates, collaborates with Managers, Senior Managers, Partners, and specialty tax professionals, and continues building the technical and leadership skills needed to progress within the firm.


Responsibilities:


  • Support a client portfolio focused primarily on high-net-worth individuals, families, and related trusts, family investment partnerships, closely held businesses, and investment entities, while also supporting other clients within the team's portfolio.

  • As experience and engagement needs warrant, review basic federal, state, and local tax returns and related workpapers for accuracy and completeness under manager supervision, ensuring compliance with firm standards and tax regulations.
  • Coordinate day-to-day activities on assigned engagements, including tracking open items, monitoring deadlines, communicating status, and escalating technical, staffing, or timing issues to engagement leaders.
  • Communicate with clients and their advisors to gather information, resolve routine questions, provide engagement updates, and support year-round tax compliance and planning activities under the direction of engagement leaders.
  • Assist with tax planning and the resolution of complex tax compliance issues by conducting technical research, summarizing findings, collaborating with Federal, SALT, and other specialty professionals, and escalating issues or recommendations to engagement leaders as appropriate.
  • Perform thorough self-review of work to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with firm and professional standards.
  • Mentor Associates through day-to-day training, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing while modeling strong client service and teamwork.
  • Maintain proficiency in firm technology and tax systems while supporting team members in their effective use.
  • Identify opportunities to connect clients with KSM specialists and additional services, communicating opportunities to Managers and engagement leaders.
  • Stay current on federal, state, and local tax laws, regulatory developments, and industry trends to support clients and engagement teams.
  • Contribute to firm, practice, and operational initiatives that improve processes, enhance the client experience, and support strategic priorities.

Requirements/Qualifications:


  • CPA license or active progress towards CPA license strongly preferred
  • Minimum of 3 years of related experience in public accounting with a strong technical background in high-net-worth individual taxation
  • Bachelors or Master's degree in accounting
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Exceptional organizational skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Client (internal and external) service oriented
  • Creative and persistent problem solver
  • Ability to handle sensitive situations and confidential information
  • Flexible and adaptable
  • Ability to coordinate and maintain follow-up on a number of projects simultaneously

Job Type: B2B Contract

Location: Netherlands

Workplace: Remote

Requirements

  • University Degree and at least 8 years of IT professional experience;
  • Minimum of 3 of dedicated experience working as a Scrum Master at SM2 level or above;
  • Led at least 2 production teams through full sprint cycles (planning, review, retrospective, and refinement);
  • Implemented data-driven continuous improvement initiatives, such as increasing team velocity or reducing lead time;
  • Experience coordinating cross-team work via Scrum-of-Scrums or PI Planning events;
  • Deep knowledge of the Scrum Guide and Agile Manifesto principles and values;
  • Good knowledge of facilitation techniques (e.g., Fist of Five, participatory decision-making, Liberating Structures);

  • Good knowledge of team motivation and stakeholder engagement techniques (e.g., information radiators, team empowerment models);
  • Good knowledge of Agile metrics (velocity, cycle time, burn-up/down charts, cumulative flow diagrams) and the ability to build and interpret dashboards to support team performance and forecasting;
  • Tool proficiency in Azure DevOps (preferred) or Jira, particularly in backlog management, dashboards, and workflow configuration;
  • Possession of Scrum Master certifications: PSM II (or higher) and SAFe 5/6 Agilist;
  • Experience with one or more scaled Agile frameworks (SAFe, Nexus, LeSS, etc.) is considered as an asset;

  • Excellent command of the English language.

Responsibilities

  • Support the team in using agile planning and development tools (e.g. Azure DevOps, Confluence);
  • Experiment with new practices and frameworks to improve team outcomes;
  • Actively participate in learning opportunities such as communities of practice or conferences to improve skills and better support the team;
  • Contribute to the advancement and improvement of agile practices within the organization.

We are more than a health system. We are a belief system. We believe wellness and sickness are both part of a lifelong partnership, and that everyone could use an expert guide. We work hard, care deeply and reach further to help people uncover their own power to be healthy. We inspire hope. We learn, grow, and achieve more – in our careers and in our communities.

Job Description Summary:

This position conducts professional coding audits of clinical coding records across inpatient, outpatient, observation, emergency department, and all OhioHealth Physician Group (OPG) clinic service lines. The Education and Quality Analyst provides education to physicians, coders, failed claims specialists, and clinical documentation specialists regarding coding, billing, clinical documentation, and coding compliance. The analyst also collaborates with medical staff to address coding queries across all OPG clinic service lines. In addition, the Coding Education and Quality Analyst helps ensure that coding and billing for patient services comply with governmental program requirements and the contractual obligations of non-governmental payers. This position is also responsible for preparing and submitting responses to third-party audits, including those conducted by insurance companies. The analyst evaluates the quality and productivity of new hires and coders who are subject to quality monitoring. Quality-monitoring results are shared with coding management to support performance improvement efforts and, when appropriate, the development of work improvement plans.

Responsibilities And Duties:

40%
Documentation Audit This position conducts facility and charge entry audits of all Hospital, Neighborhood Care, Vascular Interventional Radiology, Rehab and clinic coding records. This includes inpatient, outpatient, observation, emergency department, vascular interventional radiology diagnostic and clinic service lines. Works with Clinical Documentation Improvement staff and Data Quality Engineers to ensure accurate capture and reporting of Hospital and Physician Quality Indicators for external reporting purposes. Monitors and tracks PQRI reports as applicable to individual practitioners and Operations staff. Reviews MediRegs, research of federal regulations, coding rules and regulations, and other reference material. Communicates coding and compliance updates to appropriate staff including physicians and management as appropriate. Assists Coding Management and Failed Claims with resolution of unbilled and billed claim rejections related to coding and documentation as well as other facility departments regarding coding and charge issues as applicable. Ensures encounter forms are updated and compliant.

35%

Education The Education and Quality Analyst educates physicians, coders, failed claims specialists and clinical documentation specialists on coding, vascular interventional radiology, billing, clinical documentation and coding compliance. Communicates coding and compliance updates to all coding staff and failed claims. Also educates other departments and individuals as necessary regarding coding rules, documentation guidelines and charge issues. Will be primarily responsible for ICD-10 CM/PCS education for entire OhioHealth System.
15%
Physician Queries Responsible for interacting with medical staff for all coding queries for all Central Ohio Hospitals.
10%
Policy and Procedural Development/Other Duties Assists in development of policies and procedures crossing multiple department lines. All other duties as assigned.

Day

40
