raw.description:
Description

Description Section for Assignment in VMS (Flextrack):

The MTO COMPASS Advanced Traffic Management System (ATMS) allows Traffic Operation Centres to monitor the traffic and road conditions of selected provincially maintained highways; as well as control in real time all the field traffic control assets through MTOs private COMPASS fibre network. Oracle Database Appliance (ODA) with Virtual Machine (VM) provisioning and Oracle Weblogic Application Server are two key components within the COMPASS ATMS environment.

Two (2) ODA-X9 are currently in operation in the COMPASS ATMS environment since 2023 and have been running Oracle 19C database with two-node RAC configuration, Fusion Middleware (Weblogic) VMs and also hosted other COMPASS application VMs. The ODA development environment has been set up to mirror the production environment. Oracle Dataguard is deployed for the 19C database and Oracle Cloud Control software is used as grid management tools, supporting

the 24x7 operation of the province-wide COMPASS ATMS system.

As the existing service provided by the Data Architect/Modeller through IT source is ending on March 31, 2025, the new service contract is required to maintain the COMPASS systems production and backup Oracle Database Appliances and to provide preventive maintenance support to COMPASS operations in order to continue support of the 24x7 COMPASS operations and applications as well as ongoing system migration activities.

ITS Office oversees the COMPASS ATMS environment and performs all required testing on the development environment prior to the production rollout. Under this contract, all the Oracle components on both production and development environment shall be maintained regularly and upgraded to conform with Oracle support level and certification requirements.

Responsibilities/Assignment Deliverables

This project involves the following tasks to ensure the 24x7 operation of the province-wide COMPASS systems production and backup Oracle Database Appliance (ODA).

1. Provide technical support in COMPASS production database and application update and migration activities. Services include but not limited to the following:

  • Upgrade the Oracle Cloud Control infrastructure to latest version

- Update/reconfigure ODA infrastructure

  • Update IP addresses of ODA infrastructure to the latest COMPASS VLAN topology

- Relocate and/or backup existing VMs

  • Re-create database and restore necessary VMs

- Create new VMs and/or databases

- Failover database to another ODA

2. Provide preventive maintenance works. Key tasks involve but not limited to the following:

  • Monitor and review Oracle Enterprise Manager Cloud Control alerts

- Perform regular ODA health checks

- Conduct space analysis and checks

  • Install the latest patches (including latest released Oracle security patches), in the ODA database and Weblogic in both production and backup environment

- Maintain the Cloud Control platform

  • Maintain the Production and Standby Emergency Backup environment and user access control
  • Provide system support to resolve issue related to Oracle database, Fusion Middleware (Weblogic), Cloud Control and JEOS VMs.

3. Interface with Oracle on behalf of the Client on the following:

  • Manage ODA related incidents and Service Requests (SR)
  • Coordinate hardware repair/replacement of the ODAs

The consultant must work closely with the client and will undertake and manage the tasks in close collaboration with the Client. The successful consultant shall meet with the Clients team on a frequent basis as deemed required by each task.

The consultant must have practical experience in:

  • ODA migration in complex production system environment
  • Deploying and maintaining ODA X9-2HA and X9-2L
  • Installing, deploying, upgrading and maintaining ODA VM provisioning including the latest versions of Oracle database, Weblogic, Oracle Fusion Middleware, and Linux Just Enough Operation System (JEOS) VMs.

Current COMPASS ODA Configurations:

ODA-X9 (to operate in production environment, pending completion of migration activities):

One ODA X9-2HA with VM Provisioning (not bare-metal) base configuration

One ODA X9-2L with VM Provisioning (not bare-metal) base configuration

Oracle 19C Enterprise Edition (subject to change)

Weblogic with Fusion Middleware (Forms/Reports) are running as VMs on the same ODA

Weblogic Managed Server are running as VMs on the same ODA

Oracle Cloud Control is running on all ODAs and its VMs

COMPASS ATMS Distributed Functions java programs are running as standalone JEOS VM on ODA DOMx (DOM1, DOM2, etc) [NK1]

Experience and Skill Set Requirements for Assignment in VMS (Flextrack):

Skill Set Requirements

One (1) Specialized IT Consultant

  • Practical experience in installing, deploying and provisioning Oracle DB Systems, Oracle 19C Database, VMs and Oracle Weblogic.
  • Practical expertise in Oracle Database Appliance (ODA) X9 Model Family
  • Practical expertise in Oracle Standby Database Architecture
  • Practical expertise in building Oracle Virtual Machine (VM) and VM Template
  • Practical expertise in applying patches in ODA X9 Model Family
  • Practical expertise in Oracle Weblogic with Form and Report Services
  • Practical expertise in working with JEOS Linux
  • Project management competencies such as planning and organizational skills to be able to complete the deliverables in timeframe provided culminating with high quality results
  • Previous experience and performance of other similar projects
  • Demonstrated ability to build effective working relationship with clients
  • Written and spoken communication skills with respect to both formal presentations, reports and correspondence
  • Practical experience in Oracle Cloud Control
  • Practical experience in integrating WLS, JEOS and Cloud Control in ODA-X9 environment

Maintenance and Support Requirements

1. Oracle Certified Professional / Database Administrator

2. Oracle Implementation Certification in Oracle Database Appliance

3. Oracle Implementation Certification in Oracle Virtual Machine

4. Oracle Implementation Certification in Oracle Real Application Clusters

5. Oracle Implementation Certification in Oracle Database

6. Oracle Implementation Certification in Oracle Performance Tuning

7. Oracle Implementation Certification in Oracle Enterprise Manager Oracle Linux

Note: Please be advised that this is an in-demand Role, and the contractor will be contacted on a need-basis.

SkillsExperience and Skill Set Requirements

Evaluation Criteria

Technical Experience and Qualifications - 30%

  • Demonstrated practical experience in Oracle single-node DB systems and 2-node RAC DB systems on virtual machines within the last 5 years
  • Demonstrated practical experience in Oracle Standby Database Architecture and Oracle Data Guard within the last 5 years
  • Demonstrated practical experience in building Oracle Virtual Machine (VM) and VM Template
  • Demonstrated practical experience in Oracle Weblogic with Form and Report Service (WLS)
  • Demonstrated practical experience in Oracle Cloud Control

Project Management Skills - 20%

  • Demonstrated experience with project management and in completing deliverables in timeframe provided culminating with a high quality results
  • Proven experience deploying, installing, and managing other similar projects
  • Strong experience with building effective working relationship with clients
  • Strong written and spoken communication skills with respect to both formal presentations, reports and correspondence

ODA Experience - 50%

  • Demonstrated experience in Oracle Database Appliance (ODA) X9 Model Family
  • Demonstrated practical experience in applying patches in ODA X9 Model Family
  • Demonstrated practical experience in deploying, upgrading and managing Oracle Real
  • Application Cluster database (including backup/standby) in Oracle Database Appliance (ODA) Virtual Machine (VM) provisioning.
  • Demonstrated practical experience in deploying, upgrading and managing Oracle Fusion Middleware Weblogic (WLS) in ODA VM provisioning.
  • Demonstrated practical experience in deploying, upgrading and managing Just Enough OS (JEOS) Linux VM in ODA.
  • Demonstrated practical experience in deploying, upgrading and managing Oracle Cloud Control in ODA VM provisioning.
  • Demonstrated practical experience in integrating the WLS, JEOS and Cloud Control in the ODA VM provisioning.

Must haves:ODA X9-2HA and X9-2L

raw.title: Childcare Intake & Tour Booking Representative
raw.excerpt: About the Role We are looking for an upbeat, professional, and customer-focused Childcare Intake & Tour Booking Representative to be the first point of contact for families interested in childcare and early learning programs.
raw.description:
About the Role

We are looking for an upbeat, professional, and customer-focused Childcare Intake & Tour Booking Representative to be the first point of contact for families interested in childcare and early learning programs.

In this role, you will handle inbound enquiries from prospective families, follow up on leads, and help parents take the next step by booking tours at childcare centres. You will play an important role in creating a positive first impression, answering initial enquiries, and making it easy for families to connect with the right school.

The ideal candidate is confident on the phone, communicates clearly, and knows how to guide a conversation towards a confirmed booking without being pushy or overly sales-focused. You should be organised, comfortable using technology, and willing to follow established scripts and processes.

Previous experience is welcome but not essential. We are particularly interested in candidates who are coachable, eager to learn, and ready to develop their skills in a structured, customer-focused environment.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Inbound Calls & Family Enquiries

  • Answer inbound calls from prospective families interested in childcare centres and early learning programs.
  • Serve as the first point of contact, creating a friendly and professional experience for every caller.
  • Understand the family's enquiry and guide them towards booking an in-person centre tour.
  • Provide clear, accurate information using the client's approved scripts and resources.
  • Keep conversations focused and efficient while ensuring families feel heard and supported.

Tour Booking & Lead Conversion

  • Book in-person tours at childcare centres, aiming to secure the appointment during the initial call.
  • Follow up on website enquiries, Facebook leads, and other incoming requests.
  • Contact families who have missed scheduled tours or need to reschedule.
  • Confirm booking details and ensure appointments are recorded accurately.
  • Follow up with prospective families to encourage them to take the next step in the enrolment journey.

School & Schedule Coordination

  • Coordinate with childcare centres regarding same-day tour requests, late arrivals, and scheduling changes.
  • Communicate with school staff to confirm availability and manage last-minute adjustments.
  • Assist families with rescheduling and other appointment-related enquiries.
  • Ensure schools and families receive timely updates when arrangements change.

CRM & Administrative Support

  • Use Salesforce or similar CRM systems to access school information and manage bookings.
  • Accurately record enquiry details, call outcomes, follow-up activities, and tour appointments.
  • Navigate multiple systems efficiently while speaking with families.
  • Follow the client's established phone scripts, text templates, and booking procedures.
  • Maintain accurate records to support reporting, lead tracking, and team performance.

Performance & Quality

  • Work towards improving the percentage of enquiries converted into booked tours.
  • Maintain a high standard of professionalism and call quality.
  • Follow established processes and performance expectations.
  • Accept coaching and feedback to continuously improve communication and booking results.

Requirements

  • Excellent verbal communication skills and a clear, professional telephone manner.
  • Friendly, upbeat, and customer-focused personality.
  • Confidence speaking with prospective customers and guiding conversations towards a booking.
  • Strong listening skills and the ability to understand customer needs.
  • Good organisational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage calls, appointments, follow-ups, and changing schedules.
  • Comfortable working with computers and navigating multiple systems simultaneously.
  • Willingness to learn new software, scripts, and processes.
  • Coachable, adaptable, and able to work towards performance targets.
  • Reliable and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

Preferred Experience

Previous experience is beneficial but not essential. Relevant backgrounds include:

  • Call centre or contact centre operations.
  • Customer service or customer support.
  • Inbound sales or lead management.
  • Appointment setting or booking coordination.
  • Reservations or scheduling.
  • Reception or front-desk customer service.

Experience with Salesforce, other CRM platforms, or call management systems is an advantage.

Spanish language skills are a bonus but are not required.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Communication: Clear, friendly, and professional communication with prospective families.
  • Booking conversion: Ability to guide conversations towards securing a tour appointment.
  • Customer service: Creating a positive first impression and making families feel comfortable.
  • Organisation: Managing bookings, follow-ups, and scheduling changes accurately.
  • Technology: Comfortable learning and using CRM systems, call platforms, and digital tools.
  • Adaptability: Handling same-day requests, late arrivals, and unexpected changes.
  • Coachability: Willingness to follow scripts, accept feedback, and learn the client's processes.
  • Efficiency: Keeping calls focused and productive without making families feel rushed.

How Success Is Measured

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • The percentage of prospective families who book a tour after making an enquiry.
  • The quality and professionalism of calls.
  • Accurate booking records and follow-up activities.
  • Adherence to established scripts and processes.
  • Effective coordination with childcare centres and prospective families.

Who Would Be a Great Fit?

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys speaking with people, providing helpful service, and turning enquiries into meaningful next steps. You don't need extensive experience or a background in childcare. What matters most is your communication style, positive attitude, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.

If you're confident on the phone, comfortable with technology, and enjoy helping people find the right solution, we'd love to hear from you!

This is a remote position.

The employer develops a breakthrough high-performance onchain exchange that delivers institutional grade execution, whilst delivering superior speed, security and reliability guarantees to users. Their revolutionary decentralized exchange operates as the world's first trading-specific Based Rollup on Ethereum offering core competitive advantage : Unlike traditional Layer 2 solutions that rely on single sequencers, Based Rollup grants transaction sequencing rights directly to Ethereum validators, achieving true decentralization.

This design delivers significant benefits:
  • Speed:
  • Security: verifiable order execution and settlement, via zk-proofs, with executed trades settling on Ethereum. over 950,000 Ethereum validators securing every transaction. Transaction data ultimately settles on Ethereum mainnet, inheriting all L1 security guarantees.
  • Reliability: no single point of failure, with the rollup design having multiple rotating L2 nodes (unlike generation-1 rollups)

Their custom trading engine is written in Rust, achieving deterministic execution. Their engine is cross-compiled into zero-knowledge circuits, allowing the network to generate validity proofs for each state transition, ensuring provably correct order execution.

They’re looking for a Senior Rust/C++ Engineer based anywhere in Europe (Remote), to join their team
As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will play a crucial role in designing, developing and maintaining robust and scalable backend systems. Your role goes beyond writing code—you’ll architect systems that are resilient, secure, and optimized for low-latency, real-time processing.

MISSIONS

Backend Development: Design, develop, and maintain the core backend systems that power the company's DeX and Network. This includes writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code. The exchange backend will need to support a high-throughput order-book and index on-chain data into event queues and various persistence layers to be consumed by the UI and Risk Dashboards via scalable APIs and WebSockets.
System Architecture: Define the high-level structure of the backend systems, the data flow, and interactions between the various components of the backend stack. Focus on messaging and event-driven architecture patterns common in financial services.
Reliability, Performance & Availability: Ensure the architectural design addresses reliability and high availability and performance requirements. Implement failover mechanisms, redundancy, and disaster recovery plans to minimize downtime.
Security: Implement and maintain robust security measures to protect backend systems and APIs from a variety of attack patterns including but not limited to DDoS attacks, data breaches, injection attacks.
Data Storage Strategy: Define the strategy for data storage, including selection of databases and data models suitable for financial applications. Consider trade-offs between relational, key-value stores and messaging queues.
Testing Strategy: Develop and execute a comprehensive testing strategy including unit, integration, security, load and performance testing. Collaborate with the development team to create and maintain detailed test reports and testing processes.
Technological Evaluation: Stay updated on emerging technologies and trends in backend development and architecture. Evaluate the potential adoption of new tools, frameworks, and methodologies to enhance our systems' performance and scalability.
Documentation and Communication: Clearly document the architectural design, making it accessible to the development team and non-technical audience. Collaborate with software engineers to implement the design effectively and ensure that it aligns with the intended goals.
Code Review: Participate in code reviews, mentor junior engineers, and enforce coding standards and best practices.
Team Collaboration: Work closely with the cross-functional team, including on-chain and front end engineers as well as the heads of product management and quant, cto and ceo.

Requirements

The ideal candidate is someone who loves DeFi, web3, engineering, security, rigor and speed. A highly skilled Senior Backend engineer with over eight years of experience with a commitment to code quality and state-of-the-art software testing practices.

You are able to support the team with shipping robust and performant code,fast.

6+ years of experience with Rust and/or C++ building highly scalable webservices
Mastery of asynchronous programming and advanced concurrency patterns. Emphasis on thread safety and lock-free data structures.
6+ years of experience designing and maintaining relational databases like PosgreSQL
4+ years of experience with messaging and low latency persistence like Kafka, Redis, RabbitMQ or others
Experience in building and maintaining high-availability systems that have handled significant transaction volumes in a Web3 and trading environment
Experience with low-level network programming, including asynchronous I/O, direct socket programming, and familiarity with Linux kernel optimizations (e.g., epoll, zero-copy, or even kernel bypass techniques where applicable)

albo

albo is a leading fintech company offering financial products to individuals and SMBs with the mission to bring financial freedom to everyone everywhere.

About the role

As Financial Controller, you will lead albo's Accounting and FP&A teams, reporting directly to the CFO. You will own the accuracy and integrity of the group's financial results, financial regulatory reporting and internal controls. This is a senior, hands-on role combining technical review, team leadership and sound business judgment in a regulated fintech environment.

What you’ll be doing at albo:

  • Oversee the monthly, quarterly and annual close, delivering the monthly close by D+10. Review balance sheet, P&L and cash flow reporting, resolve material reconciliation issues and ensure accounting actuals align with FP&A before management reporting. Ensure entity financial statements follow applicable Mexican NIF and CNBV accounting criteria, and own consolidated IFRS reporting for the group.
  • Oversee high-volume reconciliations across operational systems, banks and the ledger, including payment settlements and loan portfolios. Review lending accounting with Accounting, Risks and Operations, covering interest and fees, IFRS 9 expected credit losses, write-offs and recoveries.
  • Oversee timely and accurate financial regulatory reporting to CNBV and Banco de México, in partnership with Compliance, ensuring compliance with applicable requirements for each regulated entity, including capital requirements and safeguarding and reconciliation of client funds.
  • Oversee the Head of Accounting and Tax in delivering SAT filings and payments, tax reconciliations and supporting documentation. Review material tax exposures and coordinate transfer pricing and cross-border matters with specialist advisers.
  • Lead coordination of external audits across Mexico and the UK, working with the Head of Accounting and Tax to ensure audit readiness and timely resolution of findings. Review group consolidation, intercompany eliminations and foreign currency translation, and coordinate UK statutory accounts and filing with Legal and advisers.
  • Oversee the annual budget and rolling forecasts, reviewing assumptions and timely variance analysis. Assess profitability and unit economics by product and segment, linking operational drivers to revenue, costs and cash flow to support business decisions.
  • Support the CFO with financial models, board reporting, investor materials and financial information for lenders. Review liquidity forecasts and monitor financial covenants with Treasury, escalating risks and potential breaches promptly.
  • Strengthen financial controls, close processes and reporting through NetSuite, automation and continuous improvement. Ensure clear ownership, review evidence and traceability from source data to financial reports, and track corrective actions to completion.
  • Advise teams across albo on accounting, tax and financial matters, reviewing new products, partnerships and funding arrangements with Accounting, FP&A, Treasury, Legal and Compliance.

About you and what type of skills you'll need:

  • 10+ years of experience in Accounting, Controlling or Finance, including direct responsibility for overseeing budgets, forecasts and financial analysis.
  • Proven experience leading and developing accounting and FP&A teams, setting clear accountability and reviewing technical and analytical deliverables.
  • Hands-on experience with applicable CNBV accounting criteria and financial regulatory reporting in a regulated Mexican financial institution. Experience with IFPEs, payments or lending is a plus.
  • Track record of delivering financial closes, external audits and regulatory reporting on time. Strong IFRS knowledge and experience with group consolidation and intercompany accounting; coordination of UK audits or statutory accounts is a plus.
  • Experience with NetSuite (Oracle) or a comparable ERP. Recent experience leading or participating in ERP implementations for groups with multiple legal entities is a plus.
  • Strong analytical and financial modeling skills, including profitability analysis, operational drivers and cash flow forecasting, with the judgment to translate numbers into business decisions.
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field. CPC certification is a plus.
  • Experience in fintech or high-growth companies is a plus.
  • Fluent professional English, both written and spoken, with the ability to lead technical accounting and financial discussions and communicate confidently with international auditors, investors and lenders.
  • This is a remote position for candidates based in Mexico City, with availability for in-person meetings when required.
  • Customer Centricity: You understand how accurate customer balances, timely reconciliations and safeguarding of client funds support trust and a reliable customer experience.

  • Communication: Excellent ability to communicate internally and externally, quickly build relationships, and work cross-functionally.

About Lyra

Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra members have access to care in one day, and nine out of ten improve with the support of providers like you. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. You will be contracted by Lyra Clinical Associates.

About the Role

Lyra is committed to addressing urgent and costly mental health needs with specialized support where it’s needed most. Our Center of Excellence for Neurodiversity offers neuropsychological and psychological assessments, diagnosis, and tailored care for ADHD, and support for autism and learning differences. We are looking for contractTesting Psychologists who are passionate about whole-person, whole-family mental health care.

The Testing Psychologist will perform comprehensive intake interviews and psychological assessments to support diagnostic clarity, treatment planning, and intervention strategies for children, adolescents, and adults. This role focuses on addressing behavioral health complexities, providing actionable insights through psychoeducational and psychological evaluations, and collaborating with interdisciplinary care teams to optimize outcomes.

This role is a great fit for providers who are results driven, detailed, process oriented, and comfortable with data. Candidates with an independent work ethic who are flexible and adaptable, we encourage you to apply.

Key responsibilities:

  • Work with patients of all ages is preferred, as well as their families, by providing intake interviews and psychological evaluations

  • Administer, interpret, and integrate a wide variety of psychological test batteries, focusing on cognitive, emotional, behavioral, and academic functioning

  • Provide clear, evidence-based diagnostic impressions and actionable recommendations tailored to the individual’s needs

  • Collaborate and review work with psychometrists and psychometrist assistants, overseeing test administration, scoring, and ensuring quality control

  • Deliver compassionate feedback through feedback videos and live sessions to communicate findings and recommendations

  • Maintain a detail-oriented, process-focused approach to ensure the accuracy of testing data and comprehensive reporting

  • Utilize telehealth platforms effectively for remote assessments, including adapting testing strategies for virtual delivery

  • Conduct intake interviews, testing sessions, and live feedback sessions, delivered virtually or in person, as indicated

Requirements:

  • Doctorate degree in Psychology (PhD or PsyD) from an American Psychological Association or Canadian Psychological Association accredited program

  • Licensed Clinical Psychologist in at least one state

  • PSYPACT authorized or PSYPACT eligible preferred

  • 3+ years of experience in psychological assessments with children, adolescents, or adults

  • Familiarity with evaluating complex behavioral health needs (e.g., ASD, ADHD, mood disorders, anxiety, trauma)

  • Expertise in psychological and psychoeducational assessment tools (e.g., BASC, Conners, WAIS, WISC)

  • Effective therapeutic communication skills

  • Proficiency with telehealth platforms and remote testing tools

  • Experience conducting testing virtually

  • Ability to deliver care virtually or in person and within your own office space

  • Candidates must successfully pass a background check for this opportunit

Here are some of the advantages of joining the Lyra + Bend network:

  • Connect with highly compatible clients who are a good fit for your clinical expertise
  • Support from caring and highly qualified, vetted psychometrists
  • Set your own schedule, without a minimum hours requirement
  • Focus less on the administrative burden of billing with Lyra’s paperless billing and quick payment turnaround
  • Have peace of mind with Lyra’s 24/7 Care Navigation team for client crisis support
  • Access to a robust offering of live and recorded CE credited courses (approved by APA, ASWB, and NBCC)
  • Access to cutting edge technology and a team of support staff (e.g., psychometrists, psychometrist assistants) to help ease the administrative burden of the evaluation process
  • Testing supplies are provided for you
We believe that our diverse perspectives are our biggest strengths, and that embracing them will create real change in healthcare. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to building an inclusive environment where you can be you.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information or any other category protected by law.

Please note that Lyra does not “sell” or “share” personal information as defined by the CPRA. For more information about how we use and retain your information, please see our Workforce Privacy Notice.

raw.excerpt: About DoppelDoppel is building the future of social engineering defense.
raw.description:
About Doppel

Doppel is building the future of social engineering defense. Our AI-native platform uses agentic AI to protect executives, employees, customers, and brands from phishing, impersonation, fraud, and other AI-powered threats across digital channels. Backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz and Bessemer Venture Partners, Doppel is a rapidly growing Series C company helping customers stay ahead of modern digital threats.

The Role

We are hiring our first dedicated Renewals Manager to build and run the renewals function at Doppel.

This is a builder role and a hands-on commercial role. You will not inherit a finished renewals organization or simply administer contracts. You will design the operating model while personally owning renewal execution across our customer base.

You will establish the systems, processes, forecasting discipline, commercial guardrails, segmentation, and cross-functional handoffs required to make renewals predictable and scalable. At the same time, you will be directly responsible for moving renewals from early planning through commercial negotiation, procurement, signature, and close.

You will partner closely with Customer Success Managers, Account Executives, CS Operations / RevOps, Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, and channel partners. Customer Success will continue to own customer value, adoption, health, and risk-recovery plans. You will own the commercial renewal motion and renewable ARR.

This is initially an individual-contributor role, with the opportunity to help define how the renewals organization should evolve as Doppel scales.

What You Will Do

Build the Renewals Function

  • Design and implement Doppel's scalable renewals operating model, including lifecycle stages, ownership, exit criteria, escalation paths, and rules of engagement.
  • Establish renewal motions for strategic, core, scaled, direct, channel, and auto-renewal customers.
  • Build a forward-looking renewal forecasting and inspection cadence that gives leadership reliable visibility into renewable ARR, expected renewals, churn, contraction, timing risk, and commercial blockers.
  • Define clear renewal stages, forecast categories, risk definitions, and Salesforce data requirements so the renewal book can be inspected consistently.
  • Develop playbooks, templates, customer and partner cadences, dashboards, reporting, and repeatable commercial workflows.
  • Partner with Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, Sales, and CS leadership to define commercial guardrails for standard uplifts, multi-year agreements, co-terming, concessions, downsells, payment terms, and non-standard exceptions.
  • Establish consistent churn and contraction reason codes and use renewal data to identify systemic retention risks and improvement opportunities.
  • Identify opportunities to automate renewal opportunity creation, reminders, quoting, risk detection, reporting, and administrative work using Salesforce, customer-success tooling, and AI.
  • Continuously refine the model as renewal volume and complexity grow, including recommending when additional renewal capacity or specialized coverage is required.

Run the Renewal Business

  • Personally own the end-to-end commercial renewal lifecycle across Doppel's customer base, from early planning through quote, negotiation, procurement, signature, and close.
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of the renewal book and ensure upcoming renewals are identified, validated, and actively managed well in advance of expiration.
  • Lead customer-facing renewal conversations covering pricing, uplift, term, multi-year options, scope changes, downsell, procurement, and contract execution.
  • Own standard renewal quotes and commercial execution, routing non-standard pricing or terms through DealHub and the appropriate approval process.
  • Maintain an accurate renewal forecast and provide evidence-based visibility into expected outcomes, churn and contraction exposure, timing risk, and blockers.
  • Partner with CSMs to translate account health, adoption, business outcomes, support history, stakeholder changes, and competitive signals into the renewal strategy.
  • Identify renewal risk early and drive the commercial components of mitigation plans alongside the CSM, AE, leadership, and executive sponsor.
  • Coordinate partner-led renewals and ensure Doppel, the partner, CSM, and AE are aligned on timing, pricing, scope, customer communication, and remaining steps to close.
  • Partner with AEs on combined renewal-and-expansion motions. Renewals remains accountable for the existing renewable ARR and renewal execution; the AE owns incremental expansion ARR. Together, you will create one coordinated customer-facing commercial strategy.
  • Manage complex renewal structures including multi-year terms, co-terming, product changes, pricing adjustments, and approved commercial exceptions.
  • Keep Salesforce accurate and current as the single source of truth for renewal amount, forecast category, risks, next steps, owners, commercial status, and expected close timing.
  • Ensure signed renewals become clean, billable transactions by coordinating PO requirements, billing contacts, subscription dates, payment terms, invoice schedules, and other required information with Finance.
  • Analyze churn, contraction, uplift realization, multi-year adoption, late renewals, forecast variance, and other renewal patterns and turn those insights into improvements to the operating model.

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in SaaS renewals, account management, customer success, or another commercial post-sale role, with meaningful direct ownership of renewals.
  • Demonstrated experience owning a renewal target or book of business and delivering strong retention outcomes with disciplined forecasting.
  • Experience building or materially improving a renewals process, operating model, playbook, forecast methodology, or commercial cadence—not simply operating within an established one.
  • Experience in cybersecurity or another complex B2B SaaS environment involving enterprise customers, channel partners, procurement, and legal stakeholders.
  • Strong commercial judgment and negotiation skills across pricing, term, uplift, concessions, multi-year agreements, procurement, and contract execution.
  • Ability to operate both strategically and tactically: you can design the process, build the dashboard, negotiate with a customer, inspect a forecast, and chase a signature when needed.
  • Ability to distinguish customer-value risk from commercial or transaction risk and mobilize the right cross-functional team for each.
  • Strong executive communication skills: concise, credible, comfortable with senior customer stakeholders, and effective in high-pressure commercial situations.
  • Strong analytical skills and operational rigor, with the ability to manage a large number of concurrent renewal dates without losing the strategic context of the account.
  • Strong Salesforce fluency; experience with CPQ / DealHub-style quoting, forecasting tools, customer-success platforms, and contract workflows is highly valuable.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-growing environment where roles and processes are evolving and you are expected to create structure rather than wait for it.

Why Join Doppel

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful equity; $120,000 - $130,000 OTE
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Comprehensive health benefits, PTO, and parental leave.
  • Opportunity to build a critical recurring-revenue function from the ground up and have a direct impact on how Doppel scales.

Success Measures

  • Strong Gross Revenue Retention and achievement of Doppel's renewable ARR target.
  • High percentage of renewals completed on or before the contractual renewal date.
  • Reliable renewal forecast accuracy with risks identified early enough for the business to act.
  • Consistent realization of approved renewal uplifts and increased adoption of multi-year agreements where appropriate.
  • Reduced late-stage surprises, emergency extensions, and renewals entering the final 30 days without a clear path to close.
  • Clear visibility into churn and contraction drivers with measurable improvements based on those insights.
  • Consistent execution of direct, channel, and auto-renewal motions with clean ownership and handoffs.
  • A scalable, documented renewals operating model that reduces administrative burden on CSMs and allows them to spend more time driving customer value.
  • Clean handoffs from signed renewal to Finance, with accurate contracts, dates, PO information, billing contacts, and payment terms.
  • A clear recommendation for how the Renewals function should scale as Doppel's customer base and renewable ARR grow.
Salary Range
$120,000—$130,000 USD
